chapters.title: Chapter 251 - Offline Meeting
paragraphs: “Hello? Chen Yu?”
“Fang Heng? I’ve finally gotten in touch with you.”
Chen Yu was a little surprised.
He felt that it was too difficult to even contact Fang Heng!
“Hahaha, I’m sorry. I’ve been quite busy recently.”
“Fang Heng, we’re preparing to enter Pine City. This operation is very important. We’ve already received news that the anti-federation forces have been...”
“Ahem, Chen Yu.”
Fang Heng coughed lightly and interrupted, “Actually, I’m not interested in the mission in Pine City. Why don’t we settle the account for the last Blood Moon Project?”
“Ah?”
Chen Yu exclaimed.
He did not expect Fang Heng to call about the account this time.
“Did you run into some trouble?”
“Yes, it’s big trouble.”
Fang Heng sighed, sounding very distressed.
“I need trucks. Trucks that can transport goods. The more the better.”
Chen Yu opened his mouth and immediately began to think.
What did he need so many trucks for?
Was one not enough?
What kind of operation was the prison shelter planning to use trucks for?
Seeing that the other party did not answer, Fang Heng asked tentatively, “Chen Yu?”
“Oh, I’m here. I’m sorry, I was distracted.” “The last Blood Moon incident was all thanks to your prison, which provided a lot of help to the Federation.”

Chen Yu scratched the back of his head. “Fang Heng, we estimate that we can provide you with an item equivalent to 1,300 King of Gods’ points. However, we have already provided you with some special ore resources in the early stages.”
“In other words, we can also provide you with three large military delivery trucks. Do you think this plan will work?”
Only three.
Fang Heng frowned, feeling that it was a bit too little.
However, after careful calculation, the materials used to repair the alloy emergency exits of the quarantine zone were all extremely rare metals, and the actual price was indeed very high.
Furthermore, the Federation did not cheat him.
“Alright, three then. When will the goods arrive?”
“I’ll apply as soon as possible. It’s estimated to be tomorrow.”

Chen Yu felt that something was not right, so he continued to ask, “Fang Heng, Pine City is related to the main storyline mission and the rewards will be substantial. Are you sure you don’t want to go?”
“You want me to go?”
“Yes, the two Federation players who participated in the Pine City mission with you previously highly recommended you.”
Chen Yu was very sincere and said, “With you around, our mission success rate will increase significantly.”
Fang Heng sensed an opportunity.
He raised his eyebrows.
“Then... Why don’t you give me two more military trucks? I’ll follow along to protect your safety?”
“This...” Chen Yu was stunned for a moment before he replied, “I’ll go and ask my superiors. We might take action tomorrow morning. You have to make preparations in advance.”
“No problem. By the way, do you have any plans for the next round of the Blood Moon Project?”
“Yes, because the two Blood Moons are too close. Although the game has already activated the server transfer system, the difficulty of the server transfer is still too high for us at this stage.”
Fang Heng was delighted and immediately said, “Add five more military trucks for me. I want 200 people for the next round of the Blood Moon. How about it?”
“You guys give me the goods first. The people can move in after three days.”
Chen Yu was puzzled.
He did not doubt that Fang Heng could handle the Blood Moon given 150 people.
But... he wanted five big trucks?
There were already ten big trucks here and there. What was Fang Heng trying to do?
Was he going to have a car exhibition?
“I’ll have to ask the leader about this. I think it shouldn’t be a big problem.”
“Okay, contact me anytime if you have any news.”
Fang Heng hung up the phone.
He was elated.
This was great.
With military trucks, they could transport resources to the shelter one by one.
They could then transport some of the resources to the apocalypse merchant camp around the shelter and sell them for points.
The plan to empty the apocalypse merchant camp, which was set half a month ago, finally saw light.
For future military trucks, the next road repair plan had to be put on the agenda.
Hold on, slow down.
At least for the next two days, after completing the repair of the quarantine zone’s emergency exits, he could rest and hang up the game properly.
After all, there were more important things to do outside of the game.
Fang Heng pondered for a while, opened the website and booked a train ticket to Xihong City.
Fang Heng packed a few clothes and headed to the train station.
Five hours later.
“Hi, God! I’m here! I’m here!”
Just as he got off the train, Fang Heng saw Mo Jiawei standing on the platform.
He was standing in the most eye-catching position among the crowd, waving his hands and feet. Behind him were two muscular bodyguards in black.
“God, you’ve finally seen me in person. Let’s go, I’ll bring you to the best foot spa city in this area.”
“I’ve already booked a private room. Don’t worry. When we reach my old Mo Family’s territory, you can eat, drink and have fun.”
Fang Heng smiled bitterly.
He was not here to eat, drink and have fun this time.
“No, let’s talk about business first.”
“Foot spa city is business. You don’t know, right? My great-great-grandfather’s generation started off with a foot spa city. Oh right, it wasn’t called foot spa city then, it was called a bathhouse.”
“It’s a tradition of our family to invite our best friends to foot spa city.”
Mo Jiawei bragged and put his hand on Fang Heng’s shoulder. “Besides, my fourth uncle is very healthy. He goes to bed at 10 p.m. I’ll take you to see him tomorrow morning.”
“Okay.”
Seeing Mo Jiawei’s enthusiasm, Fang Heng could only follow his ‘master’s’ orders.
After having a meal in the splendid foot spa city, Mo Jiawei brought Fang Heng into a VIP room to soak his feet. “Phew! Awesome!”
After soaking his feet in the tub, Mo Jiawei sighed.
Fang Heng looked at the two bodyguards in black behind Mo Jiawei.
Along the way, the two security guards followed closely behind Mo Jiawei 24 hours a day.
They even followed him to the toilet.
“God, these two security guards were trained by the family since they were young. They are reliable and keep their mouths shut. We can rest assured.”
Mo Jiawei explained and chatted with Fang Heng about the game.
“The next Blood Moon is very short. Is the prison shelter going to accept players? I think we can use this opportunity to make a lot of money.”
wed
“Yeah, we can consider it.”
Fang Heng pondered for a moment.
Not to mention money, Fang Heng felt that he could use the Blood Moon as an opportunity to kill a wave of zombies and earn a wave of points and evolution crystals.
After a while, when Victor finished building the beam turret, Blood Moon Level 30 would be as easy as playing games.
“But I don’t want too many spies to sneak into the shelter... I need to screen the personnel...”
While the two were chatting, there was a knock on the door and a foot-spa city waiter came in with a fruit plate.
Fang Heng looked at him twice.
“Be careful!”
Suddenly, the bodyguard in black shouted.
The moment the voice sounded, the hotel employee took out a black pistol from his pocket and pointed it at Mo Jiawei.
The other bodyguard in black reacted faster. He had already pounced on Mo Jiawei with his body.
Just as the bodyguard was about to press down on his pistol, a white shadow flew toward him.

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - Occultism
paragraphs: “Dong!!!”
A white ashtray dashed out from the side and smashed into the waiter’s wrist!
“Ah!”
The waiter let out a pig-like howl and the gun in his hand flew out.
The next moment, Fang Heng had already stepped in front of the waiter.
He grabbed the waiter’s right hand and exerted force on his right arm.
Every move and move was completely based on the instinctive reaction of the muscles in his body.
The waiter was lifted by Fang Heng and drew a circle in the air.
“Dong!”
The waiter landed on his back and was smashed onto the floor, making a dull knocking sound.
The waiter felt pain all over his body and lost the ability to move.
He had just gritted his teeth and raised his head when two black muzzles were already aimed at his head.
“Don’t move!”
The waiter’s expression changed slightly.
The next second, his head tilted and he fainted.
The black-clothed bodyguard looked surprised. He immediately squatted down and quickly checked the waiter’s condition.
The bodyguard frowned and turned to look at Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei.
“He’s dead, it’s poison. He committed suicide.”
Fang Heng looked at Mo Jiawei and asked, “Is he here for you?”
Mo Jiawei was also shocked.
“This...”
The next morning, in the meditation room.
A young man dressed in white sat upright on a futon.
Mo Yunxiao.
Mo Jiawei’s fourth uncle.
Fang Heng sized up Mo Yunxiao, who was making tea and muttered in his heart.
He was so young!
On the outside, Mo Yunxiao was not much older than Mo Jiawei. It was not an exaggeration to say that they looked like blood brothers.
Mo Yunxiao slowly poured three cups of tea and handed them to Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei.
“Please.”
Fang Heng picked up the teacup and took a sip.
“Fang Heng, I’ve heard a lot about you.”
“You’ve heard of me?”
Fang Heng was puzzled.
He thought to himself, am I very famous?
Mo Yunxiao caught the subtle expression on Fang Heng’s face. He smiled and did not answer. He lowered his head and took a sip of tea.
Because of the assassination incident, Mo Jiawei was brought to the police station last night to be investigated. He only returned home at midnight.
He had just slept for a few hours and was dragged by Fang Heng to meet the guest.
He yawned at the side. “Fourth Uncle, Fang Heng is my best friend. He has helped me a lot in the game and is also our partner.”
“He has been in some trouble recently, so he specially came to ask you for advice.”
“I don’t dare to give advice, let’s talk instead.”
Mo Yunxiao sat up straight and made a gesture of invitation.
“If you have any doubts, feel free to say it.”
Fang Heng had already prepared a rough draft before coming here.
He gave a rough description of his memory loss and the ritual he saw in the dream.
As for the note that he found in the rented house, Fang Heng deliberately hid it.
After listening to Fang Heng’s narration, Mo Yunxiao seemed to have an answer.
He whispered, “The memory loss...”
“Uncle, you already know?”
“Probably.”
Looking up, Mo Yunxiao smiled slightly.
“Fang Heng, there’s no doubt that what you saw in your dream was a memory projection, but what you saw may not be true.”
“For example, if you saw your friend in your dream, she might just be a psychological hint.”
“Your friend might have participated in your ritual, but of course, it’s also possible that it has nothing to do with the ritual.”
“We can now confirm one thing. You did participate in the ritual before, and you even opened the ‘lock’ through the power of the ritual.”
Fang Heng nodded.
“As for the memory loss you mentioned, I think this has nothing to do with the ritual.”
Fang Heng was a little surprised and asked in surprise, “Nothing to do with it?”
“Yes, part of the reason for the memory loss is probably related to the King of Gods’ game.”
Fang Heng’s frown deepened.
“Under certain circumstances, the player’s memory will be hidden by the King of Gods.”

“For example, the Federation has confirmed that once a player has completed the main storyline mission, he will use some special method to return to the new server of the elementary game and attempt to complete the main storyline mission again.”
“At this time, the King of Gods will hide the player’s memories of the relevant game content.”
“As time passes, the relevant memories related to this matter will gradually be hidden.”
“Of course, some of the hidden memories can be awakened.”
As he spoke, Mo Yunxiao put down the teacup in his hand and stared into Fang Heng’s eyes.
“Fang Heng, do you still remember your ranking in the basic level Magic Tower?”
Magic Tower?
Fang Heng was stunned.
Following that, a series of memories appeared in his mind.
Other than the official game, there were many other training modes in the King of Gods’ game that could be used.
For example, the Magic Tower mode, the Arena mode, the Team mode...
These modes had nothing to do with the game world of the main storyline, and participating in the game couldn’t earn any time online. No one had ever received any rewards from these modes.
Hence, the vast majority of players would ignore them.
However, the Federation believed that the existence of these game modes wasn’t meaningless.
King of Gods had activated these modes to train the player.
Before the player reached adulthood, they could enter the game through the game cabin, but they could only enter the basic modes of these types of games.
To encourage the player to participate in the game training from a young age, the entire Federation would provide large amounts of money to hold large-scale competitions around the world.
Fang Heng remembered that this body of his had entered the game from the start of his studies, and had once been addicted to it.
In the past, it was because of his outstanding performance in the Magic Tower mode that he caught the attention of several gaming clubs.
“It seems that my judgment was right. You have already recalled some things.”
Mo Yunxiao felt that his guess was right. He stretched out his left hand forward and spread it out.
“Fang Heng, do you mind if I observe the mark on the back of your hand?”
“Sure.”
Fang Heng stretched out his hand and let Mo Yunxiao’s palm cover the back of his hand.
Mo Yunxiao picked up the teacup on the short wooden table and poured it on the back of Fang Heng’s hand.
A soft sound came from the back of Fang Heng’s hand and some steam came out.
The runic mark on the back of his hand appeared again.
It lasted for four to five seconds before the runic mark slowly disappeared.
Mo Yunxiao withdrew his hand and frowned, remaining silent. Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but urge, “Fourth Uncle, how is it?”
“It’s a ritual of occultism. Currently, it’s only activated to Tier 1 materialization.”
“The strange thing is that I’ve never seen this ritual before, but I can confirm that it’s been partially modified.”
Fang Heng asked, “Mr Mo, is there any danger to this ritual?”
“From the perspective of the ritual, I have never heard of the existence of traps or dangers, but some rituals have some special effects.”
Hearing this, Fang Heng was greatly relieved.
What he was most afraid of was the negative effects of the mark on the back of the hand.
Mo Yunxiao lowered his head and thought for a moment, then raised his head again.
“Fang Heng, I need some time to look up some information. I hope that I can understand the specific meaning of the effect of the ritual on the back of your hand.”
“I may need your cooperation during this period. If it’s convenient, I hope you can stay here for some time.”
Fang Heng briefly thought about it.
Staying here was not much different from going back. They were both playing games.
If he did not figure out the effect of the mark on the back of his hand, he could hardly be at ease.
“Thank you. Sorry to bother you during this period.”

Sorry to bother you during this period.”

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - Actual Combat
paragraphs: “I won’t disturb you. Researching rituals is one of my hobbies. You can stay here. I’ll get my assistant to arrange a room for you.”
“Ah, right!”
Mo Yunxiao was just about to get up when he suddenly thought of something.

“Coincidentally, the Federation’s semi-annual materialization professional qualification examination will be held in a month. Our North River Heavy Industry also has a group of players who are actively preparing for the examination. Why don’t you come with me to take a look?”

Seeing Fang Heng’s blank expression, Mo Yunxiao patiently explained. “The Federation strictly controls the player’s ‘lock’ behaviour. Only after passing the assessment will they be considered to have a legal identity.”
“Apart from identity and background, the assessment also has some requirements for strength.”
Fang Heng nodded, but he was feeling doubtful.
What was there to see?
Furthermore, he was instinctively a little disgusted by the Federation’s actions of controlling him.
Furthermore, he had already activated Tier 1 materialization and could be considered a ‘black account’.
He wouldn’t participate in any assessments in the future.
“Ha, just treat it as a small favour. I’ll bring you to my game hall to take a look first. I believe everyone will welcome you very much.”
Mo Jiawei’s interest was piqued when he heard that. “Game hall? Uncle, I want to go
too!”
North River Stadium.
The game hall was the largest stadium.
Twelve large-scale arenas were placed in the centre of the stadium.
Futons, wooden stakes for training, boxing gloves...
Most of the students were between the ages of 20 and 30.
Fang Heng also saw a few young people who were not even 18 years old.
At first glance, this place looked more like a dojo?
As soon as he stepped into the stadium, part of the memories related to the body resurfaced in Fang Heng’s mind.
Since junior high school, Fang Heng had been training in a similar type of game hall.
He had suffered a lot. It had taken him more than four years to reach the maximum attribute of 5 points.
The ordinary player was different. After they entered the game, their basic attribute would generally fluctuate between 3 to 4.5.
Mo Yunxiao clapped his hands and led Fang Heng to the centre of the largest arena. He gathered the players who were training in the arena.
“Let me introduce you to everyone, this is Fang Heng.”
Hearing Fang Heng’s name, the underground players discussed in low voices.
“Fang Heng? How familiar... I’ve heard of him before.”
“Idiot, the Magic Tower, have you heard of the Genius Youth? He was popular for a while back then.”
“Ah? It’s him?”
“Who is it? Is he very powerful?”
“I’ve never heard of him. I don’t know.”
“He was quite powerful in the past. I heard that he became useless for some reason.”
“That’s right, it’s him. I searched his name on the Internet...”
What was going on? He was quite famous?
Fang Heng heard the discussions of the players and was somewhat confused.

“Fang Heng used to be a professional player. Due to some reasons, he retired from the professional player stage. During this period, he will undergo some recovery training here. Everyone, let’s welcome him.”
The students stopped their discussion and started clapping
“Then...” Mo Yunxiao smiled and looked
“Is there anyone who wants to spar with Fang Heng?”
aro
Huh?
Fang Heng turned to look at Mo Yunxiao.
Mo Yunxiao still had a faint smile on his face.
He leaned over and whispered into Fang Heng’s ear, “It’s okay. It’s just a game. Remember to use your full strength, or you’ll be at a disadvantage.”
“I’ll do it!”
A spirited young man among the players waved his hand excitedly. He bravely walked out of the crowd and stood in front of Fang Heng.
The other players also pushed back one after another and formed a circle, leaving enough space for the two to display their skills.
Fang Heng frowned.
What did he mean? He was going to fight directly?
Mo Jiawei was so excited that he cheered Fang Heng on in the crowd. “God, you can do it! F*ck him!”
“Whew!”
Seeing Fang Heng standing there casually, Wu Peng was a little unhappy.
Wu Peng clasped his fists at Fang Heng.
“I am Wu Peng, 29 years old, Tier 1 materialization. Please advise.”
After saying that, Wu Peng carefully approached Fang Heng and launched a probing attack. His huge fist swept past Fang Heng’s right side.
Fang Heng knew that he had Tier 1 materialization ability.
His average basic attribute was about 30, which was much higher than ordinary people!
Even though he could not use the in-game skill-bullet time, his high agility attribute and perception allowed him to clearly capture and determine the trajectory of Wu Peng’s punch.
The incoming fist was still in mid-air.

Fang Heng’s physical memory was activated. As if he had rehearsed it thousands of times in advance, Fang Heng took a small step to the side and slightly moved his body to the side, easily dodging Wu Peng’s fist.
Raising his right hand, he threw a punch at Wu Peng’s face.
He used all his strength at once!
It was the fastest punch that Fang Heng could ever release!
Wu Peng instantly felt as if he was enveloped by the edge of a fist.
Shouldn’t both be doing a trial test of each other’s ability in this combat?
Wu Peng was so frightened by this punch that he broke out in cold sweat. He hurriedly withdrew his hands to protect his body.
“Bang!”
“Ta, ta, ta.”
Wu Peng’s arm was hit by a punch. He took three steps back consecutively with a look of disbelief on his face.
What a heavy punch!
A hint of surprise flashed across Mo Yunxiao’s eyes.
The entire venue was quiet for a moment.
Among the people in the training ground, Wu Peng’s strength was among the best.
He was knocked back several steps with just one punch?
Wu Peng pursed his lips and shook his numb right hand.
He did not feel that his strength was insufficient. He only felt that he was careless.
Just as he was about to continue, he saw that Mo Yunxiao had already walked in front of Fang Heng.
“Clap, clap, clap...”
Mo Yunxiao took the lead and clapped.
The students also reacted when they saw the situation and clapped together.
“Today’s sparring session ends here. Everyone, continue your training.”
The outcome had yet to be decided, and it ended just like that?
The students were rather disappointed.
Everyone dispersed and continued to train and chat in twos and threes.
Fang Heng stood to the side and lowered his head in thought.
In the game, his strength attribute was already higher than 30 points.
When he used his full strength, his fist easily pierced through a slightly thinner steel plate.
But when he fought with Wu Peng just now, he felt that his opponent’s strength was not much inferior to his own.
There was always someone better than him!
Fang Heng felt that he had been a little inflated recently.

He had originally thought that his strength attribute was already at the peak. He did not expect that any random person pulled out from the training grounds would be able to fight him to a 40-60 split.

“Wu Peng is one of the best among these people. Currently, he has entered the intermediate level of the game. Based on his strength, it will definitely not be a problem for him to pass the Federation’s materialization qualification examination.”
Mo Yunxiao walked to Fang Heng’s side and said softly, “Also, his strength attribute is 9.4.”
What?
Only 9.4?
Fang Heng suspected that he had heard wrongly. He turned around and looked at Mo Yunxiao with surprise.
“You’ve realized it? Your strength attribute in the game is at least 15 points, right?”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng nodded. “You’ve only activated the ritual, but you haven’t truly grasped the ritual’s skills.”
Although Mo Yunxiao had a smile on his face, his surprise was no less than Fang Heng’s.
It was only an elementary game and his basic strength attribute had already exceeded 15 points!
Not only was it strength attribute, but judging from the punch just now, agility and perception were not low either.

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - Meditation
paragraphs: “I have nothing to do during this period. If I have time, can I learn some things here?”
Seeing that Fang Heng was interested, Mo Yunxiao suggested, “But I have to remind you in advance that learning this thing is quite time-consuming, and it’s not useful in the game at the moment.”
“You can teach me?”
Things that could improve one’s strength, even if it was only effective outside of the game, had to be learned!
Moreover, Fang Heng had a faint premonition.
Materialization ability was extremely important.
If everything was as he had guessed, then sooner or later, this world would become a part of the game.
“Hey, don’t be so serious. To be honest, this thing is quite simple. With your ability, there’s no problem.”
Mo Yunxiao smiled gently and patted Fang Heng’s shoulder to show his encouragement.

“According to the different ways of unlocking, there are different ways of learning. You used an occult ritual to unlock it, so you need to use meditation to control the ritual.” “Although our North River Heavy Industry is not doing well in the game, we still spend a lot of money every year to train students.”
“If you want to learn, there are courses in the meditation hall next door.”

“I’ll get my assistant to get you a card. After you get the card, you can use the hall for free. Every afternoon, there will be a teacher who can coach you on the spot. You can come whenever you want to practice...”
Afternoon, in the meditation hall.
Fang Heng sat in a corner of the room.
Like the other students, he sat on the futon with his eyes closed.
According to what the teacher had taught him, Fang Heng tried to empty his mind.
He adjusted his breathing and controlled his heartbeat.
He expelled all the chaotic thoughts from his mind.
Only chaos remained in his sea of consciousness.
Fang Heng had heard Mo Jiawei mention this during lunch.
The difficulty of meditation training was equivalent to hell level.
Ever since he was young, Mo Jiawei had seen many students who spent months in meditation but were unable to enter a state of meditation.
Many students sat on futons for a month or two. Their state of mind had collapsed and they were unable to recover.
On the contrary, Fang Heng felt that meditation was very simple.
After calming his heart, he quickly entered a meditative state and saw the sea of consciousness that his teacher had described.
It was a sea of grey chaos!
Fang Heng controlled his consciousness and carved rune marks in the chaos.
It didn’t seem to be as difficult as the teacher said?
According to the teacher, carving a mark in the chaos was a very difficult thing.
The person had to rely on his strong willpower to carve a mark in the chaos bit by bit.
Under normal circumstances, it would take two to three months to complete it.
However, after experiencing it for himself, Fang Heng discovered that it wasn’t difficult to leave a mark in the sea of consciousness.
He only needed to focus his mind.
Could it be that he was very special?
Fang Heng didn’t think about anything else. He followed the mark on the back of his hand in his memory and focused his mind to carve runes in the sea of consciousness.
The runes themselves weren’t complicated.
The outermost part was oval and the inside was an irregular hexagram.
There were even a few thick lines in a few corners that were connected.
Time passed by minute by minute.
In the sea of consciousness, Fang Heng could not feel the passage of time in the outside world.
After an unknown amount of time, the last bit of the oval perfectly condensed.
The engraving was completed!
The rune gradually materialized and it emitted layers of dark golden light, floating in the chaos.
He had succeeded?
It was that simple?
It was too smooth, and Fang Heng was not quite sure for a moment.
“It shouldn’t be wrong, right?”
In the next moment, Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
He noticed that red blood was seeping out from the edge of the dark golden rune.
What was going on? Looking carefully, red blood was continuously seeping out from the edges of the dark golden rune.
Drip...
A drop of blood fell to the ground along with the golden rune.
Fang Heng realized that the entire golden rune was gradually being devoured by the blood...
Something was wrong!
Fang Heng was sure that this situation was not normal, but after the runes were inscribed, his mental strength could no longer affect the sea of consciousness.
He could only watch helplessly as the runes were devoured by the blood.
Fang Heng tried the sea of consciousness.
But he found that he could not do it at all!
The sky darkened.
The afternoon meditation class ended and the other students in the meditation room had already left.
Only Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei were left in the room.
Mo Jiawei was lying on the futon.
At first, he came to ask Fang Heng to have dinner with him.
Seeing that Fang Heng was still cultivating with his eyes closed, he decided not to disturb him, so he waited by the side.
He waited and fell asleep at some point.
Outside the door, a noise woke Mo Jiawei up.
“What’s wrong?”
Mo Jiawei was in a daze.
He saw Fang Heng still sitting on the futon, still in a meditative position.
A bodyguard in black pushed the door open and walked in. He whispered something into Mo Jiawei’s ear. “What?”
Mo Jiawei was shocked. He suddenly got up and said, “Quick, take me to have a look.”
Leaving Fang Heng alone, Mo Jiawei hurriedly left the meditation room and ran out of the stadium with the bodyguard.
Outside the stadium, most of the students gathered at the entrance and pointed at the sky.
Many of them even took out their phones and took pictures of the sky.
Mo Jiawei also followed the crowd’s gaze and looked at the sky.
What the hell were those things!
In the sky, a dense mass of black gathered together.
Bats?
Why were there so many bats?
Mo Jiawei was stunned.
In a big city, it was usually very difficult to find even one or two bats, let alone so many bats gathered together.
The other students also found it very strange.
More and more bats gathered in the sky. They circled in the sky uneasily, covering a large area of the sky.
Their ears were filled with the sizzling sound of the bats’ wings rubbing against each other.
Mo Jiawei felt that something was not right. He turned to look at the bodyguard beside him.
“What’s going on?”

The bodyguard whispered, “I don’t know. When it was dark, someone noticed a small number of bats near the stadium. At first, they didn’t notice it, but since ten minutes ago, more and more bats have gathered.”
“Have you notified Second Uncle?”
“I have. He’s on his way.”
Suddenly, something happened to one of the students in the crowd. He pointed at the sky and said, “F*ck, look!”
Mo Jiawei looked up again.
The dark mass of bats became restless.
After circling in the air for a few rounds, they rushed toward the crowd below at the same time.
What the hell!
“Watch out!”
Mo Jiawei’s heart skipped a beat and he was immediately pulled into the stadium by the two bodyguards behind him.
“Come in quickly!”
The entire stadium was in chaos!
The students ran back to the stadium one after another.
A large group of black bats followed the gate and flew in, causing chaos in the stadium!
“Close the door! Close the door quickly!”
Someone shouted.
In the chaos, someone forcefully closed the glass door.
“Bang! Bang! Bang...”
The bats in the outside world were still crazily attacking the tempered glass door.
It seemed like there was something in the stadium that attracted the bats.

“Close the door!
Close the door quickly!”
Someone shouted.
In the chaos, someone forcefully closed the glass door.
“Bang!
Bang!
Bang...”
The bats in the outside world were still crazily attacking the tempered glass door.
It seemed like there was something in the stadium that attracted the bats.

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 5 Decaying Ritual Runes
paragraphs: “What the hell is going on...”

Mo Jiawei thought to himself that he must have seen a ghost. In the past two days, he had been attacked by assassins and now he was attacked by a swarm of bats. Could it be that they were all coming for him?
Was he getting unlucky?
Mo Jiawei was a little flustered.
He had asked his second uncle as to who tried to assassinate him, but he hadn’t received any reply. He was only told to be careful and not to go out alone.
“Bang!!!”
A loud noise interrupted Mo Jiawei’s random thoughts.
He looked up and saw a swarm of bats breaking through the glass door.
Groups of bats swarmed into the stadium again.
All of a sudden, the students were in a mess. Some of them pointed fire extinguishers at the air, while others covered their heads with their clothes and fled...
The bodyguard put down the walkie-talkie and whispered, “Young Master Mo, Second Master has just arrived. He’s calling for
you...”
A private car stopped at the entrance of the stadium
A middle-aged man stepped out of the car.
He looked to be in his forties or fifties with white hair on his temples.
He raised his head to look at the sky and narrowed his eyes slightly.
There were still a large number of bats entrenched in the sky.
They hovered in the sky and vaguely gathered into a rune.
“Ritual... occultism...”
Mo Xiangtian whispered, his face thoughtful.
“Second Uncle!”
Mo Jiawei ran over under the escort of two bodyguards.
He asked three questions in a row.
“Second Uncle, why are there so many bats all of a sudden? Is it related to the Vampire Apocalypse?”
“Could it be that someone is targeting our North River Heavy Industry?”
“Do you know who it is?”
Mo Xiangtian did not answer. He only asked, “Jiawei, has there been a newcomer in the game training room recently?”
“Newcomer?” Mo Jiawei was stunned. He shook his head and said, “No.”
“Forget it. It’s not peaceful these days. You stay at home and don’t go out.”
Mo Jiawei put on a bitter face. “Ah...?”
“Hey, Second Uncle, are you going back? What about the bats? Aren’t you going to deal with them?”
Fang Heng was still sitting quietly on the futon in the meditation room.
“Bang!”
“Bang! Bang!!”
The black bats broke through the windows one after another and flew into the meditation room where Fang Heng was.
They were attracted by a special strength and flapped their wings one after another, surrounding Fang Heng.
Fang Heng had no perception of what was happening in the outside world.
He was still trapped in the space of consciousness.
Fang Heng stood in front of the rune and quietly observed it like a spectator.
After several attempts, Fang Heng found that he could not break free from the space of consciousness.
So he gave up.
At least he did not feel any danger.
The golden rune was now completely soaked in blood. It was like it had been fished out from the blood. Blood kept oozing out and blossoming with blood-red light.
It was over?
What was next?
Fang Heng was rather curious, wondering what new tricks this rune could come up with.
“Eh?”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
After the blood-red glow reached its peak, it slowly dimmed.
A tiny black dot appeared at the corner of the rune.
Upon closer inspection, that black dot seemed to be...
Rotten?
Like burnt paper, layers of black ashes began to fall off the surface of the rune.
Layer by layer...
The entire rune started to decay...
Under the blood-red colour, the entire rune seemed to have been placed on the spot for millions of years, gradually becoming dark and decaying.
“There are changes again?”
Fang Heng did not know that at this moment, in the outside world, the bats circling him fell to the ground one by one, losing their vitality.
The bat corpses that littered the ground decayed at a speed visible to the naked eye, revealing the ghastly white bones...
This commotion came and went quickly.
After more than ten minutes, the bats that were entrenched in the stadium had completely dispersed.
Wu Peng and the other two students on duty today were cursing and swearing as they proceeded to clean up the bat corpses in the building
“What did Teacher Chen say?”
“He didn’t say anything. He looked like he was hiding something. I thought that this matter was definitely not normal.”
“If I had to say, it might be some big shot who has activated the Tier 3 materialization to test his skill.”
“Stop bragging. Using our North River Heavy Industry to test his skill? Are their brains damaged? Aren’t they afraid of provoking the black-faced Buddha?”
“Maybe it’s our enemy who is showing off. Haven’t you heard that the young master of the company group was ambushed yesterday...”
As they spoke, the group opened the door of the meditation room.
Wu Peng was the first to step into the room.
He was stunned.
The others also stopped talking and fell silent at the same time.
This...
It was as if the meditation room had just experienced the end of the world.
The internal chaos in the room was terrifying. Almost every part of the room was left with traces of damage from the impact.
On the ground, there were piles of white bones left by the dead bats.
Meanwhile, Fang Heng was still sitting on the futon in the corner of the meditation room, motionless.
This was too strange!
Wu Peng and the others looked at each other and felt that something was wrong.
Fang Heng?
He was still meditating?
With such a big movement just now, he was still able to maintain a meditative state?
Could it be that something had happened?
The few of them exchanged glances.
In the end, Wu Peng gathered his courage and walked carefully toward Fang Heng.
Only when he walked behind Fang Heng did he gently pat his shoulder.
“Fang Heng?”
Seeing that Fang Heng did not respond, Wu Peng exerted more strength. He reached out his hand and pressed on Fang Heng’s shoulder, trying to shake him. “Hey, Fang Heng, are you alright?”
“Chi!!”
Suddenly, Fang Heng’s eyes opened. His right hand went back and firmly grasped the hand that Wu Peng put on his shoulder.
Wu Peng did not even see clearly how Fang Heng attacked! He instinctively tightened all the muscles in his body!
He felt that his wrist was firmly bound by a strength that he could not resist. Then, the world spun in front of his eyes and the world turned upside down.
The series of attacks came from Fang Heng’s muscle reaction.
Fang Heng only came back to his senses when he threw Wu Peng into the air.
The force that was originally smashing Wu Peng down suddenly withdrew, and his palm also loosened.
“Bang!”
Wu Peng’s entire body flew out along with the force and he hit the wall with a thud.
Fang Heng lowered his head and looked at his hands, then looked at the white bones around the room.
White bones?
They looked like the bones of a bird.
What happened?
Wu Peng did not fall heavily. He quickly got up from the ground and grabbed his forearm that Fang Heng had grabbed just now.
His forearm was in excruciating pain!
He looked at Fang Heng warily, and a layer of cold sweat appeared on his forehead.
That grab just now was too terrifying!
Whether it was strength or speed, they were much stronger than when they met in the arena!
Therefore, he didn’t use his full strength when they were sparring just now!
“What’s wrong?”
After being taught a lesson by his second uncle, Mo Jiawei was about to come back to look for Fang Heng when he heard the sound of collision in the corridor, so he sped up and rushed in.
Seeing the bones all over the floor in the room, Mo Jiawei was also dumbfounded.
“I’m sorry. I accidentally made a move while I was meditating just now. Are you okay?”
“I’m fine.” Wu Peng gritted his teeth and forced himself to hold on. Fang Heng nodded. “You’re very good. Let’s spar again next time.”
Mo Jiawei blinked his eyes and looked suspiciously at Wu Peng and the others.

“Fang Heng, you’re finally awake. Chen Yu came to look for me just now. He said that the big truck you ordered has arrived and can be picked up at any time. In addition, the team from the Federation has already entered Pine City...”
Fang Heng looked around the room and nodded. “Let’s talk outside.”
The two of them spoke as they left the meditation room.

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - Ritual Control
paragraphs: After watching Fang Heng leave, Wu Peng could no longer hold himself back and sat down on the spot.
The other two students also surrounded him.
“Brother Peng, are you hurt?”
“Hiss!”
Wu Peng carefully opened his sleeve.
The spot that Fang Heng had just grabbed was swollen.
Their faces instantly turned slightly pale.
“Could it be a bone fracture? Quickly go to the infirmary to take a look.”
After leaving the meditation room, Fang Heng followed Mo Jiawei back to Mo Yunxiao’s villa.
On the way, Fang Heng roughly learned from Mo Jiawei what had happened in the stadium not long ago.
“God, do you think it’s strange? So many bats suddenly appeared. I thought it was an enemy that came looking for us.”
“Yes, indeed.”
Fang Heng replied and lowered his head in thought.
Was the bat’s attack related to him?
And the white bones that littered the ground after he woke up...
It seemed like he would have to find an opportunity to ask Mo Yunxiao tomorrow.
However, did his meditation count as complete?
After the construction of the runes was completed, there were two changes. The first was that blood flowed out, and the second was that it became rotten.
Fang Heng lowered his head and tried to clench his fists.
Strength had indeed increased a lot compared to before.
After returning to Mo Yunxiao’s villa, the assistant had already prepared two guest rooms for Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei.
After Fang Heng washed up, he returned to the guest room.
A top-tier game cabin was placed in the living room of the room.
After a busy day, Fang Heng opened the game cabin and turned around to enter.
King of Gods’ space. Fang Heng did not enter the game directly as usual. Instead, he chose to stay in the King of Gods’ space to check the other options.
Magic Tower trial!
This trial was divided into basic mode and advanced mode.

The basic mode required all players to be at Level 5 after entering the Magic Tower. Moreover, they could only have the initial talent skill. They were only allowed to enter if they had not entered any elementary game before.
The advanced mode trial did not have any requirements. The various attribute skills during the challenge were consistent with the player’s attributes in the main game world.
Fang Heng took a look and casually opened the Magic Tower ranking board.
He was suddenly stunned.
Fang Heng? On the basic mode ranking board, Fang Heng’s name was shockingly ranked first.
100 levels!
He was the only person who had completed the basic mode 100-storey Magic Tower challenge before the age of 18!
Fang Heng had a vague premonition that some of his body’s memories had been erased.
Without further thought, Fang Heng chose to return to the Zombie Apocalypse game.
Once again, he appeared in the basement of the shelter.
A red hint flashed across Fang Heng’s vision.
(Hint: You have mastered a new skill-occult ritual.]
“Eh? Mastered a skill?”
Fang Heng immediately opened the game panel to check.
Skill-occult ritual (binding soul seal).
Level: Tier 1.

Skill description 1: After mastering this skill, you can synchronize your basic ability attribute into the player’s world. Current synchronization rate: 100%. Skill description 2: You can directly enter the game through the ritual seal.
Special ability 1 has been awakened through the soul seal: Outside of the game, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes.

Special ability 2 has been awakened through the soul seal (Vampire Apocalypse): You will not be affected by the distortion of the game world of the Vampire Apocalypse. In the Vampire Apocalypse game, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes.

Special ability 3 has been awakened through soul seal (Zombie Apocalypse): You will not be affected by the distortion of the game world of the Zombie Apocalypse game. In the Zombie Apocalypse game, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes.
Looking at the game description, Fang Heng’s doubts were not reduced at all but increased instead.
A 100% synchronization rate, did that mean that he could obtain a 100% ability mapping outside of the game?
Then what was the soul seal that was bound after the skill was activated?
“Soul seal.”
Fang Heng muttered softly. He recalled the note he found in the rental house.
It seemed to be very important.
Fang Heng opened the character panel and glanced at his attribute.
The ability of the seal was undoubtedly extremely powerful, directly increasing all attributes by 10%.
CIE
Moreover, this was only the first level up. Perhaps he could continue to level up in the future.
“Strange.”
Previously, Mo Yunxiao had clearly said that learning meditation would not affect one’s strength in the game world.
However, it was clear that he had also received a 10% increase in all attributes in the game.
Was this special effect unique to him?
Was it related to the soul seal?
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng sat down on the spot.
He decided to focus on the game and wait until tomorrow morning to ask Mo Yunxiao about it.
After lighting the bonfire, Fang Heng controlled a group of zombies to take turns and enter the quarantine zone to repair the alloy gate.
“Next, we’ll go to Pine City to pick up the people from the Federation.”
“While we’re at it, we’ll kidnap the nemesis!”
Pine City.
A group of twelve people from the federal team gathered at the weapons factory on the Meteorite Company’s campus.
Xu Bin was in charge of directing this operation.
After the Blood Moon ended, he and Xiao Jing had both tried to contact the Dark Knights.
However, the operation for the Dark Knights to once again infiltrate Pine City was temporarily put on hold. This made the Federation realize that something was wrong.
They thought that the anti-federation forces were acting in the dark, so they decided to enter Pine City to explore ahead of time, taking the initiative to trigger the mission.
When they infiltrated Pine City, they encountered their first problem.
The nemesis!
If they used a helicopter to enter Pine City, it was very likely that they would be bombarded by the nemesis’s rocket launcher like last time.
Therefore, Chen Yu paid the price of two military transport vehicles and obtained a badge from Fang Heng. This badge could block the nemesis’s tracking.
It was very effective!
The helicopter was not chased by the nemesis along the way.
However, the moment they entered Pine City, Xu Bin sensed that something was wrong.
Strange!
It was too strange! It was completely different from the last time he came to Pine City. The number of zombies in Pine City was too small!
If the difficulty level was SSS-level last time, the difficulty level now would be S-level at most.

He thought it was a tough battle, but he didn’t expect that they could easily occupy the weapons factory on the company’s campus. “Captain Xu, I’ve searched the place. The armoured vehicles in the underground garage are gone, and the spare weapons in the warehouse are gone.”
Xu Bin was a little surprised. He couldn’t help but look back at Xiao Jing, who was frantically lowering his head to take notes.
He let out a long sigh.
Alright, Xiao Jing was unreliable!
Before coming here, Xu Bin had originally planned to use the armoured vehicles as part of his follow-up plan.
However, this plan was rejected by Chen Yu after he proposed it.
The reason was that they were most likely unable to find the armoured vehicles in the Meteorite Company.
How strange!
How did Chen Yu know about it in advance?

“Captain, we’ve just checked. There are very few zombies on the Meteorite Company’s campus. We’ve looked around the three entrances of Areas C, D and E, but we haven’t found any traces of mutated spiders.”

He thought it was a tough battle, but he didn’t expect that they could easily occupy the weapons factory on the company’s campus.
“Captain Xu, I’ve searched the place.
The armoured vehicles in the underground garage are gone, and the spare weapons in the warehouse are gone.”
Xu Bin was a little surprised.
He couldn’t help but look back at Xiao Jing, who was frantically lowering his head to take notes.
He let out a long sigh.
Alright, Xiao Jing was unreliable!
Before coming here, Xu Bin had originally planned to use the armoured vehicles as part of his follow-up plan.
However, this plan was rejected by Chen Yu after he proposed it.
The reason was that they were most likely unable to find the armoured vehicles in the Meteorite Company.
How strange!
How did Chen Yu know about it in advance?
“Captain, we’ve just checked.
There are very few zombies on the Meteorite Company’s campus.
We’ve looked around the three entrances of Areas C, D and E, but we haven’t found any traces of mutated spiders.”

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - Move away
paragraphs: Xu Bin was even more surprised.

According to the internal information provided by the Federation, the next phase of the mission was to deal with the mutated spiders. They had to think of ways to find more high-tier information from the Meteorite Company.
“Have you checked everything thoroughly?”
To deal with the mutated spiders, the federal team had also equipped them with focused flamethrowers and a newly developed special smoke bomb.
The smoke was mixed with a high concentration of insecticides, which could cause large-scale damage to the mutated spider!
“Captain...”
Xu Bin raised his head. “Huh? What else did you find?”

The team members prepared their words and said in a low voice, “Captain, we just tried to explore the first floor of the laboratory building in Area D. It’s very strange that we didn’t find any materials in the building.”
Xu Bin didn’t react for a moment.
“Huh? What do you mean?”
“It’s... Uh, it’s just too clean. There’s nothing in the laboratory building. It feels like someone swept it in advance. Our entire party searched it, but we didn’t find even half a scrap.”
The newly joined Federation soldier had a blank look on his face.
He couldn’t understand it no matter how hard he tried.
How could the player sweep the room so cleanly?
Putting everything else aside, ordinary player wouldn’t even want something like scrap to occupy their backpack.
But..
The inside of the experimental building was clean. There was nothing left.
Xu Bin was also puzzled.
As he was feeling puzzled, the Federation player who was standing guard at the window on the second floor of the factory whistled and gave a hand signal.
He signaled that an armoured vehicle was approaching from afar.
From far, an armoured vehicle passed by the factory and was slowly driving toward the Meteorite Company.
The armoured vehicle was driving very slowly, and there was a huge metal box behind it.
There were pulleys at the bottom of the box.
A group of Dark Knights were carefully escorting the cultivation pod.
Everyone looked at the armoured vehicle.
The armoured vehicle passed by the factory and slowly stopped.
Fang Heng jumped out of the vehicle.
“Hey, what a coincidence!”
Seeing Xu Bin and Xiao Jing, Fang Heng waved to greet them.
“Fang Heng, we just came to Pine City, you...”
Xu Bin looked at the big metal box with a rope at the back of the armoured vehicle.
When he got closer, he realized that it was a super-large cultivation pod.
He had many questions.
For example, how did Fang Heng come to Pine City? Where did the armoured vehicle and cultivation pod behind him come from...
Xu Bin asked with a concerned tone, “Fang Heng, what’s in it?”
“It’s the nemesis.”
What?
Xu Bin was shocked and subconsciously touched the gun in his hand.
“Don’t panic. The anesthetic that Chen Yu provided me is very effective. Now it’s in a dormant state.”
Xu Bin heaved a sigh of relief.
“Fang Heng, where are you going to send it?”
“Of course, to a safer place.” Fang Heng patted Xu Bin’s shoulder with a serious expression.
“Don’t worry. I’ve already made a deal with Chen Yu. I’ll guarantee the safety of your mission...”
In the meditation room.
Every morning, after Mo Yunxiao woke up, he would sit quietly in the meditation room to calm his nerves.
After sitting quietly, he would brew a pot of tea.
It was a beautiful day.
“Come, have some tea.”
“It’s the twelve plutocrats.” Sitting on the other side of the low table was Mo Xiangtian.
He raised his teacup and took a sip.
“They sent an ordinary person to assassinate the direct descendant of the Mo family.”
“Their intentions are very clear. They are warning and provoking us, telling us not to act rashly.”
“Ha, they are arrogant!”
Mo Xiangtian put down his teacup and sneered.
Mo Yunxiao was as calm as ever. He asked, “What did great-grandfather say?”
“Great-grandfather said that we are now a society ruled by law. If we encounter an assassination, of course we have to call the police.”
After saying that, the two of them looked at each other and smiled in tacit understanding.
“Did you hear about what happened at the stadium yesterday?”
“I heard about it. I didn’t expect it to cause such a big commotion.”
“His talent is amazing, right?”
“Yes, just forming a Tier 1 ritual rune can cause such a strange phenomenon. His basic attribute in the game and his compatibility with the Vampire Apocalypse is so high that it has no precedent.”
As he said this, Mo Yunxiao frowned.
“I keep feeling that there are still some secrets hidden in him.”
“Since it’s a secret, let’s not delve too much into it.”
Mo Xiangtian said, “Jiawei is the only direct descendant of the Mo Family in this generation. He has been very mediocre since he was young, but his luck is still pretty
good.”
“Dong Dong Dong...” As they were talking, there was a knock on the door. “Fourth Uncle, you’re inside, right?”
“Please come in.”
Mo Jiawei and Fang Heng walked into the meditation room together.
When he saw Mo Xiangtian in the room, Mo Jiawei’s face instantly fell.
“Hmph! Not enough.”
Mo Xiangtian glanced at Mo Jiawei, snorted lightly, and stood up. “I still have something
to do.”
Mo Jiawei felt bitter in his heart. He thought, “What did I do wrong again?”
It was not until Mo Xiangtian left the meditation room that Mo Jiawei felt relieved.
“Fourth Uncle, something big happened in the stadium yesterday!”
“I’ve never seen so many bats gathered together.”
“I’ve heard about it.”
Mo Yunxiao nodded and poured a cup of tea for the two of them.
“It should be related to the ritual. Fang Heng, you completed the meditation yesterday and completed the ritual in the sea of consciousness, right?”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng nodded.
So fast? He finished the meditation in one day?
Mo Jiawei was stunned when he saw Fang Heng nod.
Then, he felt that it was quite normal.
God was supposed to be like this.
“That’s right. After completing the meditation, the sealed strength was completely released. I think these bats came here to search for your aura.”
came
Mo Jiawei was greatly shocked when he heard this. He turned his head to look at Fang Heng.
Was he the reason why there was such a big commotion in the stadium last night?
“But Fourth Uncle, why didn’t the others have this reaction when they unlocked it?”
“Under normal circumstances, only a very small number of people would have this reaction, and the degree of reaction is very small.”
“This is the first time I’ve seen such a strong reaction.”
“Last night, I checked the relevant information again. I think this may be related to Fang Heng’s special ritual seal.”
“In addition, to be able to attract so many bats over, it seems that Fang Heng’s compatibility with the Vampire Apocalypse game is very high.”
As Mo Yunxiao spoke, he turned to look at Fang Heng

“On the other hand, Fang Heng, your basic attribute in the game must be very high.” “Combining the above three points, it finally triggered the strange phenomenon outside the stadium last night.” Listening to Mo Yunxiao’s explanation, Mo Jiawei seemed to understand, but he only felt that Fang Heng was pretty awesome.
Fang Heng frowned and asked, “Mr Mo, what does compatibility mean?”
“Well, compatibility is a more general term. The higher the compatibility between a player and a game world, the easier it is for the player to adapt to a game world.”

“For example, the probability of you mastering a skill in the Vampire Apocalypse game will be higher, and the experience points of the skill will be easier to obtain. There will be a probability of triggering a higher-level mission, and so on.”
Fang Heng probed, “Then what about my ability? After entering the apocalypse game, will my ability also be improved? For example, my basic attribute?”

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 8 Invitation
paragraphs: “No, it can’t be done. Rituals can only bring strength out of the game. It can’t enhance the strength in the game.”
No!
He had received an attribute increase in the game yesterday!
Moreover, not only in the Vampire Apocalypse, but he could also receive an increase in attributes in the Zombie Apocalypse!
Fang Heng thought to himself.
He realized that Mo Yunxiao didn’t know the function of the soul seal either.
And the soul seal could be a very powerful tool.
For a moment, the three of them fell silent.
After a while, Mo Yunxiao sent an invitation to Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng, are you interested in the Vampire Apocalypse?”
“Huh?” Fang Heng raised his head, his face full of confusion.
“Your ability is very strong, you are very suitable for the Vampire Apocalypse.”
“We’ve been operating in Vampire Apocalypse District 7 for several years, secretly acquiring some gaming companies, and have plans to develop in District 7.”
“We’ve already participated in the main storyline mission, if you can join...”
Fang Heng refused, “I’m sorry, I don’t have any plans to go to other games for the time being.”
“Fang Heng, perhaps you still don’t know what the main storyline means?”
Fang Heng raised his head.
This was also the first time Mo Jiawei had heard of a secret related to a hidden game. He looked extremely interested.
“Fourth Uncle, what else do you have to say about the main storyline mission?”

“It’s under the control of the King of Gods. I can only say that the main storyline means ‘belonging’. Completing the main storyline mission and obtaining the highest score is equivalent to us obtaining the right to belong to this world.”
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted.

“With your help, I have the confidence to complete the main storyline mission within a year. When that time comes, we will divide and conquer District 7 of the Vampire Apocalypse together. What do you think?”.
Faced with Mo Yunxiao’s temptation, Fang Heng shook his head.
“I am indeed a little interested, but for the time being, I don’t have the time. Thank you for your invitation, I will seriously consider
it.”
Main storyline mission?
The world of the Zombie Apocalypse game also had main storyline missions!
Moreover, Fang Heng was sure that he played a major role in the main storyline mission!
All this while, Fang Heng didn’t understand why the Federation was so obsessed with the main storyline mission.
So there was a saying that the world ultimately belonged to someone.
Although he wasn’t quite sure what it meant, Fang Heng guessed that it was probably something like control.
He had to get the main storyline mission of the Zombie Apocalypse from Server 8!
He had no reason to leave Server 8, which he had almost completed half of the main storyline mission, and go to the Vampire Apocalypse to play a part in it.
However...

If things went too smoothly and he accidentally completed the main storyline mission of the Zombie Apocalypse in a short period, he might consider going there to play. Mo Yunxiao didn’t mind Fang Heng’s rejection.
“It doesn’t matter. I still need some time to look for information related to your ritual. If you change your mind, you can come to find me anytime.”
Five days later.
On the main road leading to the prison, a small transportation car was slowly moving forward.
Around them, a few motorcycles were accompanying them to protect them. Chen Yu was currently sitting in the driver’s seat, his expression slightly solemn.
A lot of things had happened in the past few days.
The various actions of the anti-federation forces targeting District 8 had already aroused the vigilance of the Federation’s higher-ups.
For this reason, the Federation had established a special investigation team for District 8.
Because of Chen Yu’s recent outstanding performance in the game, he was temporarily transferred to the Federation’s task team.
This was the latest news from the task team.
During this period, the Federation had been actively nurturing a great engineer, Liu Jungong, and trying to build a good relationship with him. He died unexpectedly during the Blood Moon.
It was confirmed that this incident was the work of the anti-federal organization, Night Owl.
A top-notch great engineer!
There were only four people on each server, and they would randomly appear all over the world.
The recruitment requirements were very harsh.
Generally speaking, only four to five months after the opening of the server would there be a chance to complete the recruitment mission.
The Federation had spent a lot of resources just to build a good relationship with Liu Jungong in the early stages.
His death had a great impact on the Federation.
In addition, the second search operation into Pine City had also failed.
Xu Bin and his group, who had been sent out to carry out the mission, searched the Meteorite Company’s base in Pine City.
However, they found that the entire base had been cleaned up a long time ago!
They didn’t even find any trash, let alone items related to the mission!
“It has been confirmed that Fang Heng can control zombies. The estimated number of zombies can reach 100.”
“He has a close relationship with the Dark Knights. His military rank has been raised to ‘Captain’, and I suspect that he can control higher-level Licker...”
In the front passenger seat, a young man wearing thick glasses was looking through the information that had been imported from outside the game not long ago.
“He used to be a professional player. Because he was involved in some criminal incidents, he left the game guild. After that, he lived alone in Server 7 of the Zombie Apocalypse...”
“Recently, he has been in close contact with North River Heavy Industry.”
Zhang Zhe closed the file and turned to look at Chen Yu. “Are you familiar with him?”

“I’ve met him a few times, and I feel that Fang Heng is pretty good. He’s also very cooperative with our work. Previously, he helped us with the main storyline mission in Pine City as well as the Blood Moon Project.”
“Yeah.”
Zhang Zhe nodded.
He originally belonged to District 2 and had participated in related main storyline missions before.
Unfortunately, the main storyline mission for Server 2 had already been declared a failure.
Due to the recent series of emergencies that happened in Server 8, which had attracted the attention of the Federation’s upper echelons, he had been transferred here to provide support.
For this, he had paid a huge price. All his levels, skills and points had been cleared to zero.
Chen Yu pondered for a moment and asked, “Are you suspecting that the changes in the main storyline mission are related to Fang Heng?”
Zhang Zhe had black circles around his eyes. He had stayed up the past two days to read quite a bit of information.

“Judging from the information and your description, Fang Heng is currently the player who has the deepest contact with the main storyline mission. If the Dark Knights’ next main storyline mission is triggered, he will definitely be the first to be notified.”
Chen Yu nodded in agreement.
“That’s true. Do you think he is hiding something from us?”
“It’s a matter of interest. It’s human nature for him not to mention the main storyline mission. It’s understandable.”
The car took a turn and slowly drove into a side road.
Looking at the scenery outside the window, Chen Yu frowned.
What was going on? It had only been a few days? How did it change so drastically?
Chen Yu’s heart skipped a beat.
He rubbed his eyes and wondered if he had gone the wrong way.
Chen Yu lowered his head and turned on his survival radio again. He looked at where he
was.
Zhang Zhe was puzzled and asked, “What’s wrong?”
“This used to be a forest area.”
Chen Yu said with a bitter smile. “Huh?”
Zhang Zhe also looked out of the window when he heard that.
Forest area?
This endless prairie and small mounds...
Are you sure it’s not a plain area?
The car slowly drove toward the prison.
The more they drove forward, the more shocked Chen Yu was.
What on earth did Fang Heng do?
It was clearly a forest before the last Blood Moon!

Do you think he is hiding something from us?”
“It’s a matter of interest.
It’s human nature for him not to mention the main storyline mission.
It’s understandable.”
The car took a turn and slowly drove into a side road.
Looking at the scenery outside the window, Chen Yu frowned.
What was going on?
It had only been a few days?
How did it change so drastically?
Chen Yu’s heart skipped a beat.
He rubbed his eyes and wondered if he had gone the wrong way.
Chen Yu lowered his head and turned on his survival radio again.
He looked at where he
was.
Zhang Zhe was puzzled and asked, “What’s wrong?”
“This used to be a forest area.”
Chen Yu said with a bitter smile.
“Huh?”
Zhang Zhe also looked out of the window when he heard that.
Forest area?
This endless prairie and small mounds...
Are you sure it’s not a plain area?
The car slowly drove toward the prison.
The more they drove forward, the more shocked Chen Yu was.
What on earth did Fang Heng do?
It was clearly a forest before the last Blood Moon!

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - Development and Expansion
paragraphs: There were also changes to the roads here.
The last time he came here, it was a bumpy journey and he was very tired at the end.
But now, the roads had been widened by many times, and they had been renovated with stone pavements.
This was a tool that could only be made with a high-tier cement mixer...
At this time, ordinary players were still thinking of ways to strengthen the shelter and find a way to fill their stomachs.
He was so free? And so rich?
He had already started to build roads?
Chen Yu was a little taken aback.
Gradually, the outline of a prison appeared on the horizon.
Zhang Zhe poked his head out of the car window and looked outside.
Several players were carrying logs and stones toward the prison.
“Are these players taking refuge in the prison?”

“Yeah, you’ve seen the posts on the Internet, right? They say that they’re paying for their work. The prison has recruited several players to work in the prison to ensure that they can successfully survive this Blood Moon.”
“There are also entrance tickets that are sold separately. They’ve already sold for 50,000 yuan per ticket.”
“What about them?”
Zhang Zhe pointed at a team of fully armed players blocking the road ahead.
“Eh? It’s the Blackthorn mercenary group?”
Chen Yu slowed down the car and stuck his head out of the window.
Black Tiger, the commander of Team 7 of the Blackthorn mercenary group, recognized Chen Yu.
“Chen Yu, it’s you. Are you looking for Boss Fang Heng?”
“Uh, yes, why are you here?”

“It’s because I accepted the prison’s request. For the time being, our Blackthorn mercenary group will be responsible for the security and patrolling around the prison, protecting the players in the prison when they are collecting stones and wood.”

Black Tiger gave a rough explanation and gestured for the player team at the back to let them pass. “I’ll go with you guys. The boss has also recruited a few other mercenary groups. Many of them don’t know you guys, so with me around, it won’t be troublesome.”
“Thank you.”
Chen Yu smiled bitterly and opened the car door.
D*mn it, Fang Heng had achieved something big.
He had become so rich from selling entrance tickets that he even started to recruit advanced player mercenary groups as helpers.
Soon, the car entered the prison area.
The guards of the Dark Knights on the sentry towers saw Chen Yu and the others at a glance and waved for them to stop.
Chen Yu parked the truck at the side and walked out.
It had been a few days since the moat had been built!
Chen Yu could not help but sigh.

The last time he came here, he had relied on the barbed wire defense structure at the periphery. Now, the prison area had expanded by more than 100 meters. The new moat and city walls had also been built.
In addition, there were two more large ancillary buildings outside the prison.
Zhang Zhe narrowed his eyes and asked, “What is that place?”
“It’s a temporary shelter. Fang Heng doesn’t want too many random people to enter the prison.”

“Other than the players who participated in the Blood Moon Project and the players who bought the VIP tickets, everyone else will live outside and wait for the Blood Moon before entering the prison together.”
VIP tickets?
Chen Yu was stunned.
It was a set-up.
The wooden bridge over the moat descended, and three trucks filled with mining materials drove from the outside, slowly entering the prison.
Chen Yu stared at these trucks in a daze.
He felt that these trucks looked a little familiar.
Weren’t these what Fang Heng wanted from the Federation?
At that time, Chen Yu thought it was strange. He wondered why Fang Heng wanted so many military trucks at that time.
Did he use them?
But where did he get so many ore resources?

Fang Heng enjoyed this feeling very much.
He reinforced the shelter a few times, expanded the warehouse as well, and then filled them up again and again!
All the spare materials were transported to the shelter.
During this time, after completing the construction of the emergency exits in the quarantine zone, he devoted himself to the development of the prison.
In five days, this was the second time he expanded the shelter.
Every time he expanded, he filled it up!
Victor was in charge of building a special storage room in the basement of prison Building No. 2. It was used to store resources such as ores, wooden planks, iron nuggets and other materials.
A large-scale workshop was newly opened in the basement and more than 300 furnaces operated 24 hours a day.
The basement was not easy to ventilate and the entire hall was extremely hot.
Ordinary players would not be able to stand it!
But it didn’t matter, the zombie clone was not afraid of the heat!
Hack 24 hours a day!
Fang Heng calculated in his heart.
At this speed, when the next batch of iron nuggets was produced, the next expansion was expected to take another five or six days!
More than half of the forest area had been mined by zombies, and the top-level wooden planks had already piled up in three warehouses.
He had to wait for Victor to build another two more.
Hmm... they found a copper mine?
It was good stuff. Copper could be used to make high-level electronic components and it could also be used to make ammunition.
There was another benefit after establishing a teleportation passage in the shelter.
He could go to any teleportation point of the Dark Knights through the space tear anytime and anywhere.
The efficiency of travelling was greatly improved!

Fang Heng used teleportation points to teleport back and forth. He and Mo Jiawei spent a few days swiping away half of the apocalypse camps in the game world, and he only managed to collect more than 300 furnaces.

Considering that the space tearing device used special energy crystals which were relatively rare, the remaining energy could last for about two days, so Fang Heng chose to temporarily close the teleportation passage.
“Yes, I’ll have the Blackthorn mercenary group scout the newly discovered mine.” The abandoned iron ore that they had found was almost finished, so they needed to find a new mine...

The warehouse of Apocalypse Camp 23 was also full, and they had stopped purchasing resources from the outside world. In the afternoon, they asked Mo Jiawei to bring a few cars over to empty the high-grade goods sold there...

chapters.title: Chapter 260 Visit
paragraphs: Survival points were used as currency in the apocalypse camp. They were very affordable.
It was worthwhile buying them!
Fang Heng was very busy, but he was also very excited.
Just as he was thinking about the overall situation, the old steward knocked on the door.
"Mr Fang Heng, Mr Chen Yu from the Federation and his friends are here to visit."
"Chen Yu..."
Fang Heng had heard from Mo Jiawei that Chen Yu had been troubled by the anti-federal organization recently.
This guy had been quite busy recently but to pay a visit personally...
Could it be that the anti-federation forces had made some new moves?
"Okay, take him to the reception room. I'll be back soon."
In the reception room.
Chen Yu put a piece of Tiramisu cheesecake in his mouth.
"Zhang Zhe, you should try it too. The culinary skills of the prison shelter are definitely at Level 20. The taste is amazing."
Fang Heng pushed the door open and entered. "If it's good, then bring some back."
"Ha, Fang Heng, how can I do that?"
Chen Yu scratched his head in embarrassment.
"Then I won't stand on ceremony."
At this stage, the various resource points in the Federation had been fully developed. The resources of the various resource points were almost enough.
They definitely wouldn't go hungry, but it was still impossible for Fang Heng to recruit an NPC chef to be in charge of three meals a day and desserts.
Chen Yood up and introduced Fang Heng.
"Fang Heng, this is Zhang Zhe, the head of the Special Investigation Team for the Night Owl Incident."
Fang Heng looked at Chen Yu with a puzzled gaze.
"Night Owl?"
"Yes, a series of events have happened in the game since the start of Server 8."
"Now we can confirm that this series of events are closely related to the Night Owl organization."

"Especially these days, the members of Night Owl have been very active in the other game servers. The higher-ups gathered information from various sources, suspecting that Night Owl is intending to make another big move shortly."
"The higher-ups decided to set up a Special Investigation Team, which will be responsible for investigating Night Owl and the main storyline mission in the current server."
Fang Heng tried to recall from his memory.
He had indeed never heard of the name Night Owl.
Speaking of which, could the employer behind Old Black be Night Owl?
"I've heard a lot about you, Fang Heng."
Zhang Zhe looked at Fang Heng with a scrutinizing gaze and nodded at him.
"Your shelter is great."
"I'm here this time to understand the main storyline mission related to the Dark Knights.
Fang Heng was somewhat disgusted by Zhang Zhe's scrutinizing gaze.
He pouted his lips.
As expected, the main storyline mission!
He had already learned the importance of the main storyline mission from Mo Yunxiao.
Night Owl had caused so much trouble in the game, and most of it was to delay the progress of the Federation's main storyline mission. They had even made moves to destroy the main storyline mission.
It seemed that Night Owl was the same as the Federation. They were both interested in the main storyline mission.
In other words, they were all competitors!
Zhang Zhe said, "We hope that we can cooperate with you to complete the main storyline mission together."
Cooperate?
Fang Heng's impression of Zhang Zhe became even worse.
He thought to himself, "Do you think that I don't know anything and you can get something from me for free? If we cooperate, who will be the final owner of the main storyline mission?"
At this stage, his main storyline mission was undoubtedly the most important.
The mission for the next stage was also in his hands. The safest way was to complete it alone.
If they were to cooperate and complete it...
The best would be for the Federation and Night Owl to fight among themselves. He would take the opportunity to secretly develop and complete the mission silently in the background to get the reward.
A perfect plan!
Yes! Let's pretend to cooperate first!
Fang Heng nodded and said, "Yes, I will consider the cooperation aspect."
"However, ever since I came back from Pine City, I haven't received any missions related to the Dark Knights."
Fang Heng did not lie about this.
It had been quite some time since he had handed over the secret documents related to the primogenitor virus to the Dark Knights.
He was anticipating some news from the Dark Knights soon.
Zhang Zhe asked, "What about the others? There's no other news?"
Fang Heng shook his head, "I'm not very familiar with the Dark Knights. I haven't been in contact with them recently."
"That's troublesome. The next main storyline mission hasn't been triggered. The situation in Pine City is also very strange."
Chen Yu did not doubt Fang Heng's words at all. He sighed and was deeply worried.
"We are most worried that the Night Owl organization might have done something in the dark that affected the triggering of the follow-up mission."
Seeing that he could not get any useful information from Fang Heng, Zhang Zhe stood up.
"Fang Heng, then I won't bother you anymore. If there is any news, contact me anytime."
"Alright, I'll send you off."
Fang Heng stood up and sent the two of them out of the reception room.
Fang Heng was stunned for a moment when he pushed open the door of the room and stepped into the pathway.
At the end of the pathway, Mo Jiawei was preparing to go upstairs with a group of people at the corner.
Mo Jiawei's face froze when he saw Fang Heng.
"Fang Heng?"
Then, Fang Heng heard a familiar voice.
There was a tinge of surprise in the voice.
Lucia walked out from behind Mo Jiawei and the others. She walked quickly to Fang Heng and gave him a warm hug.
Fang Heng did not expect Lucia to come so suddenly.
"I came back to look for you as soon as I was done."
Lucia winked at Fang Heng and moved aside. "Fang Heng, let me introduce you. This is the founder of the Dark Knights, Russell Blind."
Russell!
Fang Heng was stunned and looked behind Lucia.
"Hello, Fang Heng. The Dark Knights are honoured to have young people like you."
The final BOSS of the Dark Knights! Russell!
He was not strong, but his reputation was well-known.
He came to Fang Heng's shelter in person!
Behind Fang Heng, Chen Yu and Zhang Zhe were shocked and quieted down at the same time.
Even Russell had come personally...
Chen Yu wanted to ask Fang Heng, "Are you sure that you're not familiar with the members of the Dark Knights?"
"Thank you for everything you've done to save this world."
Russell was a white-haired old man, but he was in good spirits.
Mo Jiawei thought to himself that he was unlucky.
Russell's group had been directly teleported over through the space tearing device, and they had arrived in a hurry.
He had heard that Fang Heng was meeting with people from the Federation. From the start, he had planned to bring Russell to the living room on the second floor to wait.
He hadn't expected to run into Fang Heng, who had just left the meeting room.
Fang Heng pointed at the meeting room. "Teacher Russell, let's go in and talk."
"There's no need, Fang Heng. Time is tight, and the helicopter is already in position. We'll set off for Paradise Island in four hours."
Paradise Island? What kind of place was that?
Fang Heng looked at Mo Jiawei, who was also confused.
"Four hours later? Why is it so urgent?"
"This is important, Fang Heng."
"Seven hours ago, our research team cracked part of the encrypted data we got from Pine City."
