chapters.title: Chapter 261 Paradise Island
paragraphs: "Based on the comprehensive analysis of the data, apart from the information about the primogenitor virus, we also obtained some information about the origin of the primogenitor virus."
"We learned that the primogenitor virus was originally extracted from a meteorite."
"A university research team discovered the uniqueness of the meteorite. They conducted further research on the meteorite and tried to develop a drug to treat cancer through the meteorite."
"After that, a consortium called Valles bought the university's laboratory and renamed it the Meteorite Company."
"Three years ago, to carry out special research, the Meteorite Company bought a large island overseas. They placed the meteorite in the laboratory on the island and sent people to guard it."
"This research project is led by the chief researcher of the company, Dr Kevin."
"Before the Zombie Apocalypse, Dr Kevin had been staying on this island."
"This island is the Paradise Island that we are going to."
Lucia was excited. She added, "Fang Heng, as long as we can find the meteorite on Paradise Island, we will be able to develop an antidote to the zombie virus and completely save this world!"
The next moment, a game hint flashed across Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei's eyes.
[Hint: Player has triggered the 14th ring main storyline mission-Paradise island (team).]
Mission name: Paradise Island.
Mission description: You have received information about the first-generation meteorite on Paradise Island. The Dark Knights have invited you to go to Paradise Island together.
Mission difficulty: C.
Mission requirements: Try to follow the Dark Knights into Paradise Island and look for information related to the first-generation meteorite.
[Hint: Player's basic physique attribute recommended in the follow-up mission: 10.]
"After receiving the news, we used the positioning system to find the specific location of Paradise Island. We immediately sent people to investigate."
"This is Alto. We found him on the island. He is a native of the island."
A tall and thin black-skinned young man stood out from behind the Dark Knights.
"Please help us. Please take my parents and friends away from that d*mn place! Paradise Island is no longer the Paradise Island of the past. If we continue to stay there, we will all die."
Fang Heng was confused. "Your parents and friends?"
Lucia continued to explain, "Paradise Island is surrounded by the sea. They were lucky enough to avoid the madness during the early days of the Zombie Apocalypse."

"In addition to the protection of the former Meteorite Company, the islanders and the Meteorite Company quickly set up defense lines on the island. Until now, they have not been affected by the zombie horde."
Fang Heng's eyes lit up.
What did she say?
An overseas island that was not attacked by zombies?
Did it mean that...
That there were many survivors there?
Were there any researchers?
Could they be brought back to the shelter?
"Time is of the essence. We'll discuss more details on the helicopter later."
Russell said, "Colonel Fang Heng, Colonel Barker is currently carrying out another mission. Lucia and David recommended you to me at the same time."

"May I ask if you are willing to take on the responsibility of commanding and leading the team to carry out this mission to Paradise Island to carry out an exploratory mission and retrieve the crucial first-generation meteorite?"
[Hint: Russell hopes that you can be the commander of this operation. If you agree, you will obtain the authority to control this team's operation.]
Main storyline mission! There was no reason to refuse the offer!
Fang Heng immediately nodded and said, "Of course, I will do my best."
"You did not disappoint me, Fang Heng."

Russell nodded in gratification. "We need to make some preparations first. We will meet up at the teleportation point in four hours and head to Paradise Island together. If there is anything you need, you can tell David. The Dark Knights will fully cooperate with this operation..."

[Hint: You have accepted the position of team commander. You have gained the authority to control this team. You can share this mission with other players. Each player will calculate the number of ring missions independently.]
Listening to everyone's conversation, Chen Yu's heart pounded.
He frantically winked at Zhang Zhe.
This was their chance!
If they wanted to get involved with the main storyline mission, they had to think of a way to join the Dark Knights!
Apart from that, the favorability rating and honor level of the Dark Knights had to reach a certain level.
The two of them had not even entered the Dark Knights, so they could forget about participating in the mission!
But now that Fang Heng had become the commander of the operation, adding two more people was not a problem at all!
Zhang Zhe also frowned deeply.
The primogenitor virus!
The first-generation meteorite!
He did not expect Fang Heng to have pushed the main storyline mission to the mid and late-stage!
Moreover, his honor level in the Dark Knights had already reached the colonel level! He had even been invited to become the commander of this mission!

Zhang Zhe also knew that this was the best opportunity for them to join the mission. He could not help but interrupt, "I'm very sorry, Mr Russell. Can you allow me to have a simple chat with Fang Heng?"
"Time is very tight. Fang Heng, I'll wait for you in the lounge."
After the Dark Knights left, Zhang Zhe looked at Fang Heng and said, "Fang Heng, I represent the Federation and wish to enter into a deeper level of cooperation with you."
Fang Heng glanced at Mo Jiawei.
Mo Jiawei smiled bitterly in return.
He felt bitter in his heart.
He had always been wary of the people from the Federation.
Who would have thought that he would meet them?
Fang Heng thought for a moment and asked, "How do you want to cooperate?"

"I've participated in Server 2's main storyline mission before. Each server's storyline may be different, but some things are the same. For example, the primogenitor virus, or the first-generation meteorite. I can provide you with information during the mission."
Fang Heng pondered carefully.
He thought, "Isn't this like free-riding from me? Do I need this bit of information from you?"
Fang Heng smiled gently and said, "But, I seem to be able to complete this mission without your help."
Zhang Zhe's expression froze.
"The reward for the main storyline mission is very good. I don't want to split it equally. You would be able to understand, right?"
Zhang Zhe came back to his senses and laughed in his heart.
He laughed at Fang Heng's overestimation of himself.
How could the main storyline mission be so simple?
There were so many servers in the apocalypse game. Relying on the strength of the entire Federation, he only managed to obtain two of the servers that belonged to the main storyline!
Did Fang Heng want to complete the main storyline alone?
He was like a frog at the bottom of a well, wishful thinking!
Chen Yu did not have so many twists and turns in his heart. He was anxious as he tried to persuade Fang Heng.

"Fang Heng, one of the anti-federal organization's forces, the Night Owl organization, has been infiltrating the main storyline mission. We need to ensure that the main storyline mission does not fall into the hands of the anti-federal organization."
"Only by working together can we ensure the safety of the main storyline mission to the greatest extent. We don't want the mission reward."
Fang Heng thought that what Chen Yu said made sense.
Old Black's intelligence level was much higher than the Federation's. They might have played some dirty tricks in the main storyline mission.
However, it would be a bit disadvantageous for the Federation to directly participate in the main storyline mission.
He had worked with Chen Yu many times and believed that Chen Yu would not trick him. However, it was not necessarily the case for the Federation's superiors.
For example, this Zhang Zhe had come out of nowhere.
"Alright, I agree to your joining the team."
Fang Heng smiled and added, "However, I need some compensation."

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - Islanders
paragraphs: Zhang Zhe didn’t have much of a good impression of Fang Heng as well.
He secretly despised Fang Heng’s greed.
“How much do you want?”
“A ticket to the main storyline mission. How much do you think I can sell it for if it’s made public?”

Zhang Zhe gritted his teeth, “We need two tickets to participate in the mission. In exchange, we can provide you with some mission-related information and also provide the prison with a batch of materials worth 500 King of Gods’ points as compensation.”
“If you had said that, then I would have agreed to it long ago!” Fang Heng thought to himself and did some mental calculations.
With the Federation joining, there were pros and cons.
No matter what, materials worth 500 King of Gods’ points were still tempting.
“Alright, welcome to the team. Now, you can tell me the information related to this mission.”
“Due to the uniqueness of the main storyline mission, it is inconvenient for me to reveal the details of the mission to you.”
Zhang Zhe adjusted his state of mind and secretly suppressed the displeasure in his heart.
“The first-generation meteorite will release extremely strong radiation. The lower the player’s physique attribute, the greater the impact of the radiation.”
“Before we head to Paradise Island, we need to find as many tools as possible to increase the basic physique attribute.”
“Our Federation has a short-term muscle enhancement potion. We’ll provide one to the two of you later.”
Zhang Zhe looked at the time and frowned. “I still have to go back and get it. Four hours is a bit tight...”
“It’s okay. I have a space-tearing device here Four hours is enough. In addition, I also have a medicine that can improve my physique in a short time, but the negative effects are a bit strong.”
Zhang Zhe was shocked.
Space-tearing device?!
His shelter could already build such a high-level device?
That was true.
The construction blueprint was obtained through the Dark Knights. According to Fang Heng’s honor level in the Dark Knights, he could indeed get access to it.
Fang Heng stroked his chin and continued to ask, “You have experienced the main storyline mission in District 2. What is the overall mission difficulty this time? How is it compared to Pine City?”
Zhang Zhe came back to his senses and replied, “In theory, the overall mission difficulty is comparable to the mission difficulty of entering Pine City twice.”
“But now the mission has been greatly affected. The second lasso mission in Pine City has already been changed, so I can’t be sure of the subsequent difficulty.”
Fang Heng frowned. The final mission of Pine City was to face a Tier 5 mutated creature.
If the difficulty was the same...
He still had to bring some equipment.
To be safe, Fang Heng ordered the Lickers to commit suicide.
After the player reached Level 17, the resurrection time of the zombie team was 8.6 hours.
After calculating the time, they should be able to resurrect when they reached Paradise Island.
Paradise Island.
After nearly three hours of flying, the helicopter circled high above an island.
Fang Heng went offline to sleep and recharge before going online.
He looked down at the island from high above.
“After the apocalypse, Paradise Island became our sanctuary.”
The islander, Aalto, introduced the situation of Paradise Island to everyone.

“It was Dr Kevin who saved everyone. Dr Kevin gave everyone the Water of Life. People living on the island will use it to resist the invasion of the virus and prevent infection by the biochemical virus.”
What was the Water of Life? It could resist infection?
Fang Heng was puzzled. He looked at Lucia and asked, “Did you have any contact with Dr Kevin the last time you went?”
Lucia shook her head.
“Dr Kevin, he...”
Aalto took a deep breath and continued, “He has been missing for more than half a year.”
Fang Heng was stunned and began to think.
Missing for more than half a year?
Paradise Island was only a small place. How could he be missing?
Could he be dead?
The helicopter circled a few times in the high sky before landing in a space in the middle of the island’s village.
Many islanders gathered in twos and threes, pointing at the helicopter.
“Don’t mind it. Most of the islanders have lived here since they were young and rarely come into contact with others. They’re just a little curious.”
“Our island has a safe underground water supply and a large area of land suitable for farming. Before the Meteorite Company came here, we could also be self-sufficient.”
“After the Meteorite Company bought the ownership of this island, they didn’t chase us, islanders, away. Every month, they would send us some special ingredients from the outside world.”
Aalto waved to the surrounding islanders.

“Friends, these are all partners of the Dark Knights! They are here to help us. Let’s go back first. If everything goes well, we will be able to evacuate from here very quickly and go to a safe place.”
The surrounding islanders then left one after another.
A few members of the Dark Knights began to move the combat materials down from the helicopter.
Chen Yu and the others looked around after getting off the helicopter, familiarizing themselves with the environment.
Fang Heng noticed a very useful detail. He raised his head and asked, “Have the islanders been farming here for generations?”
Aalto was stunned by Fang Heng’s question.
“Yes, Paradise Island has beautiful scenery. The land is very suitable for farming. This is how the island got its name, ‘Paradise Island’.”
Fang Heng secretly pondered.
Farming was good!
This group of islanders didn’t seem to have such a high level of education. It was probably impossible for them to help Qiu Yaokang research zombies. But they knew how to farm!
People could only work when they were full. This was a principle that had never changed since ancient times.
In the future, when the shelter developed, the amount of food consumed would increase. They couldn’t just rely on the zombies to go out and collect it.
They had to be self-sufficient to achieve a virtuous cycle.
Coincidentally, after the felling of the forest near the prison was completed, there was still a large piece of empty land left.
Keeping it was one thing, but wouldn’t it be good if they could make use of the land for farming?
Well, he might as well gather all these islanders and bring them all back to the shelter...
“I’ll take you to see the Water of Life first.”
Aalto didn’t know what Fang Heng was thinking, so he led Fang Heng and the others to the centre of the village.
He continued to introduce the situation on the island.
“After the outbreak of the zombie virus, the people on the island worked together to set up a barbed wire around the periphery of the island.”
“Every morning, people would patrol the coast to clean up the zombies that drifted along the ocean and check whether the barbed wire was damaged.”
“The Water of Life made by Dr Kevin is very effective. If we are accidentally attacked by zombies, we can detoxify the poison with the Water of Life.”
Aalto led the group to a wooden house.
There were villagers armed with guns outside the wooden house.
Aalto called out to the villagers, “I’ll bring them in to have a look.”
The group walked into the wooden house.
There were large vats of water in the wooden house.
“Water of Life... Antidote...”
Fang Heng walked to one of the vats, took out a bottle from his backpack and tried to fill it.
“Hint: You have obtained an item-Water of Life.”
[Item-Water of Life*1.]

Description: Increases basic physique by 3 points within 20 minutes after use, increases anti-infection ability. After using it, it can dispel the zombie virus infection state (only effective against elementary and intermediate infection).

chapters.title: Chapter 263 Monsters
paragraphs: Mo Jiawei and Chen Yu followed suit and scooped out a bottle of water from the vat.
"Anti-infection potion?"
After receiving the game hint, Mo Jiawei's eyes lit up!
This was a good item that could only be obtained in the later stages of the Zombie Apocalypse game.
It was hard to imagine that the zombie virus antidote, which was hard to buy outside, could be obtained so easily from all these vats.
There were more than 20 vats left in the room.
No matter how one looked at it, it looked like it could be mass-produced.
If they could get the formula and sell it...
They would be rich!
Fang Heng had the same idea.
If he were to bring all the islanders back to his shelter, of course, he had to take the Water of Life together as well.
However, the water vat would have an extra weight-bearing penalty when it was placed into a backpack, so it was not very convenient to transport it around.
It was also very troublesome to transport the islanders batch by batch at one time.
How about...
He could directly build a teleportation passage here?
Eh?
On second thought, setting this place as the third base seemed to be a good idea?

The island was located in the middle of the sea, so it would not be attacked by the outside world. The setting of the defense net was also relatively simple, so it was fine to build it along the coast...
The land here was suitable for farming, so he could stay here to farm...
Fang Heng raised his head and exchanged a look with Mo Jiawei.
They both saw the excitement on each other's faces.
They had the same thought!
Zhang Zhe turned to look at Aalto and asked, "How did Dr Kevin go missing? Can you tell us in detail?"
"Well, Dr Kevin is a friendly person who has given us islanders a lot of help. In the past, he spent most of his time in the cave doing research."
"Then one day, Dr Kevin entered the cave and never came out again. No one knew what happened in the cave."
Chen Yu frowned. "Cave? Didn't you send someone to look for him?"
"Yes, the laboratory was built in a cave on the island. After the accident, we tried to look for Dr Kevin, but we failed."

"We've analyzed it. It should be the strong radiation produced by the first-generation meteorite.

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - The Cave
paragraphs: Dr Kevin’s cave laboratory’s entrance was built on the edge of a cliff.
A few outposts were also built on the periphery.
The team of Dark Knights arrived at the edge of the cave entrance and began to organize their equipment.
Everyone was ready to put on the radiation-protective suit and enter the cave to investigate.
“Hello, I’m Zhang Yan, the captain of Paradise Island’s security team. I’ve been waiting for you for a long time.”
The captain of the mercenary team, Zhang Yan, led an NPC team over and shook hands with Fang Heng and the others.
“In the past, I was hired by the Meteorite Company to protect Dr Kevin’s laboratory. Now, we only work for ourselves.” “Can you tell us about the situation in the cave?”
Zhang Yan nodded.
“About three months ago, we received news that two islanders went missing on the island.”
“We immediately set up a search team to search the island.”
“At first, we didn’t connect the disappearance to the cave.”
“The day after the islanders disappeared, the two soldiers guarding the cave went missing one after another.”
“That night, I strengthened my patrol.”
“At night, the soldiers found monsters during their patrol and sounded the alarm.”
Chen Yu asked, “Aren’t they zombies?”
“I’m not sure if they are mutated zombies. They move very fast. Maybe they were startled by the sound of firearms and started to flee.”
“We chased them until we saw them hiding in Dr Kevin’s cave laboratory.”
Hearing that, everyone fell into a short silence.
“After that, we set up a 24-hour alert at the entrance and tried to seal the entire cave, but the effect was not good. Besides this cave entrance, there are other exits that we haven’t found yet.”
Lucia suggested, “Do you want to go in with us? We’ve prepared a few more protective suits.”
“No, we’ve never entered the cave even when Dr Kevin was here. We can’t help you.”
Zhang Yan signalled to the combat team behind him with his eyes. “We’ll meet you outside.”
“Okay.”
Lucia did not force them. She signalled to the three Dark Knights to wait for orders.
“Let’s begin.”
Fang Heng took a syringe from Zhang Zhe.
[Item: 7 active proteinase injection.]
Description: Increases 4.5 basic physique within 5 hours after injection.
Good stuff!
Fang Heng directly stabbed a needle into his arm. Then, he took out a few bottles of potions from his backpack and distributed them to everyone.
These potions were defective products that Qiu Yaokang had accidentally developed when he was developing enhanced gene potions.
“Come, this is the potion developed by our prison.”
[Item: Failed temporary enhanced physique gene potions.]
Description: Increases 5 points of basic physique within 3 hours after consumption, reduces 5 points of strength and 5 points of agility (the lowest attribute value will be 3 points).
This attribute... was a bit of a letdown.
Everyone took the potion and looked at it, then they gulped all of it.
After putting on the protective suit, Fang Heng tried to move his body on the spot.
The heavy protective suit made it difficult for him to move.
Seeing that the others were still putting on their equipment, Fang Heng walked to Zhang Yan’s side and handed him a bag of Oreo cookies.
“Brother, it’s not a long-term plan for me to stay on this island. If the islanders find a new shelter in the future, do you all still plan to stay on the island?”.
Zhang Yan frowned and thought for a moment.
“Since the beginning of the apocalypse, the food that we have on the island has been consumed very quickly. We can only survive by relying on the food provided by the islanders.”
“In return, we will always protect these islanders until they find a safe place.”
There was a chance!
Pack them together and take all of them away!
Hearing what Zhang Yan said, Fang Heng felt that he had a good chance of accomplishing his mission.
“My shelter is willing to accept these islanders. If possible, after eliminating the danger in the cave, I will think of ways to provide them with more food and resources to build the island.”
Zhang Yan looked at Fang Heng in surprise.
“My shelter needs some experienced mercenary. I believe these islanders also need you. I hope you can stay here and join my shelter.”
“If you really can do it, I will consider it.”
While they were talking, Lucia and the others had finished their preparations.
“Let’s go.”
Fang Heng and Lucia led the team to the front and explored the cave.
When they stepped into the cave, a row of messages immediately flashed through Fang Heng’s vision.
(Hint: You have entered a special area. Affected by special radiation, your HP will continue to decrease. When the radiation value accumulates to a certain extent, you will enter a fainted state.]

(Hint: Your current basic physique attribute is greater than 40, immune to 90% of the radiation effect. The protective suit you are wearing will resist 50% of the radiation effect. Currently affected by 5% of the radiation effect.]
Fang Heng quickly glanced at the hint.
“The radiation here is very strong. We have to speed up.”
Without the map of the passage inside the cave, everyone could only rely on their senses and rely on the flashlight to illuminate their way forward.
“There.”
Following the traces of manual excavation, the group advanced towards the passage on the right.
After turning around and advancing for about 100 to 200 meters, an iron door on the left wall blocked their way.
Fang Heng was too lazy to waste time. He directly switched to a shotgun and aimed at the lock and pressed the trigger. “Bang!”
With a loud sound, the lock was destroyed by a shotgun.
Fang Heng kicked open the iron door and stepped into the room.
It was pitch black.
Everyone shone their flashlights into the room.
The first thing Fang Heng saw was a few control machines in the corner.
“Look! What’s that?”
Mo Jiawei saw something and shouted a warning.
Fang Heng immediately turned his head.
“Whoosh!”
A black shadow flashed in front of Fang Heng’s eyes.
Through his night vision ability, Fang Heng could clearly see what that thing looked like.
It had four limbs and a body similar to a human’s, but its entire body was dark brown and it clung tightly to the high rock wall.
It didn’t look like an ordinary zombie.
“Bang!”
Lucia’s reaction was extremely quick. She raised her automatic rifle and fired.
“Bang!”
The bullet accurately hit the monster’s forelimbs and red blood spattered out.
It moved extremely fast. After being injured, it quickly climbed down the rock wall and disappeared into a small hole.
Fang Heng’s brows were tightly knitted.
The monster’s movement style was a bit like a Licker. Its four limbs were pressed against the wall and moved at high speed.
“What was that thing?”
“No, it ran too fast. I didn’t see it clearly.”
Mo Jiawei shook his head.
He didn’t have the night vision ability like Fang Heng and Lucia. He just happened to see a blurry shadow when he swept the flashlight over it.
Before he could use his detection skill, the monster had already run away.
“Be careful. It might be the monster that the mercenary saw.”
Fang Heng’s gaze swept across the room.
There were a few holes in the top corner of the room. There were traces of frequent exits.
It seemed that the monsters used these holes to enter and exit the cave.

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - Heterozygote
paragraphs: Translator: Nyoi-Bo StudioEditor: Nyoi-Bo Studio
After confirming that the room was temporarily safe, Fang Heng walked to the console and picked up the booklet on the side of the console.
[Hint: You have obtained the operation manual of the laboratory’s central console.]
After roughly flipping through the operation manual, Fang Heng tried to check the mechanical equipment.
[Hint: It has been detected that you possess mechanical maintenance skills.]
[Hint: Current mechanical damage is 2%, the current repair success rate is 100%, cost: ordinary electronic components*3, wire*2, tool required: wrench.]

Fang Heng’s mechanical maintenance level had already risen to Level 17. During this period, he had the guidance of Victor, the master architect and master mechanic, and his maintenance skills had improved by leaps and bounds.
Chen Yu and the others stood by his side to protect him. They asked in a low voice, “How is it?”
“It’s not a big problem. Give me some time.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he waved the wrench in his hand.
A long channelling bar appeared above his head.
Two minutes later, the repair was completed. Fang Heng gently pressed the restore button.
“Buzz...”
The lights lit up in the room.
“It’s done.”
Fang Heng quickly controlled the main control panel and found the internal structure map of the research room. He projected it onto the electronic screen.
“This is the control room. Behind it is the research room. The special room where the first-generation meteorite is stored is behind the research room.”
[Hint: You have completed the fifteenth stage ring mission: Cave.]
[Hint: You have triggered the next stage main storyline ring mission-first-generation meteorite (team).] Mission name: First-generation meteorite.
Mission difficulty: ???
Mission requirements: Attempt to obtain the first-generation meteorite.
Fang Heng quickly glanced at the mission hint and swiftly controlled the platform.
“Click...”
With a soft sound, the door behind the main control room opened automatically.
“The room where the first-generation meteorite is stored has been destroyed. It can no longer be opened automatically through the central control.’
Fang Heng turned around and looked at the others.
“Our guess is probably right. Perhaps there’s something wrong with Dr Kevin’s research, causing the radiation to spread.”
“Shall we go?
Lucia had always been aggressive. She raised her gun and said, “If we can’t open it electronically, we’ll run over and open it manually.”
Eh... was she a little reckless?
MO Jiawei cast a questioning look at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng looked at MO Jiawei, then at the resurrection time of his Lickers and zombie clones.
“We have limited time. The longer we stay here, the stronger the radiation reaction will be.
“Be careful of the monsters that appear along the way. Let’s go!”
Alright! Let’s go!
Everyone raised their guns, passed the iron door and walked into the long pathway at the back.
At the end of the pathway, it was blocked by an alloy metal door.
The metal door was already distorted and damaged.
Fang Heng felt that something was wrong the moment he saw the door.
This kind of damage was more like the distortion caused by man-made explosions.
The alloy door did not completely block the entrance. In fact, due to the explosion, there were quite a lot of exposed gaps and they could barely squeezem.
Everyone quickly exchanged glances.
“I’ll go in and take a look.”
Lucia volunteered to go forward but was pulled back by Fang Heng who was behind her.
“I’m the commander for this operation, I’ll do it.”
As he spoke, Fang Heng turned sideways and squeezed into the cave entrance. The inside of the cave was very empty.
Fang Heng’s night vision was not very strong. He turned on his flashlight and used the light emitted by the flashlight to roughly sweep around the area.
The storage room where the first-generation meteorite was stored was a primitive cave that had not been completely built.
There was a deep pit in the middle.
“There’s no danger for the time being. Come in, everyone.”
Everyone outside the cave carefully stepped into the room after receiving Fang Heng’s message. One after another, they used their flashlights to illuminate their surroundings.
“Where’s the first-generation meteorite?”
“It’s in the pit.”
Fang Heng had just checked the internal structure of the cave from the computer in the main control room, so he explained it to everyone.

“The first-generation meteorite has an extremely strong radiation effect, so it is stored in the depths of the cave. Under normal circumstances, you need to be in the main control room to operate the equipment and pull it up from the depths.”
“Shh... look...”
Lucia suddenly noticed something, lowered her voice and pointed to the air.
What was that?!
Looking in the direction Lucia pointed to, Fang Heng’s heart palpitated.
A swarm of bats?!
Fang Heng was shocked when he saw the black creatures hanging upside down on the top of the rock wall.
No! They were the monsters that they saw not long ago!
They were more like a combination of bat and human, hanging upside down on the rock wall by the sharp claws that grew from their feet.
“Vampires...”
Zhang The’s face turned pale for a moment. He realized the seriousness of the problem.
“What?”
Fang Heng suddenly turned to look at Zhang The.
“Vampires.”
MO Jiawei covered his right eye and observed the creature on the top of the rock wall, narrating the information he got from his detection skill.
“The fusion of vampire and zombie corpse.”
“A heterozygous creature that is fused from the zombie virus and vampires. It
has strong climbing ability and short gliding ability. Different from ordinary zombie corpses, this creature possesses strong mobility and infection ability.”
MO Jiawei’s heart was pounding. He didn’t expect to meet such a hybrid creature here.
He continued, “This hybrid creature has most of the characteristics of zombies and vampires. Its weakness is strong light.”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat, and he immediately whispered, “Quick! Move the flashlight away, don’t agitate them.”
Everyone moved the flashlight away, not looking at the hybrid creature hanging high in the sky.
“Damn it! It must be Night Owl!”
Zhang Zhe clenched his teeth and cursed softly.
The Federation had received information before that Night Owl had made a
move in both the Vampire Apocalypse and Zombie Apocalypse worlds.
Connecting with the hybrid creature that he was seeing now, Zhang Zhe was almost certain that Night Owl must have made some kind of intervention in this world’s main storyline!
Fang Heng and Lucia looked up with their naked eyes.
In the entire cave, there were at least hundreds of vampire corpse heterozygotes at the top of the cave. There was also a huge heterozygote that looked like a high-level elite creature.
The only good news was that they seemed to be in a dormant state.
Fang Heng did not have the time to consider whether Night Owl was behind all this.
He had to think of a way to complete the mission and obtain the first-generation meteorite first!
He quickly came up with a plan in his mind and said in a low voice, “They are still in a dormant state. Don’t alarm them. We will get the first-generation meteorite and then evacuate.
Everyone nodded in unison.
Fang Heng swept his gaze across the surroundings and pointed at the manual valve at the side.
By turning the manual valve, he could lift the first-generation meteorite that was hidden deep underground.
Fang Heng made a gesture.
“I’ll open the valve. You guys help to cover me.”
After saymg that, he carefully walked toward the manual valve in the corner.
The others immediately found a cover at the back and were on guard.
Coming to the valve, Fang Heng reached out and turned the valve.
“Ka... Hua la la la...”
The sound of the mechanical chain being pulled was particularly distinct in the silent hall.
MO Jiawei secretly prayed in his heart that those vampire corpse heterozygotes at the top of the cave would not wake up due to the sounds.
Given his strength of up to 30 points, Fang Heng was able to turn the valve with ease.
Suddenly, Fang Heng heard a light click sound in his ear.
In the next moment, Fang Heng felt all the hair on his body stand on end..

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - Resurrection
paragraphs: Translator: Nyoi-Bo StudioEditor: Nyoi-Bo Studio
Fang Heng was very familiar with this feeling.
Skill-Danger perception has been activated!
Combined with the cracking sound just now...
Was it a trap!?
Fang Heng reflexively jumped back and looked for cover. At the same time, he shouted, “Be careful!!”
“Boom!!!”
In the next second, an explosion resounded throughout the entire cave.
Fang Heng’s feet shook slightly, and a lot of stone chips fell from the sky.
Explosives had been planted in the cave beforehand!
Lucia shouted, “Fang Heng! Are you okay!”
“I’m fine!”
Fang Heng stood up and quickly observed the situation around him.
There weren’t that many explosives.
The other party had deliberately hidden the explosives at the entrance!
D*mn it!
They wanted to blow up the entrance of the cave!
And they had succeeded.
A few rocks blocked the passage which they came from.
If they wanted to leave this place, they had to spend time cleaning up the rubble!
The next second, the pitter-patter sound followed.
The sound of the explosion caused the vampire corpse heterozygotes that were hanging at the top of the cave to wake up!
“Chi! Chi-chi!!”
The vampire corpse heterozygotes flapped their wings and attacked Fang Heng’s team.
Fang Heng, who could not find cover, became the primary target!
The nearest vampire corpse heterozygote charged toward Fang Heng.
The skill-bullet time was activated!
The vampire corpse heterozygote’s movements gradually slowed down in front of Fang Heng.
Fang Heng switched to a shotgun.
“Bang!!!”
One shot.
Blood splattered everywhere.
With the addition of his high strength attribute, the power of the bullet also increased significantly.
The bats in the air were blasted into blood and flesh!
The sound of the gun was even louder, alarming the vampire corpse heterozygotes in the hall.
“D*mn it! We’ve fallen into a trap!”
Zhang Zhe gritted his teeth and switched to a military pistol. He hid behind the cover and aimed to shoot.
The rest of the team also relied on the terrain to gather together and cover each other to shoot.
The rest of the team also relied on the terrain to gather together and cover each other to shoot.
Fang Heng, who was alone outside, became the primary target of the bats. Lucia shouted anxiously, “Fang Heng! Come back quickly!”
Fang Heng acted as if he didn’t hear her and blew up a vampire corpse heterozygote with a single shot.
Chen Yu felt that it was a little strange. Although they had the advantage in terrain, most of the vampire corpse heterozygotes in the hall were attracted to Fang Heng.
It seemed that Fang Heng was very attractive to these heterozygotes!
At this time, the situation was urgent. Chen Yu did not have time to think too much. He took out his modified revolver and started shooting.
“Tsk, just like that?”
Fang Heng got used to the attack mode of the heterozygotes. He said disdainfully and took out his machete.
“Chi!!”
A slash.
The attacking heterozygote was cut in half at the waist by Fang Heng.
The movement speed of the vampire corpse heterozygotes was very fast. They also had impressive flying ability.
However, their HP was still very low.
With the benefit of the skill-bullet time, Fang Heng was able to dodge most of the attacks completely, and he was able to hack them down one by one!
He was not afraid of being injured by the occasional group attacks. His physique exceeded 40 points and his HP was very stable!
Moreover, he also had the Water of Life to dispel the infection status!
Fang Heng even had the spare time to glance at the game log.
The bullet time would consume a lot of energy and stamina, so it couldn’t last long.
But it wasn’t important.
In half a minute, his zombie clones would be resurrected!
D*mn it! God was still going strong!
MO Jiawei was worried about Fang Heng at first but later found that Fang Heng didn’t seem to be afraid at all. He was killing the monsters crazily.
“Be careful! Fang Heng!’
Just as Fang Heng was getting excited about killing the creatures, he suddenly saw something out of the corner of his eye.
A huge black shadow pounced towards him from mid-air.
It was the huge hybrid creature that he saw earlier!
MO Jiawei saw the attribute of this elite creature through his skill and his expression changed slightly.
“Fang Heng! Be careful! He is the high-level vampire corpse heterozygote that was formed after Professor Kevin died.”
Professor Kevin?!
Fang Heng was stunned.
He raised the machete in his hand and used all his strength to ruthlessly slash forward from top to bottom.
“Clang! ! ”
An extremely heavy sound of metal being hammered was heard.
With over 30 strength points, Fang Heng had prepared a full-strength attack beforehand.
Fang Heng felt his wrist become extremely numb.
He didn’t stand firmly and took half a step back.
The large vampire corpse heterozygote that pounced over had no place to borrow strength in the air and flew backwards.
Fang Heng stared at Kevin.
In the next moment, several alchemy arrays flashed under Fang Heng’s feet.
“Shu-! Shu-!!!” Licker!
Resurrection time!
The Lickers dashed out from the rotating alchemy array!
Under Fang Heng’s control, they pounced on Kevin, the high-level vampire corpse heterozygote that was in mid-air!
The flying ability of the vampire corpse heterozygote was not strong and it was forced back by Fang Heng’s all-out attack.
The Lickers in the air opened their mouth and bit Kevin’s body, dragging him down from the air.
“Bang!!”
The Lickers and Kevin fell heavily to the ground.
“Chi Chi Chi...
The remaining Lickers quickly rushed up and bit Kevin.
Its sharp claws kept slashing at its body.
Fang Heng was shocked.
He saw the game log refresh rapidly.
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker resurrected successfully.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker resurrected successfully.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker deals damage to high-level vampire corpse heterozygote, Kevin.]
[Hint: Your Licker has absorbed the blood of high-level vampire corpse heterozygote, Kevin. Your skill-low-level vampire bloodline experience points +219.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-vine parasite has successfully revived.]
Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker...]
[Hint: Your Licker has absorbed the blood of high-level vampire corpse heterozygote, Kevin. Your skill-low-level vampire bloodline experience points
[Hint: Your skill-low-level vampire bloodline has been upgraded to Level 4.] That’s right, the huge creature was the mutated life form of Dr Kevin after his death.
Wait, the vampire bloodline skill had been upgraded?
One sip of his blood could increase such a high level of experience points?
Fang Heng was a little confused for a moment.
He had spent a lot of money to buy a lot of animals, and even after drinking so much blood, he had only achieved Level 3. Now, after two sips, he had achieved
Level 4?
What a loss!
Fang Heng felt that he had wasted his money previously!
In the blink of an eye, more zombie clone bodies crawled out from the loose soil near Fang Heng.
Meanwhile, the Lickers were crazily gnawing at Kevin.
Kevin was firmly suppressed and could not make an effective counterattack.
Row after row of game hints refreshed.
[Hint: Your Licker has absorbed the blood of high-level vampire corpse heterozygote, Kevin. Your skill-low-level vampire bloodline experience points +212.]
[Hint: Your skill-low-level vampire bloodline has been upgraded to Level 8.]
[Hint: You need to absorb blood with higher energy to upgrade your skill level. ]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker has killed the high-level vampire corpse heterozygote, Kevin.]
Amazing, he had reached Level 8.
This was a massive win!
Fang Heng took out a bottle of Water of Life from his backpack and drank tons of it.
[Hint: You used the Water of Life, your infection level is zero.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker has killed the high-level vampire corpse heterozygote...]

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - Taking the Lead
paragraphs: Translator: Nyoi-Bo StudioEditor: Nyoi-Bo Studio

After absorbing the blood until they could no longer increase their skill experience points, the Lickers quickly ended Kevin’s life and turned their attention toward the remaining vampire corpse heterozygotes in the hall.
Other than being able to fly, the other attributes of the vampire corpse heterozygotes were far inferior to the Lickers!
Their most powerful infection skill was also ineffective against the Lickers.
This was in addition to Fang Heng’s personal attribute bonus.
It was a one-sided massacre!
A critical hit from the Licker was enough to finish off a vampire corpse heterozygote.
In the blink of an eye, the situation had reversed!
The Lickers had become the hunters. They climbed along the walls and frantically hunted down the fleeing vampire corpse heterozygotes.
Not far away, Chen Yu, who was hiding behind the cover, looked at Zhang Zhe who was beside him.
What a terrifying combat ability...
Just as they had guessed earlier.
Fang Heng did have the ability to control a large number of zombies!
And that included controlling the Lickers!!
They had a feeling that Fang Heng had a similar ability, but they did not expect the latter’s ability to be so powerful!
A high-level creature such as the vampire corpse heterozygote was easily killed by the Lickers.
Even though there were only twelve Lickers.
In an elementary game, possessing such an ability was extremely terrifying!
Seeing it with his own eyes, Chen Yu felt extremely shocked.
The Lickers were hunting aggressively for their prey and wiped out the vampire corpse heterozygotes within a short period.
The entire room was filled with sizzling sounds.
After inheriting Fang Heng’s vampire bloodline passive skills, the Lickers and the zombie team were strongly attracted to blood.
They surrounded the corpses of the vampire corpse heterozygotes and kept feeding on them.
This strange scene made Chen Yu, who had been on the battlefield for a long time, feel his scalp go numb.
He suddenly felt that the zombie team controlled by Fang Heng was much more terrifying than the heterozygotes found here. “We’re safe.
Fang Heng made a safe hand gesture to the crowd.
He felt that it was a pity.
These vampire corpse heterozygotes were too fragile. They were hit by the Licker’s claws and were either half-dead or half-injured.
Otherwise, he would have the opportunity to bring back a living body for research purposes.
After the crisis was over, Chen Yu and the others heaved a sigh of relief and walked out from behind the cover.
While thinking, Fang Heng controlled the vine zombies to move the rocks at the entrance while he walked to the manual valve at the corner and continued to turn the valve.
The iron chain was pulled up again.
“Hualala...”
Zhang Zhe walked to the centre of the cave, lowered his head and shone his flashlight downward.
As the platform was gradually pulled up, Zhang The’s face became more and more ghastly.
A loud noise was heard.
The platform was pulled to its limit and snapped into the groove.
“What’s going on?

The platform was empty.
Zhang Zhe jumped onto the platform with a sullen face.
He squatted down as if searching for something.
Fang Heng noticed that Zhang Zhe picked up a piece of gravel from the ground.

Fang Heng also jumped onto the platform and picked up the gravel at his feet.
It was thumb-sized brown gravel.

Zhang The’s expression was very ugly. He gritted his teeth and spat out a few words.
“It’s Night Owl!”
“He arrived here earlier than us and destroyed the first-generation meteorite.”
Chen Yu’s face was filled with disbelief, “How is that possible?”
Zhang Zhe did not explain. His face was dark as he put away the rubble, “This is a serious matter. I need to report this to my superiors immediately.”
“No, that’s it?”
MO Jiawei stood outside the platform and listened to what the two of them were saymg. He could not understand it at all.
How could a perfectly good main storyline mission be cut off in advance after achieving this step?
“How did Night Owl do it? We followed the mission line step by step to get here. How did they find the first-generation meteorite earlier than us?
Fang Heng stuffed the damaged meteorite into his backpack and looked at Zhang The.
From the very beginning to the discovery of the traces of vampires in the cave, the meteorite had already been destroyed.
Night Owl was way ahead of them!

“Dr Kevin went missing six months ago, and the equipment here stopped working six months ago. All the signs indicate that he was killed at that time. Does this mean that Night Owl was six months ahead of us?
“Yes!”
MO Jiawei also reacted at this time.

“No matter how you calculate it, it’s not right. Even if Night Owl came here after Dr Kevin died, the mercenary group only found traces of the vampire corpse heterozygote here three months ago, so Night Owl should have come here at least three months ago.”
“After all, there’s no sign of Server 8 three months ago. How did they manage to enter the game ahead of time?

Faced with MO Jiawei’s questioning, Zhang The’s face was livid. He only said, “It involves Federation secrets. I can only say that Night Owl has the ability to do this, and they’ve already succeeded.”
“In short, our Federation will handle this matter. There’s no need for you to worry about the follow-up.”
After saymg that, Zhang Zhe nodded at Chen Yu and took the lead to leave the cave.
Chen Yu scratched his head. He gestured to Fang Heng to contact him again and quickly followed.
Seeing the two of them leave, MO Jiawei was extremely displeased.
After busying himself for half a day, not only did the mission disappear, but he was also met with a rebuff from the Federation.
“This is the reason why I hate the Federation. They were able to come here because of us. Now that we are of no use to them, they’re running away.”
Fang Heng asked, “Lucia, what are your thoughts?”

“This is also the first time I’ve heard of the Night Owl’s name. We only learned about Paradise Island through encrypted intelligence messages. Someone was three months ahead of us. Could it be someone from the Meteorite Company...” “It shouldn’t be. The Meteorite Company has no connection with the vampires.” Fang Heng pondered for a moment.
He found that the game mission was still there. It was still focused on finding the first-generation meteorite so they did not fail.
There should be another way.
“The first-generation meteorite has been destroyed. Do the Dark Knights have the ability to repair it?”

“It’s very difficult.” Lucia was worried and said, “We can only try to bring the fragments back to try. The internal structure of the first-generation meteorite has been destroyed. The probability of recovery is very small...”
“Alright, let’s collect the fragments first.”
Fang Heng was also a little unhappy.

The rewards for the main storyline ring mission had always been very generous. If one part was not done well enough, it was not to the extent that all the previous efforts were in vain. However, they would not be able to earn anything bigger in the future.

It is also very difficult for the Federation to do such a thing at the moment. It is also quite unlikely for Night Owl to do so based on his current strength. He suspects that Night Owl might have the support of a higher power backing him.”
Chen Yu: “In addition, our server’s main storyline mission might be cut off by Night Owl. Server 8 might very well become an ownerless land. If there is more information, I will contact you again..”

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - Breakthrough
paragraphs: Translator: Nyoi-Bo StudioEditor: Nyoi-Bo Studio
Turning off the survival radio, Fang Heng frowned.
Looking back at the entire mission process, he felt that one thing was the strangest.
Since Night Owl could enter the game ahead of time and cut off the mission line, why didn’t he just take the meteorite away and completely occupy the mission line, instead he chose to destroy it?
Didn’t they want to complete the main storyline mission?
Their goal couldn’t be purely to destroy the world, right? This was too stupid.
Mo Jiawei had collected all the meteorite fragments. Seeing that Fang Heng was still in a daze, he couldn’t help but ask, “God, what do you say?”
“Let’s go back first. The mission has not been hinted as ‘failed’, so there’s still a way.”
Right now, Fang Heng could only think of Qiu Yaokang, who was in the shelter.
With Qiu Yaokang’s strength, he might be able to repair the first-generation meteorite.
Just as they left the cave, Zhang Yan walked over with his mercenary group.
Aalto asked anxiously, “Colonel Fang Heng, what’s the situation inside the cave?
Fang Heng nodded in response according to the prepared explanation.
“Unfortunately, Dr Kevin had an accident while he was studying the first-generation meteorite. The final result was that the living creatures in the cave mutated. ”
“We have roughly cleaned up the mutated creatures in the cave. There shouldn’t be any danger shortly.”
“But the problem hasn’t been completely solved yet.”

“This cave has been completely contaminated by radiation. There may be an endless stream of mutated creatures in the future. When the number of mutated creatures has gathered to a certain extent, they may come back again.”
Aalto’s heart sank.
For the islanders, staying on this island would still be dangerous.

“Don’t worry, Aalto. We’re good friends. I won’t just stand by and watch. How about this? I’ll send a team over to help guard the island and clean up the mutated creatures in the cave every once in a while.”
“Ah, this...
Aalto was touched.
[Hint: Your favorability rating with Aalto and the islanders has slightly increased.]
“Colonel Fang Heng, thank you so much.”
“It’s a small matter. It’s better to survive in this apocalypse. We should help each other. What do you think?”
“Colonel Fang Heng, I think you’re right.”
Fang Heng put his hand on Aalto’s shoulder.
“But the people in my shelter are picky. The food here is relatively simple. I will have to send Ovo cooks over.”
“Also, it’s a bit inconvenient to transport materials, so I want to build a space tearing device on the island. What do you think?”
“Judging from the time, the meteorite should have been damaged for almost half a year.”
In the research room of the shelter, Qiu Yaokang was plugging in the detailed analysis report of the first- generation meteorite.
“And the internal structure of the meteorite has been destroyed and lost its vitality.”
“It can be seen that the person who destroyed the meteorite was very targeted.”
“This meteorite has lost its research value.”
The more Fang Heng listened, the more he felt that something was wrong. He asked, “Even you can’t fix it?”
“The current technology can’t fix it.”
“What about in the future?”
Qiu Yaokang looked at Fang Heng. “Unless there’s a breakthrough, it’s impossible to fixit in 20 years.”
Fang Heng opened his mouth. He felt that his last glimmer of hope had been destroyed.
“Is it a dead end?”
“No, it can’t be said to be a dead end. Unless you can find the meteorite through other methods.’
“Is there another way?
Fang Heng smiled bitterly. “Don’t tease me. Are you talking about looking forward to another meteorite falling from the sky?”
“Yes, this is also a good idea.” Qiu Yaokang looked at Fang Heng with admiration.
“I think you’re mocking me.”
“No, I’m serious. From the perspective of probability, this is more reliable than us finding a way to repair the meteorite fragments within three years.”
Qiu Yaokang continued to work with his head lowered.
“But I think you have a better choice. I suggest you ask Victor.”
“Ah? Victor?”
“Ask him? He knows about meteorites?”
Fang Heng was stunned.
He did not understand what the relationship between meteorites and Victor
Why did he have to ask Victor?
“Hmm? Did he not mention it to you? Meteorite Company’s space fissure technology.”
Qiu Yaokang looked up at Fang Heng in surprise.
“Oh ya, that’s right. You’ve been out recently.”
Qiu Yaokang explained calmly.
“Last time when I was having dinner with Victor, we talked about it.”
“We’re in an endless universe. From the perspective of probability, somewhere in the universe, there will be the same galaxy, the same planet, and the same meteorite...’
“Uh... you mean a parallel world?”
“The Meteorite Company believes that there is a special connection between these similar worlds.”
“This is a project that the Meteorite Company is developing. Last time, you brought some relevant information from the mansion and Victor took it to study.”
“Theoretically, we can...”
“Bang!!”
Qiu Yaokang, who was halfway through his sentence, looked up and saw the heavily closed door. He could not help but shake his head.
“Seriously, young people nowadays don’t have any patience.”
He was rich! He was rich!
Fang Heng was extremely excited. All he could think of was the word ‘rich’.
Parallel universe?
No! It was not that simple!
If his guess was right...
This was definitely not an ordinary concept of a parallel universe!
It was...
Fang Heng rushed to Victor’s laboratory and explained his purpose for coming.

“Indeed, this theory exists. The Meteorite Company has done in-depth research in this area. Previously, I’ve seen related research content from the blueprints obtained from the Meteorite Company’s office, and found the connection between different parallel universes.”
“Recently, I have also been conducting research in this area.’
Victor brought Fang Heng to the large-scale space tearing device in the basement of the shelter.
“Through the large-scale space tearing device, we can think of a way to connect to the parallel world and open a space tunnel.”
“In theory, this plan is feasible.”
Fang Heng swallowed his saliva and carefully asked, “How far have you progressed?”
“With the information obtained from the mansion to supplement the theory, it has been temporarily perfected.”

Victor thought for a moment and continued, “If we want to successfully open a passage, we still need to improve the performance of the space tearing device and make some modifications and upgrades to the device.”
“Level up requires a lot of rare resources. In addition, to open a passage requires a lot of energy.”
“How much does it require?
“Massive.”
As he spoke, a game hint flashed in front of Fang Heng’s vision.
[Hint: Player’s shelter has been determined to be above Level 70, research level above Level 30, building level above Level 30.]
[Hint: Player now has a high-level theory of space tearing device.]
[Hint: Player now has a Tier 2 space-tearing device.]
[Hint: Player has been determined to have an S-level construction engineer -Victor.]
[Hint: Player has met all prerequisites to unlock upgrade to Tier 3 for the large space tearing device (click here to view the details of the upgrade requirements)..]

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - Tier 3 Space Tearing Device
paragraphs: He guessed it right!!!
Fang Heng’s heart began to race as he carefully read the game hint.
In an instant, Fang Heng was filled with surprise!
Time travel? Parallel world theory?
No! None of it!
These were all theories that the NPCs came up with!
It was not a simple time passage, but travelling across servers!
With the help of the time passage, he could directly use the space tearing device to cross over to other servers!
This meant that he could directly use a time passage to enter other game servers without switching servers!
For a moment, Fang Heng suddenly realized something.
“Victor, is this transformation very difficult? Are you the only one in this world who can complete the transformation?”
“Not to that extent, it’s too exaggerated.”
Victor was very modest.
“There should still be people in this world who can do it, at most three or four.”
Great!
Server transmigration!
No wonder the Meteorite Company spent so much effort to get rid of Victor!
“Victor, is there a higher level up for the space device?”

“Yes, indeed. Through a higher level up, the space tearing device can locate and search for more time anchors. However, Fang Heng, this kind of teleportation consumes a lot of energy. One teleportation will almost cost us...”
This was a match!
Night Owl had entered Server 8 before the game opened and found and destroyed the first-generation meteorite.
Combined with the vampires he had seen in the underground passage...
There was a high probability that Server 8 had been attacked by vampires from the world of vampires.
They had paid a huge price to enter the game before the game opened and destroyed the meteorite.
Then what would be the next step...
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.
If he wanted to complete the mission, he could only think of a way to obtain the first-generation meteorite from the other server.
No wonder, Night Owl had spared no effort to eliminate all the top-level engineers who could upgrade the space tearing device in Server 8’s apocalypse world.
Night Owl was eliminating the potential risks ahead of time.
From the looks of it, they might also have top-level engineers in their hands.
Fang Heng was secretly excited.
The Night Owl organization must have felt that they were stable. And no matter how stupid the Federation was, they would still be able to analyze Night Owl’s motive by now.
They would most likely have to fight each other.
No one knew that he could also establish a Tier 3 time passage.
This was his greatest advantage right now.
What he needed to do was to gather as much as he could!
Gather as many resources as he could, and complete the modification of the Tier 3 space tearing device before Night Owl! He would once again control the main storyline mission with his own hands!
With this thought in mind, Fang Heng opened the construction materials list.
[Materials required for the construction of the Tier 3 space tearing device.]
Survival points: 150,000.
King of Gods’ points: 1,000. High energy crystal: 3. High-level spare parts: 500.
Special insulator: 69.
Type II alloy metal: 27...
A row of densely packed construction requirements made Fang Heng’s heart turn cold.
Good heavens, so many advanced resources?
A Tier 3 space tearing device possessed a powerful ability and the construction difficulty was also extremely high.
Fang Heng composed himself and compared the items one by one.
Survival points were enough.
Other advanced materials could be bought with money or the Federation could find a way to gather them from the black market.
However, this would result in a large sum of survival points and money.
Roughly speaking, it would take up quite a bit of his savings.
In addition, Fang Heng had also obtained some King of Gods’ points from the Federation and Old Black previously.
In the past, he had saved most of them and had always been frugal. He had also saved up 900 points, so it wasn’t a big problem...
He could afford the others even if he gritted his teeth.
The biggest problem was the high energy crystal!
Only a Tier 5 creature would drop high energy crystals.
What should he do?
Where could he find a Tier 5 creature?
Even if he found one, would he be able to defeat it?
Moreover, he needed three more!
Fang Heng felt the difficulty of the mission and frowned.
He recalled the Tier 5 mother spider he had met in the Meteorite Company.
That battle had not been easy. Because the matriarch was a non-combat creature, he had a chance to kill it.
Most Tier 5 mutated zombies were combat-type. If they fought head-on...
It would be difficult!
It would be difficult to collect Tier 5 crystals in a short period.
Fang Heng thought for a moment.
It was better to focus on development for the time being and lure the people of Paradise Island back to the shelter.
Then, he would think of a way to go to the Meteorite Company’s quarantine zone to take a look.
They had already passed through there. There might be a Tier 5 mutated zombie.
Also, he had to increase his strength as soon as possible!
If Night Owl wanted to complete the construction of the Tier 3 space tearing device, he still needed to complete the shelter to be above Level 70.
This was especially difficult.
The Federation would not let them complete it easily.
Fang Heng felt that he still had quite a bit of time.
One step at a time!
Ever since he learned how to meditate, Fang Heng’s schedule had become more regular.
He only needed to meditate for 3 hours a day and the effect was even better than sleeping for 8 hours.
He was in high spirits!
Moreover, after every meditation, Fang Heng could feel that the seal in the sea of consciousness was becoming clearer and clearer.
Unfortunately, if he only went offline for three hours to rest, he would still experience the negative effects of fatigue after he returned to the game.
Therefore, Fang Heng felt very helpless. He still needed to spend eight hours every day outside of the game.
In the stands of the gym, Mo Jiawei was excitedly introducing Fang Heng to the assessment teams.
“Those are the assessment teams from the Federation.”

“The assessment is in half a month. They are here to test the students who have signed up for the assessment. At the same time, they will also do some background checks and psychological assessments.”
Mo Jiawei was not very good at fighting, but he was still very excited to see others fight.
This was especially so for these students.
They had been carefully groomed by North River Heavy Industry since they were young.
From now on, they would be the core players of the North River Heavy Industry!
In the mid-stage game, these people were the mainstays!
“Good!”
“Amazing!!”
On the stage, the students and the Federation assessment officers were having a heated fight, and cheers could be heard from time to time.
Mo Jiawei had always thought of himself as a support player. Watching others fight was like watching a show.
Fang Heng was not very interested.
He was more concerned about Mo Yunxiao.

When he was analyzing the ritual runes, Mo Yunxiao encountered considerable difficulties. He felt that he could not do it alone, so he informed Fang Heng and left the city not long ago to discuss the runes with his good friend.
It had been three days since he left but there had been no news.
“Hey, Fang Heng, look over there.”
Mo Jiawei pointed to two young men in black work clothes and sunglasses in the corner.
“They are the chief examiners sent by the Federation.”
“Oh.”
Fang Heng looked at them and quickly moved his eyes away.
On the sidelines, under the black sunglasses, two pairs of eyes were also looking at Fang Heng
Liu Zhengguo was one of the chief examiners this time. He touched Gong Hui’s arm.
“He is Fang Heng? The rookie in Server 8 that I told you about?”
“He’s very popular in District 8. I heard from the people in District 8 that he has built a large shelter and can control the zombie team.”

Victor was very modest.

Great!

One teleportation will almost cost us...”

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - Testing Him
paragraphs: “With this ability, Fang Heng developed rapidly in the early stages of the game.”
Gong Fan responded coldly, “Zombie? Is he good at holding things? Can he block a punch from me?”
“Don’t say that. It’s a pretty good skill. According to internal evaluation, it’s an S-level talent.”
“According to the current situation, it’s only a matter of time before he reaches the overlord level in Server 8.”
“To maintain the stability of the low-level game world, the higher-ups will most likely choose to cooperate with him.”
As Liu Yu said this, his eyes revealed a look of envy.
“If that’s the case, he’ll have nothing to worry about in the future. He’ll become a powerful b*stard.”
“But it’s a pity. I heard that recently, District 8 was scammed by Night Owl’s people. The main storyline mission was cut off. I reckon that District 8’s development has reached its peak.”
Gong Fan was not very interested and said, “I don’t care about the low-level games.”
“Alright. A few days ago, there was a large number of bat incidents in the gym that spread on the internet. Do you know about It?”
Gong Fan was slightly interested. For the first time, he raised his head and looked seriously in the direction of Fang Heng.
“Is it him?”
“I don’t know. The local intelligence department has gathered all the information that they collected on the internet that day, and they have also compared them.”
“They confirmed that the bats hovering in the sky formed some kind of special occult rune. Someone must have activated Tier 1 materialization.”
Gong Fan frowned. “Occult? Such a big commotion? Is it a high compatibility materialization?”
“What else could it be? It’s such an ordinary registration and simulation training. Just two people should be enough. Why are we here?”
Liu Yu curled his lips and continued, “The leader has instructed us to use this opportunity to probe North River Heavy Industry and see if they have secretly trained some small monsters.”
“We need to find a way to confirm the risk. It’s best if we can find the identity of the player who caused the anomaly that day.”
Gong Fan said, “Do you suspect that Fang Heng caused the anomaly that day?”

“I’ve done my research before. Fang Heng had just arrived in the city a week ago. On the second day after he arrived, the bat incident happened in the gym. He also appeared in the gym that day. Furthermore, I’ve confirmed that he’s an unregistered Tier 1 materialization player...”
“Got it. I’ll go and test him.”
as

Gong Fan felt a buzzing sound in his ears. He impatiently interrupted Liu Yu’s incessant chatter. “Why didn’t you just say that it was an order from the leader? Why did you take such a long detour?” “Don’t put too much effort into it. That guy is very important. Server 8 still needs him to maintain stability. Our Federation also has cooperation with him... Hey, look, he has left. This is a good opportunity.” “Oh right, the leader wants information on his various attributes. Try to probe more. The information should be as accurate as possible!”
“You’re so annoying...”
Gong Fan waved his hand as he spoke and walked towards the passage where Fang Heng left.
Fang Heng did not know that he was being targeted.
Two minutes ago, he had just received a message from Mo Yunxiao.
The flight that Mo Yunxiao took last night had just returned to the city this morning, and he had already returned to the villa.
During this trip, Mo Yunxiao had already gotten some clues regarding the occult runes. He sent a message to Fang Heng to go to the villa to look for him when he’s available.
Fang Heng replied, “I’ll be right there.” Then, he immediately rushed to the villa.
“Fang Heng?”
In the pathway of the gym, Fang Heng heard someone calling his name from behind.
Turning his head, Fang Heng saw a young man wearing sunglasses walking toward him.
Eh? The Chief Examiner from the Federation?
“I’ve heard a lot about you. Please advise.”
Gong Fan was afraid of trouble and didn’t like to talk much. He nodded at Fang Heng and then quickly rushed towards Fang Heng.
What was going on?
Fang Heng was a little confused when he saw Gong Fan rushing toward him.
Wasn’t Gong Fan a member of the Federation?
Why were there so many people looking for him to fight recently?
In the blink of an eye, Gong Fan had already arrived in front of him and kicked him sideways.
“Whoosh!!”
Fang Heng was swift in his actions and he dodged a sidekick.
Before he could counterattack, a fist came at him again.
Gong Fan’s follow-up attacks came like a tidal wave.
One after another.
Fang Heng was being suppressed by Gong Fan and he cried out in his heart, “This guy’s a martial artist!”
However, Fang Heng was unexceptionally calm.
He tried every means to dodge Gong Fan’s endless attacks and find a loophole to counterattack.
Gong Fan was also amazed.
He didn’t expect a newbie in the elementary game to be able to block his continuous attacks.
He quickly assessed Fang Heng’s overall strength in his mind.
He was very strong!
His moves were agile and there were no unnecessary movements.
This meant that he had undergone professional training and his body had formed an instinctive reaction.
His agility attribute was not low either.
Otherwise, he would not be able to completely avoid all of his attacks.
Gong Fan wanted to test Fang Heng’s strength attribute, so he deliberately made an opening
What a good opportunity!
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up. He aimed at his opponent’s face and threw a punch.
The moment he threw the punch, Gong Fan’s pupils constricted.
What the hell!
Gong Fan suddenly felt a sense of danger. He immediately raised his hands in front of his body to dodge.
“Bang!!!”
“Awesome! Go for it!”
In the stands by the gym, Liu Yu was watching the match excitedly. He even whistled and cheered from time to time.
He noticed that Gong Fan had returned and asked casually, “How was the test? Did that guy catch your eye?”
“Test? Test your head!”
“Ah?”
Liu Yu was stunned and turned around.
A mark appeared on Gong Fan’s eye socket.
Just by looking at it, one could tell how painful the punch was.
Liu Yu was stunned.
“No, what’s going on? Did you lose?”
Gong Fan’s face darkened.
“I didn’t lose.”
“Your information is not accurate. There are two possibilities. First, he has already activated Tier 2 materialization and can do close combat.”
“Second, his basic attribute of strength is over 25, and he has undergone extremely rigorous training...”
“Eh... Fang Heng was indeed a professional player before.”
Liu Yu coughed a few times guiltily.

“Ahem, but according to my information, he has been away from the professional arena for some time. Moreover, his performance in the previous match-fixing team was also very average, and he even played fake matches...”
Liu Yu felt a hint of killing intent in Gong Fan’s eyes.
“This was just a mistake in the information... to be honest, what’s your evaluation of him?”
Gong Fan snorted and turned his head away.
“Not bad.”
Liu Yu’s heart skipped a beat.
To make Gong Fan say ‘not bad’...
This meant that with his Tier 2 materialization, he could not do anything to Fang Heng.
In this case, Fang Heng’s strength evaluation had to be reformulated. “Do you think that the bat’s incident that day has anything to do with him?”

“I don’t know. I only evaluated his close combat strength. At least he didn’t display any outstanding Tier 2 materialization ability during the battle, so I can’t determine his level of materialization.”

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - Reading
paragraphs: Fang Heng rubbed his fists, thinking to himself that the people of the Federation were really stupid.
That guy was quite strong.
When he got back, he would report to Chen Yu, deduct his salary and have him write a check!
The gymnasium was a distance away from Mo Yunxiao’s villa, so Fang Heng conveniently called a taxi.
Half an hour later.
Fang Heng reached the villa.
“Mr Mo is in the study now. He said to bring you there if you came.”
The assistant led Fang Heng to the backyard of the villa where there was a small independent building.
He pushed the door open and entered.
The smell of paper books entered his nose.
Bookshelves were placed in front of the four walls of the room, and they were filled with thick books.
Mo Yunxiao was climbing a high ladder, taking out a book from the upper shelf.
“Fang Heng, you came at the right time. This time, I went to visit an old friend who has studied occultism for many years. I took the time to chat with her about you.”
“You’re lucky. We found something.”
“Come, help me hold it.”
Mo Yunxiao said and threw the book in his hand to Fang Heng.
Fang Heng reached out to take it.
He felt that the book was wrapped by a gentle strength and fell steadily into his palm.
In the next moment, Fang Heng was shocked.
A voice quickly flashed in his mind, and then a line of small words quickly appeared in the lower right corner of his retina.
(Hint: You have come into contact with an unknown book.]
(Hint: You do not possess any related skills and can not appraise this book.)
[Hint: Your basic perception is greater than 20. You can feel that this book contains weak energy.)
“How is it? Did you receive the game hint?”
Fang Heng was stunned. He looked at Mo Yunxiao, whose back was facing him. “What’s going on?”
“This book is something that was brought out of the game. A player who has activated Tier 1 materialization can receive the game hint.”
Mo Yunxiao explained casually and continued to search the bookshelf.
It was brought out of the game!
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat and he lowered his head to open the book to look.
The book was densely packed with a type of text and symbols.
Fang Heng could understand most of the words, but when they were combined, he was completely unable to understand the meaning.
Especially those twisted words. Just looking at them gave Fang Heng a huge headache.
Another row of words floated across Fang Heng’s retina.
(Hint: Your will attribute has passed the test. You have not suffered any backlash from reading.]
(Hint: You do not possess any related skills. You have not passed the test. You can not obtain any useful information from reading.)
Mo Yunxiao took a book and walked down the ladder.
“If you want to unlock the mystical ritual runes on the back of your hand, it’s best to start from occultism.”
Mo Yunxiao smiled gently. “To tell you the truth, I’ve also been learning recently.”
“There are still some discoveries. Madam Liv and I agree that the mark on the back of your hand doesn’t have any negative effects such as traps, backlashes or restrictions.”
“That’s great.”
After confirming that the mark on the back of his hand didn’t have any negative effects, Fang Heng heaved a sigh of relief. His mood had also relaxed quite a bit.
At least now he could confirm that he was safe.
“Yes, it’s a positive contract. As for the effect of the modified mark, since the mark on the back of your hand isn’t clear and complete yet, Madam Liv isn’t able to get any more information.”
“However, there’s one thing. From the runes on the back of your hand, you can see the shape of a hexagram.”
“In occultism, the hexagram runes correspond to the strength of a seal.”
Mo Yunxiao gestured for Fang Heng to sit on the other side of the low table.
“Madam Liv wants to meet you in person, but due to some special reasons, it’s not convenient for her recently.”
“So she entrusted me to ask if you’re interested in learning occultism. If you’re interested, she’s willing to be your guide and guide you to learn occultism.”
“If there’s a chance in the future, she’s willing to recommend you to join the occultism seminar.”
Fang Heng asked, “Who’s Madam Liv?”
Mo Yunxiao thought for a moment and said, “To be exact, she’s a veteran player who studies occultism.”
“What about the occultism seminar?”

“It’s a loose organization. Most of its members study occultism, and most of them are high-level players who are proficient in occultism. When they encounter an event or a difficult problem related to occultism, everyone will gather together to discuss and learn.”
Fang Heng hummed in acknowledgement and began to ponder.
Occultism seemed to be something that was used in high-level games. It did not seem to be of much use at the moment.
“There’s no rush. You can think about it carefully and give me an answer later.”
Mo Yunxiao began to brew tea.
“Also, Fang Heng, the Tier 1 ritual that you activated is very special. The Tier 2 materialization unlock method for ordinary people is no longer suitable for you.”
“Because the mark on the back of your hand has been modified, you have to think of a way to complete the next stage of the mark and complete the Tier 2 materialization ritual to unlock it.”
“When the time comes, the mark on your arm will be further improved and we will be able to get more effective information from it.”
Mo Yunxiao placed the brewed tea in front of Fang Heng.

“Of course, it doesn’t matter if you’re stuck at Tier 1 materialization or not. Anyway, we’ve confirmed that the mark won’t have any negative effects on you, and you can’t use the occult runes in your current game, right?”
Hearing this, Fang Heng frowned. Can’t use it?
That wasn’t quite right.
His runes could increase the strength of all attributes in the Zombie Apocalypse game by 10%!
If he could find a way to upgrade it to Tier 2 materialization, theoretically, he could get a higher level of improvement.
Learn! He had to learn!
And this was related to the secret of the mark on the back of his hand.
Fang Heng quickly made a decision. He raised his head and said, “Mr Mo, I want to try learning it.”
“Of course. It seems that you are still interested in occultism.”
“Madam Liv had already expected this.”

“It’s a pity that she hasn’t been able to leave recently, so she entrusted me to guide you through elementary occultism. After you complete the elementary guidance, I will bring you to see Madam Liv.”
Mo Yunxiao handed over the book in his hand.
“This is the introduction guide to occultism. It confirms that your basic attribute of will is higher than 12 points and that you can only use it if your intelligence level is higher than 6 points.”
“Remember, the will attribute is the key. If you don’t meet the requirements, forcefully reading will result in mental contamination. You absolutely can not force yourself.”
“In the game, the will and intelligence attributes are relatively difficult to obtain. You can only rely on yourself to slowly think of a way.”

“In addition, reading books will also consume your mental strength at the same time. You must pay special attention to not force yourself to read when your mental strength is exhausted, so as not to affect your will attribute.”
“Okay, I’ll remember it.”
Fang Heng nodded and carefully took the book.
A row of hints appeared in his retina.
