chapters.title: Chapter 272 - Reading Progress
paragraphs: Mo Yunxiao nodded and said, “After you finish reading the books, you will be able to master related skills in the game and complete the introduction to Tier 1 occultism.”
“You can enter this study room at any time. You can also browse through the books here.”
As Mo Yunxiao spoke, he pointed to a row of red bookshelves to the west.
“Most of the books on the red bookshelves are related to occultism.”
“As I said, don’t force yourself. Many books require willpower. If the attribute is not enough, you will be mentally polluted. If you are unlucky, you will be cursed.”
“Okay, thank you, Mr Mo. Sorry for disturbing you during this period.”

“You’re welcome. You can browse through the books in the study room at will, but you can not take them out of this study room. This is a rule set by the Mo Family over the years. I hope you can understand and abide by it.”
“Of course.”
“Then I won’t disturb you while you’re reading. I still have to enter the game to take a look.”
After watching Mo Yunxiao leave, Fang Heng opened the book in his hands and flipped through it page by page.
The introduction to occultism.
The various difficult-to-pronounce runes and syllables on the pages made it extremely difficult for Fang Heng to read.
He felt more like he was learning a new language.
And it was the kind that was particularly troublesome.
After reading for less than half an hour, Fang Heng felt dizzy and could not read anymore.
This was probably the state where Mo Yunxiao said his mental strength was exhausted.
Fang Heng thought to himself, then took out the cover of the book and looked at it.
A line of small words appeared on his retina again.
(Hint: Current reading progress 0.21%.]
Only 0.21%?
Was there any way to increase reading efficiency?
Fang Heng stood up and placed the book on the wooden table.
There was no other way. He returned to the game to take a look.
(Hint: During the time you are offline (3 hours and 45 minutes), your zombie team has cut down 382 trees, dug 1,662 units of the coal mine, smelted 1988 iron nuggets...)

(Hint: During the time you are offline (3 hours and 45 minutes), your zombie team has cleared out a portion of the quarantine zone. You have obtained 2,282 survival points, evolution crystal fragments*201, complete evolution crystal fragments*38, Tier 1 evolution cystal*8.)
Fang Heng opened the game log and took a quick look at the game hint.
Upgrading to Tier 3 space tearing device required three high energy crystals, so he needed to find a way to kill a Tier 5 creature!
At the moment, his hard power was not enough.
He needed to find a way to improve quickly.
Level up!

Levelling up was the most direct way. Levelling up a character could unlock the upper limit of skill levels, increase the basic attributes and increase the number of zombies in the group. It was equivalent to strengthening the overall strength.
Unfortunately, it was not easy to find a Tier 1 evolution crystal.
Fang Heng made a rough estimate.
Through the hack in the quarantine zone, he could probably gain two to three Tier 1 evolution crystals in an hour.
However, after three hours of hacking, his zombie team would die because of the high concentration of poisonous gas.
It would take two to three months to level up purely by hacking.
The efficiency was slow...
Fang Heng lowered his head and thought for a while.
Apart from levelling up, if he could further improve the combat ability of the zombie team, it would be much easier to deal with the Tier 5 mutated zombie.
Fang Heng was going to consult Qiu Yaokang.
More than a week had passed. He didn’t know if the laboratory had produced anything good.
When he came to the underground research laboratory, Fang Heng saw that many researchers were busy.
The only person he didn’t see was Qiu Yaokang
“Where’s Qiu Yaokang?”

Li Bo was busy. He turned his head and answered, “He encountered a technical problem. I heard that a technical team from the Dark Knights had sent out an invitation regarding some research. God Qiu went there to participate in a learning exchange.”
Fang Heng thought to himself, “Good guy, he’s involved in a professional seminar.”
D*mn!
Fang Heng slapped his forehead, feeling a little regretful.
Why didn’t Qiu Yaokang say so earlier!
If he had known earlier, he would have asked Qiu Yaokang to bring more gifts there and trick a few more researchers from the Dark Knights to come back... “Huh? Li Bo, didn’t you go?”
“Go out? Stop joking. It’s so dangerous outside. Wouldn’t it be courting death if I went out?”
Li Bo shrunk his neck as he spoke.
“Oh, no. I mean, the research cannot stop. God Qiu is not around. I have to be responsible for the entire experiment’s records. The laboratory cannot do without
me.”
“Cough cough...”
Fang Heng coughed lightly. He was too embarrassed to expose him.
Li Bo was afraid of death. He was still thin-skinned. Saying a few words about him would lose his loyalty again...
“What have you been researching recently?”.

Li Bo was holding a document that he was looking through. “Licker modification. The first phase of the clinical trial is very good. We are already preparing for the second phase of the trial. We have already preliminarily developed the related Licker modified T-virus. It is estimated that we will be able to carry out the second phase of the clinical trial in a week.”
Great!
There was no doubt about the Licker’s combat ability. If they were able to expand their mass production, the strength of a large group of Lickers gathered together would be astonishing!
If more ants could kill an elephant, a few hundred Lickers could go up together and a Tier 4 creature definitely wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
A Tier 5 creature would most likely be in a difficult situation too!
“We still encountered quite a several technical difficulties that need to be overcome.”
Li Bo nodded and said, “When God Qiu left, he instructed that if you’re free, Boss, you can help speed up our research progress.”
“Come on!”
Fang Heng knew that this was the mission. He was ready to do something big.
(Hint: Player triggered mission-Experiment: Licker modification.]
Optional mission 1: High-precision parts modification.
Mission description: Find special high-precision parts, improve laboratory hardware, improve laboratory environment and increase research speed (click here for details).
Optional mission 2: Licker research.
Mission description: Collect more Licker samples (this sample will be obtained by killing the Licker).
Optional mission 3: Staff expansion.
Mission description: Your laboratory needs more researchers to improve research efficiency, look for a high-level researcher to join your shelter.
Optional mission 4: T-virus resources.
Mission description: Look for more initial T-virus.
Optional mission 5: High-efficiency raw materials.
Mission description: Your laboratory needs more efficient experimental materials. Please try to collect them (click here to see the details).
Accepted!
Fang Heng waved his hand and accepted all the missions.
There was no penalty for failure in this type of mission anyway.
Fang Heng was in high spirits.
He had been trying to level up in the shelter for a while and now he was fully focused on building a Tier 3 space tearing device.
He had time to focus on the Licker modification!
Fang Heng carefully checked the missions he had received
One step at a time, he put aside the resource-related missions. Currently, all the resources in the shelter had been invested in the construction of the space tearing device.
So, the first task was to collect and kill monsters.
Kill the Licker!
This task was good.
“Unfortunately, I can’t kill my Licker clones to complete the task.”
Fang Heng felt a bit disappointed that he couldn’t exploit this bug.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - Poaching
paragraphs: Currently, Mo Jiawei was flying back and forth in a helicopter to Paradise Island to build a space tearing device. He also needed to collect various materials to build a Tier 3 space tearing device.
Liao Bufan was staying in the shelter to welcome the players who would participate in the next Blood Moon and deal with the players who delivered ores every day...
They couldn’t get away.
He had to do it himself.
However, where should he find the Lickers?
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng had an answer.
“Go find the Dark Knights. They should have a mission related to killing the Lickers.”
Fang Heng was glad that his shelter had completed the space tearing device. It was much easier to travel.
The Dark Knights had dozens of strongholds, as long as he searched one by one, he could surely find a mission related to the Lickers!
Speaking of which, the Dark Knights also had a research team.
If they sold elite mercenary groups to the outside world, would they also sell research personnel to the outside world?
Maybe they did!
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
It was time to go and pick a bunch of Dark Knights’ wool!
“Hi, David.”
“Fang Heng.”
At the Dark Knights’ branch, David did not seem to be in a good mood.
“What’s wrong? You look tired. Didn’t sleep well?”
Fang Heng took out a bottle of melatonin from his backpack and handed it over. “Try this.”
(Hint: Your friendship with David has increased.]
“Thank you. I haven’t been able to sleep for the past two days.” David sighed softly as he spoke.
“The first-generation meteorite has been destroyed. It’s too difficult to repair the meteorite. The Dark Knights have decided to temporarily give up on this clue and try to find another way.”
Fang Heng patted David’s shoulder. “It’s okay. I’ll help with the investigation. My luck has always been good.”
“Haha, you’re right.”
David braced himself.
“There will always be a way. This operation on Paradise Island was not a fruitless one. At least we found a large amount of Water of Life on the island.”
save 1
more
“With the Water of Life, we can save more lives. The survival ability of the Dark Knights’ battle teams will also be greatly improved.”
As David spoke, he seemed to have thought of something and called out to Fang Heng.

“Oh right, Fang Heng, you came at the right time. The previous mission on Paradise Island has been completed. The rewards have not been settled with you yet. Also, the information about Tsugawa Hideharu’s pupa project last time provided us with a lot of help in our research.”
(Hint: You have received the mission-pupa project reward. You have received 5000 Dark Knights’ honor points.]
(Hint: You have received part of the main storyline mission reward. You have received 1500 Dark Knights’ honor points.]
It was too little, not enough to spend.
In total, it was only 6500 points.
Fang Heng was currently worrying about resources.
6,500 points could only buy a small portion of rare ores that were difficult to obtain from the Dark Knights.
It was no wonder that the reward was small.
On this trip to Paradise Island, the first-generation meteorite that was needed for the final mission had not been found.
Fang Heng checked the mission log and asked, “David, there has been no news from the Meteorite Company? Could they have left a sample of the first-generation meteorite?”
“Yes, we have considered this and have been investigating for a long time.”

“According to our investigation, after the initial outbreak of the biochemical crisis, the top management of the Meteorite Company seemed to have disappeared overnight. We couldn’t find any news at all.”
Fang Heng spread his hands.
“Alright then, David. Recently, did the Dark Knights have any missions related to the Licker? Well, I’ve been in a bad mood recently and want to find trouble with the Lickers.”
“Huh?”
David was slightly surprised.
He then nodded and said, “Yes, I will help you make a list later. It will be easier to look for missions at the contact points of the Dark Knights.”
“Thank you, David. Also, do you Dark Knights want to look for a researcher in the future?”
“Fang Heng, the researcher that we train is very rare. We don’t have enough for ourselves. If you can help me find him, we are willing to provide a large number of honor points as a reward.”
Speaking of this, David felt much better. “For example, research personnel, Qiu Yaokang. Our researchers praise him very much... We are willing to provide a large number of honor points...”
“This... Qiu Yaokang, let’s forget about it...”
Fang Heng was silent.
He thought, “Good guy, the older one is usually the wiser one. I didn’t poach any researchers from you, but you’re thinking of poaching my researcher!”
Fang Heng felt that way after hearing David’s comments.
Huh?
Wait, poached?!
In an instant, Fang Heng had a flash of inspiration.
“Dad, I’ve been looking for you for a long time. Colonel Barker is looking for you. The team is about to set off, and the allocated materials are missing two boxes of special combat uniforms.”
Qiao Ling hurriedly walked in from the door. “Oh, no, I forgot. Qiao Ling, help me take care of Fang Heng.”
David said to Fang Heng, “I’m sorry, Fang Heng, I have something urgent to deal with.”
“It’s nothing, go do your work!”
Fang Heng raised his head and looked at Qiao Ling with a wicked gaze.
What a coincidence!
David was not easy to fool, Qiao Ling seemed to be quite innocent...
Qiao Ling’s eyes were very big, like a manga character. She noticed that Fang Heng was staring at her, which was quite strange.
“Fang Heng, is there anything I can help you with?”
“Hi, Qiao Ling, I need to check all the missions issued by all the Dark Knights’ contact points. Well, only those related to researchers, such as rescue missions, you can eliminate the others.”
“Eh, rescue mission?”
“Yes, can you find it?”
Qiao Ling turned on the central computer of the Dark Knights to check.
“There should be. Let me check. Our Dark Knights have a modified survival radio internet, and we can often find some information to ask for help.”
“I found it.”

“These recent missions are all related to scientific researchers, and many of them are in danger. Recently, our combat personnel have been in a shortage, and many rescue missions that are not urgent have been temporarily put on hold.”

Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
“Qiao Ling! That’s great! This is exactly what I need. I’ll accept all of these missions.”
With a wave of his hand, Fang Heng directly checked all of them and received them with one click.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - Poached!
paragraphs: “Chi-Chi! Chi!!”
At an abandoned factory outside the city.
Two Lickers were fighting fiercely.
Fang Heng and a few NPCs were standing in the central control room.
Through the surveillance screen, they could observe the tragic situation outside.
Terrifying!
The bloody scene made the NPCs pale.
Fang Heng set up a barbecue grill and sprinkled cumin on the skewers.
(Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker has killed a Licker. You have received 12 survival points. You have received a complete evolution crystal*1. Current mission completion rate: 35%.]
(Hint: You have completed a large skewer of meat. Your cooking skill experience points +1.]
“Don’t worry, the Lickers outside will all be settled soon. Come, come, come, eat the meat My speciality is cooking. It’s very delicious. Everyone, have a taste.”
Fang Heng distributed the skewers to everyone.
(Hint: Your friendship with Jiang Cheng, Song Shishi and Li Wen has increased slightly.]
The room was filled with the aroma of the roasted meat.
However, the scene on the monitor made everyone lose their appetite.
“Thank you.”
Jiang Cheng took the barbecued meat and took a bite.

The aroma of barbecued meat assailed everyone’s nostrils. The texture of the meat was mixed with the mellowness of the oil. The slightly charred skin greatly enhanced the sense of taste and satisfied the taste buds and hungry stomachs.
“Delicious!”
Song Shishi did not expect the barbecued meat to be so fragrant!

After the apocalypse, Jiang Cheng and the other survivors were trapped in the factory. They relied on instant noodles and canned food to fill their stomachs every day but the food was barely sufficient. Where could they be able to eat the food so deliciously as now?
“Thank you, Fang Heng. You saved us. If it weren’t for your Dark Knights, god knows how long we would have been trapped here.”
“What? Dark Knights?”
Fang Heng blinked at the NPCs.
“No, no, no. I think you’re mistaken. I’m here to welcome you on behalf of Paradise Island. If you’re willing, I hope you can join our Paradise Island shelter.”
Jiang Cheng and the other NPCs were stunned. They held the skewers and looked up at Fang Heng, confused.
“Aren’t you from the Dark Knights to bring us back?”

“Of course not. Have you heard of the prison? It has beautiful scenery and abundant materials. There are professional chefs to take care of three meals a day. There is also a special passage leading to an overseas island...”
“I promise to provide you with adequate protection.”
(Hint: Player is evaluating...)
(Hint: Evaluating the attractiveness of your shelter, your friendship with NPCs...]
“But, but...”
Jiang Cheng looked at his two companions and hesitated. “But, Fang Heng, we have agreed to join the Dark Knights...” “Is that so... Sorry, I didn’t know about this beforehand.”
Fang Heng shook his head and looked troubled.
“Alright, then I suggest that you consider it.”
As Fang Heng said that, the two Lickers slowly climbed out of the shadows behind him.
“After all, it’s very dangerous to run to the Dark Knights from here. You might be threatened by zombies halfway...”
Jiang Cheng’s face turned slightly pale. Before he could speak, Song Shishi covered his mouth.
“Mr Fang Heng, Jiang Cheng means that he is willing!”

Li Wen nodded like a chicken pecking at rice, “Fang Heng, we are very happy to join your shelter. We hope that under your leadership, we can contribute our greatest strength to the construction of the shelter.”
Jiang Cheng struggled for a moment and silently accepted reality.
(Hint: Jiang Cheng (Speciality: Research; Character evaluation: A-; Loyalty: 63) joins your shelter.]
(Hint: Song Shishi (Speciality: Research; Character evaluation: C+; Loyalty: 87) joins your shelter.]
(Hint: Li Wen (Speciality: Mercenary; Character evaluation: B; Loyalty: 72) joins your shelter.)
(Hint: Your shelter’s research level has increased.]
(Hint: Your shelter’s research efficiency has increased slightly.]
“That’s great! I knew it! We hit it off the moment we met.”
Hahaha! Success!
Fang Heng was overjoyed.
He was simply thrilled to poach others!
After all, it was a game, and Fang Heng did not have any psychological burden when it came to taking advantage of the game’s features.
Of course, it would be best if he could poach Old Black.
Fang Heng was still very vengeful about the main storyline mission.
He roughly looked at the attributes of the NPCs.
Their attributes were not bad. A-level researcher was relatively rare.
Initial loyalty was only 63, which was very low.
Fang Heng was not afraid.
His shelter had many benefits.
As long as he stayed for a few days, the NPC’s loyalty would increase.
He had to trick them back!
Fang Heng checked the situation outside the factory again.
“Most of the Lickers outside have been cleared. I’ll take you back first. I promise that you’ll love the environment there.”
Jiang Cheng sighed. He felt that the meat in his hands was not fragrant anymore.
“Let’s hope so.”
(Hint: Your mission-escort team failed. 300 Dark Knights’ honor points deducted.]
Only 300 points?
300 points for an A-level NPC with two complimentary items?
Hahaha!
He made a profit!!
Fang Heng was in high spirits. He was not sleepy at all.
Under Fang Heng’s escort, Jiang Cheng and the others were brought back to the prison shelter.
The thick city walls and sentry tower gave Jiang Cheng and the others a great shock.
A private shelter?
No, it looked more like a fortress rebuilt after a disaster!
After entering the prison and registering, Jiang Cheng received his personal toiletries materials and a few sets of clothes. He took a comfortable hot bath.
After the apocalypse, this was the first time Jiang Cheng stayed in a quiet single room.
Hot food was already on the table.
For a moment, Jiang Cheng was in a daze.
This living environment was much better than he had expected.
Since he had come, he should just take it in stride.
(Hint: Jiang Cheng’s loyalty has increased to 78. There is still a chance that he will leave your shelter by himself. Please take note...]
Five in the morning, Dongxi District.
Fang Heng spent almost an entire night bringing two batches of NPCs back to the shelter.
The plan was the same.
It was just a lie!
Initial loyalty was not important.
As long as the NPCs were lured back home, their loyalty would quickly increase.
After all, the treatment provided by the prison was very good.
Fang Heng was very confident about this.
He sat in front of a bonfire and checked the status of the zombie team.
The third task on hand was more troublesome. He needed to dig through the construction site that had been buried by the explosion.
There were a few survivors trapped below.
Fang Heng didn’t need to do it himself. A group of zombies were slowly digging with shovels.
As he waited in boredom, a red game hint flashed across his vision.
(Hint: Your apocalypse radio has received an emergency message.]
Eh? A message from the survival radio?
Fang Heng was stunned for a moment.
Strange, the range for the personal survival radio to receive messages was extremely small. This was also Dongxi District, so there shouldn’t be many good friends here.
Who sent this message to him?

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - Promotion Quota
paragraphs: Fang Heng turned on his survival radio.

Hao Zhou: “Fang Heng, We’ve encountered a great deal of trouble. If you happen to see it now and are still willing to help me, leave your contact information in real life immediately. I’ll contact you within 10 minutes after receiving the news, thank you, sorry to bother you.”
It’s Hao Zhou! He’s also in Dongxi District!
Fang Heng immediately recalled.
When he had just entered the game, he had unintentionally accepted Old Black’s request on the internet and joined Hao Zhou’s team to enter Hope Town to complete the mission.
They had not interacted for long, but Fang Heng felt that Hao Zhou was a very reliable leader.

After the incident in Hope Town, Hao Zhou had also taken the initiative to stay behind to settle the matter. After receiving the King of Gods’ points from the Federation, he immediately split the loot.
He alone took on all the responsibility and accepted the Federation’s investigation.
Fang Heng estimated that it would take two to three hours for the zombie team to dig the passage.
Since he was available, he could provide help to Hao Zhou.
Thinking of this, Fang Heng immediately sent his contact information to survival radio.
Then, he threw down a sleeping bag and went offline.
Dongxi District.
In an abandoned hut.
Hao Zhou’s team of four sat around the bonfire.
The entire team was shrouded in a sense of despair.
From yesterday until now, they had searched for every possible way to complete the mission.
But they couldn’t!
They also sought the help of many people.
After everyone heard about their mission objective, they tactfully rejected it.
On one hand, the mission requirements were extremely difficult. On the other hand, this mission would cause them to become enemies with another big game company called Krontgen.
Very few people were willing to do this.
Just now, Hao Zhou and the others tried again.
They still failed.
There were less than 10 hours left before the end of the mission. They decided to give it their all and look for their friends via the survival radio.
However, five minutes had passed and they did not receive any reply from anyone.
Suddenly, a pleasant surprise broke the silence.
“It’s Fang Heng!”
Hao Zhou could not help but shout out because he was too shocked.
Kun Ba and Kun Ta were stunned at first, and then they were pleasantly surprised.
There was a glimmer of hope in this desperate situation!
They did not expect to actually contact Fang Heng. During this period, Fang Heng’s prison shelter was the talk of the town in District 8’s forum.
It was just too famous!
Like the others, Sister Li’s eyes flashed with surprise.
But soon, the excitement faded.
“Will Fang Heng help us? He’s doing well in the game now. Will it affect him if he goes against Krontgen?”
Hearing this, they fell silent again.
Hao Zhou said, “It’s okay. I believe that Fang Heng has his own judgment. It’s normal that he doesn’t want to get involved in this mess. Now that we have this opportunity, we have to give it a try.”
Kun Ba nodded in agreement. “Yes, give it a
try.”
“I’ll go offline now to contact Fang Heng. You guys take care of the situation first.”
After saying that, Hao Zhou threw down the simple bed and hurriedly went offline.
Not long after he went offline, Fang Heng received a call on his phone.
“Fang Heng? It’s been a while. How are you?”
“Pretty good.”
Fang Heng added in his heart, “It would be even better if there was no one competing with me for the main storyline mission.”
“I heard that you’ve developed very well in the game. The forums are all discussing the prison shelter. When I first heard that the leader of the prison was you, I was really shocked.”
“Hahaha, it’s luck, I have good luck.”
Fang Heng humbled himself.
“No, I believe this isn’t luck. The last time I saw you, I felt it. With your ability, it’s only a matter of time before you obtain such a result.”

After a few words of praise, Hao Zhou continued, “Fang Heng, we’ve encountered a mission this time. It’s very troublesome and might bring you trouble, so don’t force it. If you refuse after listening to it, we can understand.”
Fang Heng’s expression turned serious.
“Okay, go ahead.”
At first, Fang Heng thought it was just a normal mission and thought it would be convenient to help.
“Fang Heng, you know the company Krontgen, right?”
Fang Heng raised an eyebrow. “Is it related to them?”
“Krontgen is one of the first large companies to establish a shelter in the game. They have the support of the twelve corporations.”
“Twelve corporations. In the Northern Federation, the twelve corporations are very powerful.”
Fang Heng asked, “What about the specifics? Did you have a conflict with them?”
“It wasn’t a conflict, but there was friction with the mission. Some time ago, after a series of pre-mission conditions, we received a high-difficulty mission.”
“The mission required us to find a way to enter a city and safely retrieve a sculpture from there.”
Hao Zhou shook his head and sighed. “After our field investigation, we discovered that the target location, Yin City, has been declared occupied by Krontgen Company.”
Fang Heng understood the situation.
It was very common for a guild to declare the ownership of an area in the game. Their prison had also declared that they had occupied 28 areas in one go.
After all, there were only so many resources. Whoever had the biggest share would be the strongest.
Normally, when players encountered something like this, they would most likely sneak in to complete the mission.
As long as they were careful, they would be fine as long as they were not discovered.
“What happened after that?”
“The Krontgen Company has a very tight security around Yin City. We tried to sneak into Yin City a few times, but the effect was not very good.”

“It was not easy to succeed once, but the follow-up to the mission required the sculpture to be taken out of Yin City. The sculpture was too big, and it was difficult to hide it, so the mission was quite troublesome.”
Fang Heng nodded and roughly understood the mission’s goal.
He felt that the mission difficulty wasn’t too high, and he didn’t take the Krontgen Company to heart.
“How about the mission reward?”
Speaking of this, Hao Zhou’s mood rose a bit.
“Fang Heng, the mission reward is the promotion quota!”
Fang Heng was a bit disappointed.
He wasn’t interested in the game promotion quota, and he had already obtained the quota.
Hao Zhou continued to explain.
“It’s a special quota, a special quota that can increase the number of resurrections!”
Fang Heng suddenly understood.
In the game, there were two kinds of promotion quotas, one was the normal quota.
After a player received a hint from the game that he could be promoted, he could exit the elementary game world and enter the intermediate game world.
This kind of normal promotion method only had a fixed reward, which was a free five-year offline time. In theory, a player could stay offline for five consecutive years.
There was also a special quota.
Special quotas had all sorts of effects.
The common ones would be giving players an extra three to thirty years of free offline time or giving players a 60-day increase in all attribute percentages after entering an intermediate game.
The mission reward that Hao Zhou received was relatively rare. It could be considered one of the more powerful ones.
After entering the intermediate game for a period of time, after death, one could be resurrected for free and the number of deaths would not be counted.
For players, this extra reward would allow them to integrate into the intermediate game world faster and better.

Hao Zhou: “Fang Heng, We’ve encountered a great deal of trouble.
If you happen to see it now and are still willing to help me, leave your contact information in real life immediately.
I’ll contact you within 10 minutes after receiving the news, thank you, sorry to bother you.”
It’s Hao Zhou!
He’s also in Dongxi District!
Fang Heng immediately recalled.
When he had just entered the game, he had unintentionally accepted Old Black’s request on the internet and joined Hao Zhou’s team to enter Hope Town to complete the mission.
They had not interacted for long, but Fang Heng felt that Hao Zhou was a very reliable leader.
After the incident in Hope Town, Hao Zhou had also taken the initiative to stay behind to settle the matter.
After receiving the King of Gods’ points from the Federation, he immediately split the loot.
He alone took on all the responsibility and accepted the Federation’s investigation.
Fang Heng estimated that it would take two to three hours for the zombie team to dig the passage.
Since he was available, he could provide help to Hao Zhou.
Thinking of this, Fang Heng immediately sent his contact information to survival radio.
Then, he threw down a sleeping bag and went offline.
Dongxi District.
In an abandoned hut.
Hao Zhou’s team of four sat around the bonfire.
The entire team was shrouded in a sense of despair.
From yesterday until now, they had searched for every possible way to complete the mission.
But they couldn’t!
They also sought the help of many people.
After everyone heard about their mission objective, they tactfully rejected it.
On one hand, the mission requirements were extremely difficult.
On the other hand, this mission would cause them to become enemies with another big game company called Krontgen.
Very few people were willing to do this.
Just now, Hao Zhou and the others tried again.
They still failed.
There were less than 10 hours left before the end of the mission.
They decided to give it their all and look for their friends via the survival radio.
However, five minutes had passed and they did not receive any reply from anyone.
Suddenly, a pleasant surprise broke the silence.
“It’s Fang Heng!”
Hao Zhou could not help but shout out because he was too shocked.
Kun Ba and Kun Ta were stunned at first, and then they were pleasantly surprised.
There was a glimmer of hope in this desperate situation!
They did not expect to actually contact Fang Heng.
During this period, Fang Heng’s prison shelter was the talk of the town in District 8’s forum.
It was just too famous!
Like the others, Sister Li’s eyes flashed with surprise.
But soon, the excitement faded.
“Will Fang Heng help us?
He’s doing well in the game now.
Will it affect him if he goes against Krontgen?”
Hearing this, they fell silent again.
Hao Zhou said, “It’s okay.
I believe that Fang Heng has his own judgment.
It’s normal that he doesn’t want to get involved in this mess.
Now that we have this opportunity, we have to give it a try.”
Kun Ba nodded in agreement.
“Yes, give it a
try.”
“I’ll go offline now to contact Fang Heng.
You guys take care of the situation first.”
After saying that, Hao Zhou threw down the simple bed and hurriedly went offline.

“Fang Heng?
It’s been a while.
How are you?”
“Pretty good.”
Fang Heng added in his heart, “It would be even better if there was no one competing with me for the main storyline mission.”
“I heard that you’ve developed very well in the game.
The forums are all discussing the prison shelter.
When I first heard that the leader of the prison was you, I was really shocked.”
“Hahaha, it’s luck, I have good luck.”
Fang Heng humbled himself.
“No, I believe this isn’t luck.
The last time I saw you, I felt it.
With your ability, it’s only a matter of time before you obtain such a result.”
After a few words of praise, Hao Zhou continued, “Fang Heng, we’ve encountered a mission this time.
It’s very troublesome and might bring you trouble, so don’t force it.
If you refuse after listening to it, we can understand.”
Fang Heng’s expression turned serious.
“Okay, go ahead.”
At first, Fang Heng thought it was just a normal mission and thought it would be convenient to help.
“Fang Heng, you know the company Krontgen, right?”

“Is it related to them?”
“Krontgen is one of the first large companies to establish a shelter in the game.
They have the support of the twelve corporations.”

In the Northern Federation, the twelve corporations are very powerful.”

Did you have a conflict with them?”
“It wasn’t a conflict, but there was friction with the mission.
Some time ago, after a series of pre-mission conditions, we received a high-difficulty mission.”
“The mission required us to find a way to enter a city and safely retrieve a sculpture from there.”
Hao Zhou shook his head and sighed.
“After our field investigation, we discovered that the target location, Yin City, has been declared occupied by Krontgen Company.”
Fang Heng understood the situation.
It was very common for a guild to declare the ownership of an area in the game.
Their prison had also declared that they had occupied 28 areas in one go.
After all, there were only so many resources.
Whoever had the biggest share would be the strongest.
Normally, when players encountered something like this, they would most likely sneak in to complete the mission.
As long as they were careful, they would be fine as long as they were not discovered.

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - Art Gallery
paragraphs: However, Fang Heng was still not very interested in this.
A higher level game?
He was not interested. After he completed the main storyline of Zombie Apocalypse, wouldn’t it be nice for him to take over the world?
However, since he was helping out, he didn’t care so much.
If a slot was available, it would be good if he could get one. Hao Zhou continued, “Also, according to the completion rate of the mission, it might be possible to get a skill book.”
Skill book!?
This was good!
Fang Heng immediately nodded and agreed.
“I’m in. Where are you now? Give me the coordinates and I’ll meet up with you guys. We’ll talk about the details of the mission when we get back to the game.”
“Okay, we’re in Dongxi District, outside Yin City (3871, 2938).”
Hao Zhou suppressed the excitement in his heart and reported the coordinates.
“There are still a large number of zombies in Yin City. We need to be ready for battle.”
“No problem.”
The two hung up the phone and went online.
After going online, Fang Heng controlled the zombie clones to meet up at the coordinates of Yin City and rode the motorcycle alone.
Since there was a possibility of a war with the Krontgen Company this time, he had to display his abilities.
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng returned to the Dark Knights’ contact point and took back the three Tyrants and all the Licker combat units from the shelter.
Under the cover of the night, the zombie army was quickly assembled.
Fang Heng climbed onto the vine chair that extended behind the Tyrant form.
“Let’s go, let’s go!” The three Tyrants took big strides and stepped onto the wide main road.
Behind them, a layer of Lickers was lying on the ground, crawling quickly...
“Fang Heng has promised that he will participate in our mission!”
They got help!
After knowing that Fang Heng would participate, everyone felt at ease. The two brothers, Kun Ba and Kun Ta, even high-fived each other.
They felt that this mission seemed to have been completed by more than half.
The news of Fang Heng’s arrival revived the stagnant team.
Before Fang Heng arrived, everyone discussed the follow-up plan.

Hao Zhou thought for a while and said, “Fang Heng can control part of the zombies to fight. Last time, when we cooperated with him, he used the zombie team to open the sewer. This time, we might be able to use the sewer as an entrance.”

“Maybe it doesn’t need to be so troublesome,” Sister Li added, “I heard that Fang Heng’s Prison Army can control the Lickers. If It’s true, then we can deal with the guards outside the city and force our way into Yin City. We can take advantage of the fact that the Krontgen Company doesn’t have time to react then seize the statue and retreat quickly.” Kun Ba was excited and waved his hand excitedly.
“Yes, yes, yes, Lickers. I’ve seen the video of Lucia from the Dark Knights. It’s amazing.”
“Don’t be too excited. I heard that the one controlling the Licker isn’t Fang Heng, but a high-level NPC from the Dark Knights.”
Hao Zhou smiled bitterly. “The forum is too deep. We can’t tell if it’s real or fake. This part about controlling the Licker is too mysterious.”
Everyone was discussing excitedly when they suddenly stopped at the same time.
Bang! Bang! Bang!!
Outside the residence, heavy footsteps approached from afar.
“What’s that sound?”
“Let’s go outside and take a look.”
Everyone immediately picked up their weapons and left the temporary residence to investigate.
Outside the door of the temporary residence, Fang Heng stood there casually.
Behind him, three Tyrants stood side by side.
Just standing there gave people a sense of oppression.
Everyone looked at Fang Heng and remained silent for a long time.
“Long time no see, guys.”
Fang Heng waved at Hao Zhou and the others.
“What’s wrong? Why’s everyone so quiet? Aren’t you happy to see me?”
As Fang Heng spoke, he took out a few bottles of beer from his backpack and threw one bottle to everyone.
Hao Zhou took the beer, opened the bottle cap and gulped down a mouthful.
It was the Tyrant!
When he first saw it, he wondered if he was hallucinating
Kun Ba still couldn’t believe it. He asked, “Fang Heng, are you the one controlling this Tyrant form?”
“That’s right. The opponent is a little strong this time, so I have brought out all my trump cards.”
Fang Heng patted the Tyrant form’s shoulder as he spoke. “Hao Zhou said that we should be prepared for battle. We should seek stability,
right?”
“This...”
Hao Zhou did not know what to say for a moment.
“This is too stable.”
The two brothers, Kun Ba and Kun Ta, looked at each other and swallowed their saliva at the same time.
Just now, they were discussing whether the Licker that they saw in the forum was real.
Now it seemed that Hao Zhou was right.
The forum was too deep.
Not a single word of truth.
Licker?
Where did that come from?
The Tyrant under Fang Heng’s control was the most ruthless!
At first, Sister Li also had an expression of disbelief, but she quickly came back to her senses.
Now that the team had the help of the Tyrant, their combat ability had increased by more than half.
“Everyone, there are still more than seven hours left until the mission is completed. We need to speed up.”
Hao Zhou said as he submitted a mission invitation.
“Time is tight. Let’s talk as we walk.”
(Hint: Player Hao Zhou is sharing a mission with you-Heart of the Apocalypse.)
Mission name: Heart of the Apocalypse.
Mission difficulty: S.

Mission description: Sandy Nelen is the curator of the art gallery in Yin City. When the apocalypse came, his collection was also left in the art gallery in Yin City. He hopes that you can think of a way to preserve these treasures of human civilization.
Mission requirements: Sandy Nelen needs you to take out the sculpture, the Heart of the Apocalypse, from the art museum in Yin City and bring it back to the apocalypse merchant camp.
Additional mission reward: Rescue as many artworks as possible from Yin City.
Mission event remaining: 7 hours and 12 minutes.
(Description: The completeness of the transferred item, the quantity and value of the item will affect the final mission evaluation.)
Fang Heng looked at the mission description and raised his head. “Alright, we’ll set off now!”
Dawn arrived.
Hao Zhou and his group rode their bicycles and quickly headed towards Yin City.
Hao Zhou gave an introduction of the mission to Fang Heng.
“A few days ago, we received a mission from a down-and-out NPC. After completing a series of prerequisite missions, we got to know Sandy and obtained the final mission from him.”
“After receiving the mission, we immediately went to Yin City to investigate. We didn’t expect that Yin City had already been completely controlled by the Krontgen Company.”
“Later, we also tried to negotiate with the Krontgen Company and offered to enter the city to complete the mission. However, we were rejected.”
Sister Li explained, “We have made many tactical models. With the ability of our team, infiltrating the city’s art museum is completely feasible.”
“The biggest difficulty of the mission is how to evacuate from the city.”
“The Heart of the Apocalypse is a large-scale sculpture. It’s already very troublesome to take the sculpture away from the city under the siege of the zombie horde in Yin City.”
“Now we have Krontgen Company in the picture.”
“Their people have set up sentries at the periphery of Yin City. If we come out of the city, they will notice us.”
“At that time, they will attack us.”
Fang Heng understood.
He roughly understood the difficulty of this mission.

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - Flatten
paragraphs: “Fang Heng, do you have any ideas?”
Ideas? Of course, he was going to attack!
Fang Heng’s words were on the tip of his tongue, but he felt that he had been a little reckless recently.
“What about you guys? Any suggestions?” “How about the sewer?”

Hao Zhou and the others had originally planned to borrow Fang Heng’s strength and use the sewer to find a way to sneak into the city without anyone noticing. Then, they would move the sculpture out of the sewer.
As for the survival rules of the sewer... that would depend on Fang Heng.
An ordinary player really couldn’t learn it!
“Eh, sewer... Let’s see the details.”
Everyone rushed to the outside of Yin City and temporarily settled down in an abandoned building to make a battle plan.
Fang Heng looked at the sewer map that Hao Zhou had collected beforehand and shook his head, “No.”

“The sculpture is too big. If we use the sewer as our exit pass, we have to think of a way to widen the sewer entrance. If we are not careful, the exhibits will be damaged and this will affect the completion rate of the final mission.”

“Secondly, the construction of the city’s sewer does not extend too far away from Yin City. After coming out of the passage, we will still be at risk of being discovered by the player from the Krontgen Company.”

Fang Heng pondered and continued, “Last but not least, it’s also the most troublesome. If we want to move out all the artworks in the gallery, it will take a lot of time. It’s too slow to transport them through the sewer.”
It was still alright when they heard the first part. When they heard Fang Heng say that he wanted to move out all the artworks in the gallery, everyone fell silent and looked at each other.
Kun Ba and Kun Ta’s eyes lit up.
Move out all the artworks in the gallery...
This plan was simply too brilliant!
Hao Zhou coughed lightly and focused everyone’s attention.
“Fang Heng, do you have a better idea?”.
“Indeed, I have a better idea. I don’t think there’s a need to go through so much trouble.”
Fang Heng looked at everyone and announced the boorish plan that he had long prepared.
“Why don’t we do it the hard way?”
“The hard way? What do you mean?”
“Simple.”
Fang Heng raised his head and looked at the shadows of the sentry tower in the distance. He said slowly, “Flatten them.”
Flatten... did this mean war?
A formal war with the Krontgen Company!?
With just a short sentence, Kun Ba and Kun Ta were immediately filled with fighting
spirit.
Before this, they had also been bullied by the Krontgen Company. Now, with the help of Fang Heng’s zombie team, they could compete with the Krontgen Company.
“Use the Tyrant to flatten them,” Fang Heng said and patted Hao Zhou’s shoulder, “Don’t be so serious. Didn’t you say to get ready to fight?”
Hao Zhou opened his mouth, but didn’t say anything for a long time.
Indeed, he had asked Fang Heng to get ready for battle, but he didn’t want Fang Heng to flatten the entire Krontgen Company at that time...
Fang Heng looked around the team and asked, “How is it? Do you have any other plans?”
The two brothers, Kun Ba and Kun Ta, shook their heads first.
What other plans could there be? Wasn’t it just a competition of size?
Whoever had the biggest fist would listen to the other. It would be reckless but that’s how things work.

“Okay, let’s move out immediately. I will lead the Tyrant to attack the sentry tower and the shelter of the Krontgen Company. The Lickers will follow you to the art gallery in Yin City. When the time comes, we will meet in the art gallery.”
“Can you do it alone? Do you want some people to go with you?”
“No need. It will be troublesome if there are too many people.”
After a few simple discussions, Fang Heng waved his hand and gave the order to Tyrant to attack.
Start from the two most conspicuous sentry towers!
It was a game after all, so it was just one fight after another.
Fang Heng did not have the slightest psychological burden.
Today, the world was divided into four major Federations, collectively known as the Global Federation, which was controlled by the Federal Central Assembly.
Fang Heng’s position belonged to the Eastern Federation.
He had heard from Mo Jiawei that the twelve corporations belonging to the Northern Federation had never been on good terms with North River Heavy Industry.
Even during the Vampire Apocalypse, North River Heavy Industry had been suppressed by them.
In short, the Krontgen Company was an enemy. The Tyrant form strode forward and approached the sentry tower.
Fang Heng found a hidden corner.
He was going to hide in the dark and secretly trick them.
On the sentry tower, the player in charge of guarding the Krontgen Company had just finished the shift.
As usual, it was another peaceful day.
The player on duty, Zhang Yun, took out some reading materials that he had prepared long ago to pass the day.
Yin City was a remote place. There was a large number of zombies in the city, so very few people would come here.
Zhang Yun stretched and raised his head.
He suddenly saw a small black dot in the distance.
What was that?
Zhang Yun rubbed his eyes.
The black dot gradually approached the tower.
It was getting bigger and bigger. What the hell!?
Zombies?
Tyrant?
Three!
Where did they come from?
Oh no! They were coming for the sentry tower!
Zhang Yun’s hair stood on end and he suddenly jumped up from his chair.
In his panic, he picked up a shotgun and aimed it at the Tyrant’s head.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!!” Three shots in a row, one shot to the head and two shots to the shoulder.
The Tyrant was not affected at all. On the contrary, it sped up a bit and strode towards the sentry tower.
Zhang Yun’s back was soaked in a layer of cold sweat.
In an instant, he realized that his brain must have been fried.
Was he thinking of using a hunting rifle to fight the Tyrant alone?
Seeing the Tyrant rapidly approaching the sentry tower, Zhang Yun immediately stuffed the hunting rifle back into his backpack and turned around to flee.
If the sentry tower was finished, then it was finished. He could not risk his life!
At the bottom of the sentry tower, the Tyrant quickly approached. It raised its huge fist and smashed it towards the sentry tower.
“Boom!!”
When its fist landed on the sentry tower, the entire sentry tower shook heavily.
“Bang Bang!!! Bang!”
Seeing Tyrant punch the sentry tower several times in a row, Fang Heng, who was watching the battle from a distance, realized that something was not right.
What was going on? Why didn’t the sentry tower counterattack at all?
He took out his binoculars to take a closer look and saw that the player guards on the sentry tower had long disappeared without a trace.
“Tsk, they ran quite fast.”
Fang Heng curled his lips, showing no interest. He waved his hand to guide Tyrant to stop attacking the sentry tower and continue to attack the Krontgen Company’s shelter behind.
“Enemy attack!!”
“Zombies! It’s the Tyrant!! Sound the alarm!!”
The entire camp was filled with ear-piercing
sirens.
“What’s the situation?”

It was just early in the morning and Krontgen Company’s shelter manager, Lope, was still sleeping outside the game. When he received the hint that the game shelter had been attacked, he was shocked and hurried back to the game.
“It’s Tyrant! The zombie tyrant has attacked our shelter!”
Listening to his subordinate’s report, Lope instantly woke up.
“Tyrant? Are you sure that’s the Tyrant?”
“It’s true. They are attacking the shelter!”
Lope pushed the player next to him and walked out of the shelter.
In the camp, three Tyrant forms were constantly waving their fists, attacking all the buildings within their sight.
Most of the players’ weapons were bows and arrows.
These wooden bows and arrows could not penetrate the Tyrant’s defense at all.
The Tyrant form did not even bother to counterattack the player, directly swinging its fists to demolish the house.
Cold sweat dripped down Lope’s cheeks.

sentences.text: “Fang Heng, do you have any ideas?”
Ideas?
Of course, he was going to attack!
Fang Heng’s words were on the tip of his tongue, but he felt that he had been a little reckless recently.
“What about you guys?
Any suggestions?” “How about the sewer?”
Hao Zhou and the others had originally planned to borrow Fang Heng’s strength and use the sewer to find a way to sneak into the city without anyone noticing.
Then, they would move the sculpture out of the sewer.
As for the survival rules of the sewer... that would depend on Fang Heng.
An ordinary player really couldn’t learn it!
“Eh, sewer...
Let’s see the details.”
Everyone rushed to the outside of Yin City and temporarily settled down in an abandoned building to make a battle plan.
Fang Heng looked at the sewer map that Hao Zhou had collected beforehand and shook his head, “No.”
“The sculpture is too big.
If we use the sewer as our exit pass, we have to think of a way to widen the sewer entrance.
If we are not careful, the exhibits will be damaged and this will affect the completion rate of the final mission.”
“Secondly, the construction of the city’s sewer does not extend too far away from Yin City.
After coming out of the passage, we will still be at risk of being discovered by the player from the Krontgen Company.”
Fang Heng pondered and continued, “Last but not least, it’s also the most troublesome.
If we want to move out all the artworks in the gallery, it will take a lot of time.
It’s too slow to transport them through the sewer.”
It was still alright when they heard the first part.
When they heard Fang Heng say that he wanted to move out all the artworks in the gallery, everyone fell silent and looked at each other.
Kun Ba and Kun Ta’s eyes lit up.
Move out all the artworks in the gallery...
This plan was simply too brilliant!
Hao Zhou coughed lightly and focused everyone’s attention.
“Fang Heng, do you have a better idea?”.
“Indeed, I have a better idea.
I don’t think there’s a need to go through so much trouble.”
Fang Heng looked at everyone and announced the boorish plan that he had long prepared.
“Why don’t we do it the hard way?”
“The hard way?
What do you mean?”
“Simple.”
Fang Heng raised his head and looked at the shadows of the sentry tower in the distance.
He said slowly, “Flatten them.”
Flatten... did this mean war?
A formal war with the Krontgen Company!?
With just a short sentence, Kun Ba and Kun Ta were immediately filled with fighting
spirit.
Before this, they had also been bullied by the Krontgen Company.
Now, with the help of Fang Heng’s zombie team, they could compete with the Krontgen Company.
“Use the Tyrant to flatten them,” Fang Heng said and patted Hao Zhou’s shoulder, “Don’t be so serious.
Didn’t you say to get ready to fight?”
Hao Zhou opened his mouth, but didn’t say anything for a long time.
Indeed, he had asked Fang Heng to get ready for battle, but he didn’t want Fang Heng to flatten the entire Krontgen Company at that time...
Fang Heng looked around the team and asked, “How is it?
Do you have any other plans?”
The two brothers, Kun Ba and Kun Ta, shook their heads first.
What other plans could there be?
Wasn’t it just a competition of size?
Whoever had the biggest fist would listen to the other.
It would be reckless but that’s how things work.
“Okay, let’s move out immediately.
I will lead the Tyrant to attack the sentry tower and the shelter of the Krontgen Company.
The Lickers will follow you to the art gallery in Yin City.
When the time comes, we will meet in the art gallery.”
“Can you do it alone?
Do you want some people to go with you?”
“No need.
It will be troublesome if there are too many people.”
After a few simple discussions, Fang Heng waved his hand and gave the order to Tyrant to attack.
Start from the two most conspicuous sentry towers!
It was a game after all, so it was just one fight after another.
Fang Heng did not have the slightest psychological burden.
Today, the world was divided into four major Federations, collectively known as the Global Federation, which was controlled by the Federal Central Assembly.
Fang Heng’s position belonged to the Eastern Federation.
He had heard from Mo Jiawei that the twelve corporations belonging to the Northern Federation had never been on good terms with North River Heavy Industry.
Even during the Vampire Apocalypse, North River Heavy Industry had been suppressed by them.
In short, the Krontgen Company was an enemy.
The Tyrant form strode forward and approached the sentry tower.
Fang Heng found a hidden corner.
He was going to hide in the dark and secretly trick them.
On the sentry tower, the player in charge of guarding the Krontgen Company had just finished the shift.
As usual, it was another peaceful day.
The player on duty, Zhang Yun, took out some reading materials that he had prepared long ago to pass the day.
Yin City was a remote place.
There was a large number of zombies in the city, so very few people would come here.
Zhang Yun stretched and raised his head.
He suddenly saw a small black dot in the distance.
What was that?
Zhang Yun rubbed his eyes.
The black dot gradually approached the tower.
It was getting bigger and bigger.
What the hell!?
Zombies?
Tyrant?
Three!
Where did they come from?
Oh no!
They were coming for the sentry tower!
Zhang Yun’s hair stood on end and he suddenly jumped up from his chair.
In his panic, he picked up a shotgun and aimed it at the Tyrant’s head.
“Bang!
Bang!
Bang!!” Three shots in a row, one shot to the head and two shots to the shoulder.
The Tyrant was not affected at all.
On the contrary, it sped up a bit and strode towards the sentry tower.
Zhang Yun’s back was soaked in a layer of cold sweat.
In an instant, he realized that his brain must have been fried.
Was he thinking of using a hunting rifle to fight the Tyrant alone?
Seeing the Tyrant rapidly approaching the sentry tower, Zhang Yun immediately stuffed the hunting rifle back into his backpack and turned around to flee.
If the sentry tower was finished, then it was finished.
He could not risk his life!
At the bottom of the sentry tower, the Tyrant quickly approached.
It raised its huge fist and smashed it towards the sentry tower.
“Boom!!”
When its fist landed on the sentry tower, the entire sentry tower shook heavily.
“Bang Bang!!!
Bang!”
Seeing Tyrant punch the sentry tower several times in a row, Fang Heng, who was watching the battle from a distance, realized that something was not right.

Sound the alarm!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - Escaped
paragraphs: Taking advantage of the chaos in the shelter, Hao Zhou led his team to the east gate of Yin City.
The entrance to the east gate of the city was blocked by an iron gate with a railing.
Through the gap in the railing, the team saw a dense crowd of zombies on the other side of the iron gate.
The zombies were immediately attracted by the smell of the players in the team and crowded toward the iron gate.
The old rusty iron gate kept creaking, which made people worry that it would not be able to withstand the pressure of the zombies and collapse.
The two brothers, Kun Ba and Kun Ta, put on their equipment and got ready for battle. Then, they turned around and looked at Hao Zhou.
“Captain, what should we do?”
Hao Zhou raised his binoculars and observed the inner part of Yin City for a moment, then quickly set up a plan.
“They’re all ordinary zombies, so they’re not a big threat.”
“I’ll set up explosives to make a hole and break through the iron gate. After that, Sister Li will activate the perception barrier. We’ll break into Yin City first.”
“The density of the zombie horde inside the city is much smaller than outside. When the time comes, we’ll just kill our way in and force our way into the art gallery.”
“Okay!”
Hao Zhou’s team had been cooperating for a long time, and they had a good understanding of each other.
“Help me cover for a while.”
Hao Zhou took out an explosive pack from his backpack as he spoke.
He was about to walk to the iron gate and plant the explosive pack. When the explosive blew up the iron gate, it would also get rid of the zombie horde.
“To blow up the iron gate and the zombie horde, we need two sets of small explosives...”
Hao Zhou muttered to himself as he walked forward, calculating in his mind.
“Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!!!”
He was distracted for a moment and several gusts of wind sounded in his ears.
“Chi Chi Chi...”
A few red shadows flew past him quickly.
What the hell!!!
Hao Zhou was shocked. He suddenly stopped in his tracks and looked over.
Dozens of Lickers flitted past him and pounced toward the iron railings.
They jumped high into the air and slashed their sharp claws across the air.
Ordinary zombies couldn’t stop a high-level hunter like the Licker!
The zombies were cut in half, and the rusty iron railings were cut into pieces by the sharp claws.
The iron gate was instantly torn open.
The Lickers immediately started killing the zombies before they even have time to break free from the iron gate.
The strong smell of blood stimulated the players’ nostrils.
In a short moment, the zombie horde was torn into pieces by the Lickers.
In a few minutes, no zombies were found standing at the east entrance of the city.
The Lickers carried out Fang Heng’s order faithfully. They continued to spread out into Yin City, looking for their next target.
“This...”
The scene before their eyes was too shocking and the depressing scene made Hao Zhou and the others momentarily at a loss.
Slaughtered?

Even though they had seen some prison soldiers controlling the Lickers in battle in the video before, now that they had witnessed it with their own eyes, the Lickers’ combat ability was much stronger than in the video!
Sister Li was extremely alarmed.
She was very sure that the Lickers that Fang Heng controlled were not ordinary!
Their various attribute abilities had been greatly improved compared to ordinary Lickers!
With these Lickers, it was only a matter of time before they cleared all the zombies in Yin City, let alone the ‘miscellaneous soldiers’ blocking the entrance!
In that case... the plan that they had laid out previously seemed to be completely useless?
Kun Ba and Kun Ta looked at each other, then turned their gazes to Hao Zhou at the same time.
Hao Zhou also stood at the same spot with mixed feelings in his heart.
How long had it been since they last met and Fang Heng’s strength had already risen to such a powerful level?
During this period, his entire team had been fighting day and night!
He believed that his strength had been completely transformed compared to a month ago.
Even if he could not be compared to Fang Heng, the gap wouldn’t be too big
But now that he’s aware of the Lickers’ ability...
Hao Zhou felt that the strength of the entire team wasn’t enough!
If he were to fight the Licker one-on-one right now, he would at most rely on the props to save his life.
“Captain, shouldn’t our plan...”
Seeing Hao Zhou freeze on the spot, Kun Ta walked up and patted his shoulder, using his mouth to signal the zombie horde that had already entered Yin City.
“Okay.”
Hao Zhou quickly adjusted his mood.
Fang Heng was his teammate. The stronger his teammate was, the happier he should be.
At least this mission was safe! “There’s a change of plan. We’ll follow the Lickers.”
Hao Zhou took a deep breath and said excitedly, “Together, we’ll charge in!”
(Hint: Your shelter has been attacked by a Tyrant. The shelter’s durability has decreased by 1,078. Please defend in time.]
(Hint: Your shelter is under attack. Please defend and repair in time... Once the shelter’s durability is reduced to zero...)
After leaving the shelter, Lope watched as the Tyrant madly swung its fist to punch the shelter. The veins on his forehead bulged.
“Leader, what should we do?”
“Are you idiots?!”
Lope could not help but shout at the player who was using the wooden bow and arrows to deal with the Tyrant, “Are you going to use the wooden arrows to kill the Tyrant?”
Seeing the confused player who stopped attacking with the wooden arrow, Lope was even angrier.
“Trash! A bunch of trash!”
“Forget about those Tyrants! Can you hold on?! Quickly load the valuable resources from the shelter into the vehicle!”
The players finally reacted.
“Retreat!”
“Go! Hurry up and leave!”
Lope gritted his teeth and stared at the two Tyrants who were close by.
Ordinary arrows and even firearms could not cause fatal damage to them.
Saving strength and reducing losses was the best solution.
But why? Why did the Tyrant target their shelter?
Lope could not figure this out.
Fang Heng was hiding under a tree far away from the shelter.
Fang Heng could not help but twitch his lips when he saw the player driving the truck out of the shelter.
“Trying to escape?” Tyrant hadn’t even flattened the place yet and he was already escaping?
He should have put up some resistance!
This was boring
Boring.
Fang Heng had originally thought that the other party would more or less resist, such as using King of Gods’ points to exchange for a rocket launcher or something.
Although the effect wasn’t great...
He didn’t think that he would surrender so quickly.
It was really boring.

Seeing that the Krontgen Company player was no longer a threat, Fang Heng left behind a Tyrant to continue demolishing the base, bringing the remaining two Tyrant forms into Yin City to provide support.
Yin City, art gallery.
Hao Zhou had already led his team to the second basement of the art gallery.
The strength of the Lickers was far beyond the imagination of the players in Hao Zhou’s team.
After the Lickers entered the city, they took the initiative to spread out and hunt down the zombie horde that wandered around Yin City.
The number of zombies in the entire city was greatly reduced!
Sister Li did not need to activate her perception barrier at all. The team killed a few zombies that they encountered along the way and quickly entered the art gallery.

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 9 Pack It Up
paragraphs: Considering that the Lickers would break into the art gallery and destroy the exhibits, Fang Heng did not choose to let the Lickers enter the art gallery.
Hao Zhou and the others felt that they were finally of some use in the mission.
According to the information provided by the curator, Sandy Nelen, the sculpture was in the vault on the second basement.
Hao Zhou immediately led the team to clean up the entire gallery and searched it thoroughly. It took a lot of effort to find the vault key on the third floor.
In the end, they took another big detour before opening the vault door.
The giant sculpture of the mission target, the Heart of the Apocalypse, was lying quietly in the center of the vault.
When they saw the mission target, the team of players looked at each other and fell into silence at the same time.
They had heard that the Heart of the Apocalypse was a large sculpture, but they had not expected it to be so big!
It was a full two and a half meters tall.
It looked like four or five young men would need to work together to lift it up.
How could such a large sculpture be moved out?
Hao Zhou asked, “How’s the cargo elevator?”
Kun Ba shook his head.
“It can’t be used. I’ve checked before. There’s no backup power supply in the art gallery, and the elevator can’t be activated unless we can find a generator to generate electricity ourselves.”
Hao Zhou suddenly felt a headache coming
on.
Where could he find a generator at this time?
He could only use the stairs to slowly transport it up with the help of the wooden planks.
Hao Zhou made a decision. “I’ll first think of a way to build a platform and transport the sculpture to the staircase.”
Although doing so was extremely inefficient, it seemed like this was the only solution at the moment.
The few of them immediately took action. They made a high-level wooden plank on the spot and installed rolling wheels under the wooden plank.
Finally, they tried to lift the large sculpture onto the wooden plank.
“Three, two, one,”
Hao Zhou’s face flushed red and the veins on his neck bulged.
However, the entire sculpture did not move at
all!
“No, it’s still too heavy.”
Hao Zhou panted heavily and said, “Don’t force it. It’ll be more troublesome if we break the statue.”.
“Let me try this.”
Kun Ba took out a bottle of short-term strength-enhancement potions with negative effects from his backpack.
Just as he was about to drink the potion, heavy footsteps came from the pathway on the second basement.
“Bang, Bang...”
Everyone was alert and raised their guns to aim at the passage.
As the footsteps approached, a huge shadow appeared at the passage entrance.
It was the Tyrant!

Fang Heng jumped down from the Tyrant’s back and came in front of everyone. “Fang Heng? You’re back!” Seeing that it was the Tyrant that Fang Heng controlled, Hao Zhou was obviously relieved and motioned for everyone to put away their weapons.
“How’s the situation at Krontgen Company?”
“It’s been resolved for now. The defense of the Krontgen Company’s shelter is too weak. It’s not strong enough.”
Fang Heng’s tone was disdainful. “But they escaped pretty quickly. Before I could even flatten them all, they drove off with their truck loaded with materials.”
“I left a Tyrant there to continue dismantling the shelter. It’s not a big problem.”
D*mn, how long had it been?
In less than an hour, he had scared the players of the Krontgen Company away?
Having seen the strength of Fang Heng’s Lickers, Hao Zhou could roughly imagine the scene of Fang Heng’s Tyrants attacking the Krontgen Company’s shelter.
Fortunately, Fang Heng was not their enemy.
Fang Heng shook his head and said, “Sigh, I thought they could hold on for a while longer.”
Kun Ba and Kun Ta looked at each other again.
Why did Fang Heng’s tone sound like he was a little disappointed?
Fang Heng walked forward and his gaze focused on the large sculpture that everyone was moving
“Let’s not talk about them. What about you guys? How’s the mission?”
“We’ve found it. Here, the Heart of the Apocalypse. This is it.”
Kun Ta patted the large sculpture beside him as he spoke. “I just didn’t expect it to be so heavy.”

Kun Ba added, “There are still many sculptures in the vault. They’re all big things. Just moving out the Heart of the Apocalypse is already difficult enough. It’s going to be very difficult to overcome the mission difficulty.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows when he heard this and looked at the interior of the vault behind everyone.
There were sculptures of all sizes piled up inside the entire vault.

After thinking for a moment, Fang Heng raised his head and said, “Alright, leave this to me first. You guys go to the first and second floor. The artworks there are relatively small. Think of a way to move all the artworks to the entrance. At that time, we’ll pack them up and bring them back to the apocalypse camp to hand in our mission.”
“You? Alone?”

Kun Ba blinked his eyes in surprise and looked at Fang Heng in puzzlement. “This thing is very heavy.” “Heavy? It’s no big deal. Come, I’ll show you guys something.” As Fang Heng spoke, he turned to the side and took two steps to the side, pointing his chin at the Tyrant behind him.
The Tyrant accepted Fang Heng’s command and strode forward.
It walked to the front of the sculpture and tried to lift the entire sculpture.
The sculpture shook slightly.
It couldn’t move it!!
“Eh, so heavy?”
Fang Heng was a little surprised as well. He controlled the other Tyrant to come up and help.
The two Tyrants exerted their strength on both sides at the same time and lifted the entire sculpture up into the air.
Good heavens...
He forcefully turned the Tyrants into porters.
Kun Ba swallowed his saliva.
But he was still a little worried.
“Fang Heng, letting the two of them carry... is it really stable?”
The Tyrants were undoubtedly very strong, but it seemed that they were strained. If they were careless and fell midway, the mission would be over.
“Don’t worry, they are very stable.”
Fang Heng was very confident. “Look.”
“Chi Chi Chi...”
Fine vines quickly grew out of the Tyrant’s body.
The vines firmly fixed the statue in the middle of the two Tyrant’s bodies.
“It’s much more stable, isn’t it?”
Hao Zhou’s eyes revealed a look of surprise.
Vines?
They looked a little familiar.
This vine seemed to be...
The vine parasite that he had seen in Hope Town back then?
Hao Zhou was deep in thought, and he had some understanding in his heart.
The Tyrant in front of him was the same as the Licker outside, both had been modified!
They were much more powerful than ordinary zombies!
Seeing that Fang Heng’s Tyrant had easily finished moving the items, the team’s morale soared.
The two brothers, Kun Ba and Kun Ta nodded in unison.
“Fang Heng, I’ll have to trouble you with the large sculptures in the vault. Let’s split up.”
“No problem.”
Hao Zhou knew that they had really found the right person for this mission!
If it was anyone else, without the help of the Tyrant form, they would not have been able to complete the mission so easily!
With Fang Heng’s help, they were able to make the most of their time and think of a way to move more exhibits back and increase the mission reward as much as possible!
They were full of energy!
Watching Hao Zhou’s player team and the Tyrants carrying the large sculptures, Fang Heng turned his head and looked at the vault again.
Inside the vault, there were more than a hundred sculptures of all sizes, with the large sculptures accounting for more than half of them.
In addition to the exhibits in the exhibition halls on the first, second and third floor...
Greed!
Faced with such a good opportunity, he had to be greedy to death!
In addition to the promotion quota, the mission reward this time also included a skill book!
The higher the completion rate of the mission, the better the skill book rewarded!

sentences.text: Considering that the Lickers would break into the art gallery and destroy the exhibits, Fang Heng did not choose to let the Lickers enter the art gallery.
Hao Zhou and the others felt that they were finally of some use in the mission.
According to the information provided by the curator, Sandy Nelen, the sculpture was in the vault on the second basement.
Hao Zhou immediately led the team to clean up the entire gallery and searched it thoroughly.
It took a lot of effort to find the vault key on the third floor.
In the end, they took another big detour before opening the vault door.
The giant sculpture of the mission target, the Heart of the Apocalypse, was lying quietly in the center of the vault.
When they saw the mission target, the team of players looked at each other and fell into silence at the same time.
They had heard that the Heart of the Apocalypse was a large sculpture, but they had not expected it to be so big!
It was a full two and a half meters tall.
It looked like four or five young men would need to work together to lift it up.
How could such a large sculpture be moved out?
Hao Zhou asked, “How’s the cargo elevator?”
Kun Ba shook his head.
“It can’t be used.
I’ve checked before.
There’s no backup power supply in the art gallery, and the elevator can’t be activated unless we can find a generator to generate electricity ourselves.”
Hao Zhou suddenly felt a headache coming
on.
Where could he find a generator at this time?
He could only use the stairs to slowly transport it up with the help of the wooden planks.
Hao Zhou made a decision.
“I’ll first think of a way to build a platform and transport the sculpture to the staircase.”
Although doing so was extremely inefficient, it seemed like this was the only solution at the moment.
The few of them immediately took action.
They made a high-level wooden plank on the spot and installed rolling wheels under the wooden plank.
Finally, they tried to lift the large sculpture onto the wooden plank.
“Three, two, one,”
Hao Zhou’s face flushed red and the veins on his neck bulged.
However, the entire sculpture did not move at
all!
“No, it’s still too heavy.”
Hao Zhou panted heavily and said, “Don’t force it.
It’ll be more troublesome if we break the statue.”.
“Let me try this.”
Kun Ba took out a bottle of short-term strength-enhancement potions with negative effects from his backpack.
Just as he was about to drink the potion, heavy footsteps came from the pathway on the second basement.
“Bang, Bang...”
Everyone was alert and raised their guns to aim at the passage.
As the footsteps approached, a huge shadow appeared at the passage entrance.
It was the Tyrant!
Fang Heng jumped down from the Tyrant’s back and came in front of everyone.
“Fang Heng?
You’re back!” Seeing that it was the Tyrant that Fang Heng controlled, Hao Zhou was obviously relieved and motioned for everyone to put away their weapons.
“How’s the situation at Krontgen Company?”
“It’s been resolved for now.
The defense of the Krontgen Company’s shelter is too weak.
It’s not strong enough.”
Fang Heng’s tone was disdainful.
“But they escaped pretty quickly.
Before I could even flatten them all, they drove off with their truck loaded with materials.”
“I left a Tyrant there to continue dismantling the shelter.
It’s not a big problem.”
D*mn, how long had it been?
In less than an hour, he had scared the players of the Krontgen Company away?
Having seen the strength of Fang Heng’s Lickers, Hao Zhou could roughly imagine the scene of Fang Heng’s Tyrants attacking the Krontgen Company’s shelter.
Fortunately, Fang Heng was not their enemy.
Fang Heng shook his head and said, “Sigh, I thought they could hold on for a while longer.”
Kun Ba and Kun Ta looked at each other again.
Why did Fang Heng’s tone sound like he was a little disappointed?
Fang Heng walked forward and his gaze focused on the large sculpture that everyone was moving
“Let’s not talk about them.
What about you guys?
How’s the mission?”
“We’ve found it.
Here, the Heart of the Apocalypse.
This is it.”
Kun Ta patted the large sculpture beside him as he spoke.
“I just didn’t expect it to be so heavy.”
Kun Ba added, “There are still many sculptures in the vault.
They’re all big things.
Just moving out the Heart of the Apocalypse is already difficult enough.
It’s going to be very difficult to overcome the mission difficulty.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows when he heard this and looked at the interior of the vault behind everyone.
There were sculptures of all sizes piled up inside the entire vault.
After thinking for a moment, Fang Heng raised his head and said, “Alright, leave this to me first.
You guys go to the first and second floor.
The artworks there are relatively small.
Think of a way to move all the artworks to the entrance.
At that time, we’ll pack them up and bring them back to the apocalypse camp to hand in our mission.”
“You?
Alone?”
Kun Ba blinked his eyes in surprise and looked at Fang Heng in puzzlement.
“This thing is very heavy.” “Heavy?
It’s no big deal.
Come, I’ll show you guys something.” As Fang Heng spoke, he turned to the side and took two steps to the side, pointing his chin at the Tyrant behind him.
The Tyrant accepted Fang Heng’s command and strode forward.
It walked to the front of the sculpture and tried to lift the entire sculpture.
The sculpture shook slightly.
It couldn’t move it!!
“Eh, so heavy?”
Fang Heng was a little surprised as well.
He controlled the other Tyrant to come up and help.
The two Tyrants exerted their strength on both sides at the same time and lifted the entire sculpture up into the air.
Good heavens...
He forcefully turned the Tyrants into porters.
Kun Ba swallowed his saliva.
But he was still a little worried.
“Fang Heng, letting the two of them carry... is it really stable?”
The Tyrants were undoubtedly very strong, but it seemed that they were strained.
If they were careless and fell midway, the mission would be over.
“Don’t worry, they are very stable.”
Fang Heng was very confident.
“Look.”
“Chi Chi Chi...”
Fine vines quickly grew out of the Tyrant’s body.
The vines firmly fixed the statue in the middle of the two Tyrant’s bodies.
“It’s much more stable, isn’t it?”
Hao Zhou’s eyes revealed a look of surprise.
Vines?
They looked a little familiar.
