chapters.title: Chapter 280 - Trail Cart
paragraphs: Fang Heng was in high spirits. He quickly opened the game log.
The 100-man team of vine zombies was about to arrive at Yin City.
The players from the Krontgen Company had been completely chased away.
The next question was how to bring a large number of exhibits back to the apocalypse merchant camp.
From Yin City to the apocalypse merchant camp, relying on Tyrants to transport the exhibits on their own would not guarantee that they would make it in time to complete the mission.
He needed a large number of transportation tools.
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng had an answer.
“Got it! For the skill book, I’ll take a gamble.”
He muttered to himself, threw a simple bed on the floor and went offline on the spot.
For a full two hours!
Hao Zhou’s team of four acted as if they were on steroids, moving all the exhibits from the first three floors of the art gallery to the entrance hall.
Not a single one was left!
“This is the last box. The second and third floors are all empty.”
The two brothers, Kun Ba and Kun Ta, carried the last box of exhibits down from the third floor and gulped down a bottle of Gatorade to expedite their recovery speed.
“I’ve also checked the six exhibition halls behind the first floor again. I didn’t miss anything.”
Looking at the pile of artworks that filled the entire hall on the first floor, Sister Li frowned. “So many...”

The four of them had been busy moving the artworks out of the exhibition halls. When they came back to their senses, they realized that the hall on the first floor had already been filled with artwork.
“Hao Zhou, we can’t bring back so many artworks, can we?”
Hao Zhou didn’t expect that the art gallery would be filled with so many artworks.
He felt that Fang Heng wouldn’t be able to settle all of them.
The time limit of the mission was less than four hours. They would be able to go back and forth between the art gallery and the apocalypse camp with a full load at least two times.
It could be considered amazing if they could even bring back one-tenth of the artworks in the hall.

“Let’s wait a little longer. Fang Heng should have his plan. His zombie team should be able to move materials,” Hao Zhou thought for a moment and said to the others, “Let’s separate the most valuable items first.”
“Okay.”
The others nodded and immediately began to classify the artworks according to their value.
“Chi chi chi chi...”
Not long after they started, a sound came from outside the art gallery.
“What’s that sound?”
It sounded like... No way?
“Let’s go out and take a look.”
Hao Zhou suddenly realized something. He immediately put down the artwork in his hand and walked out of the art gallery.
He looked up and saw two helicopters hovering in the sky above the city.
Lucia poked her head out from the back of the helicopter and shouted, “Fang Heng? Is Fang Heng here?”
Sister Li, who followed Hao Zhou out, also looked up
Helicopters? Fang Heng got a helicopter to carry materials?
Kun Ba waved excitedly at the sky, “Yes! Inside!”
Lucia heard him and her eyes revealed an excited expression. She suddenly jumped down from the sky.
She landed steadily on the ground.
“Fang Heng said that there are many valuable items for us to help carry. I’ve brought a team over first. Five more cargo trucks are coming soon.”
Cargo trucks!
Five!!
Hao Zhou did not expect that Fang Heng would be so resourceful. He could mobilize five trucks and two helicopters to help carry the artworks in such a short time.
He whispered, “He even got helicopters here, and they’re so big...”
“The bigger the better. The more we move, the more generous our reward will be.”
Kun Ba and Kun Ta could not wait any longer.
“Let’s go inside and move the famous paintings.”

(Hint: You have used your authority as a Colonel in the Dark Knights. You have urgently deployed the members of the Dark Knights and used some of their materials. You have borrowed a transport vehicle*5 (24 hours) and a transport helicopter*2 (24 hours).]
(Hint: You have used 26,000 Dark Knights honor points.]
In the game, items that could not be stored in a backpack could not be transported through the space tearing device.
When he was in Pine City, Fang Heng had thought hard about how to send the armoured vehicle back to the shelter.
He first dismantled the armoured vehicle into small and medium-sized parts, then took the parts back to the shelter to reassemble them.

Not long ago, when he was transporting the minerals, Fang Heng did the same. He divided the military truck into various parts and then transported them through the space tearing device before reassembling them again.
When he saw Fang Heng use this move for the first time, Mo Jiawei was also shocked.
He felt that Fang Heng had cheated in the game.
The ordinary players could not do this at all.
First of all, the player did not have such a high skill level in mechanical maintenance.
It was one thing to dismantle it, but once it was dismantled, it could not be put back together.
Secondly, even with such a high-level maintenance skill, the player’s vitality was not enough to complete the dismantling and assembly in a short period... What a coincidence!
Fang Heng’s zombie clones could participate in the maintenance together.
Was this not considered cheating?
“Sigh!”
If he was in Yin City now, Fang Heng could only sigh in his heart and say that it was a pity.
Time was too tight, so he didn’t have time to return to the shelter to disassemble and assemble the trucks again.
Fang Heng had no choice but to deploy the entire school of the Dark Knights to quickly mobilize the resources of the nearby contact points and gather five trucks and two helicopters.
Even if his military rank in the Dark Knights was high enough to be a Colonel.
Even if his relationship with Lucia was so good that Lucia was willing to find a team to work for him for free.
However, he still had to pay the rental fee and gas money!
What a pain! This would cost a lot of Dark Knights’ honor points!
After meeting up with Fang Heng, Lucia commanded the team of Dark Knights to move the materials on the transport vehicles to the parking lot behind the art gallery.
Lucia felt strange, “Fang Heng, aren’t we transporting materials? What do you need these wooden planks for?”
“There are too many artworks that need to be moved. The current transport capacity is not enough to move them all, so I have to make some tools myself.”
Fang Heng explained and began to control the zombie team.
The scene he saw in the basement not long ago inspired him.
While the Dark Knights were moving the materials to the vehicles, Fang Heng controlled the zombies to move the materials in batches. Then, he made long wooden planks, pulleys and hemp ropes.
(Hint: In 11 minutes, your zombie clone has completed: wooden planks (blueprints)*27, pulleys*82, hemp ropes*267, Type F simple connecting device*99...]
With the components ready, Fang Heng tried to assemble the wooden planks and pulleys.
A simple cart had been completed!

(Hint: You have completed the creation of a special combination tool. You have not yet learned the blueprints of this tool. You can not gain additional attribute bonuses, and it will be more easily damaged.]
The two zombies staggered forward and extended vines from their bodies, tightly binding the front end of the cart.
Fang Heng walked forward again and pulled the vines to test their toughness.
“It’s very sturdy. There’s no problem at all!”
Lucia stood by the side, her beautiful eyes flashing with surprise. “A cart? Fang Heng, you’re amazing!”

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - Stage 2
paragraphs: At the entrance of the art gallery, Hao Zhou and the others had just stuffed a small portion of the valuable paintings into the truck.
Kun Ba wiped the sweat off his forehead.
“It’s not enough. There are still a lot of sculptures at the entrance of the first floor. We need to make some space for them.”
“Okay, we’ll keep a big truck to carry the Heart of the Apocalypse. After we send one batch, we’ll come back and move them a few more times.”

Hao Zhou wasn’t greedy. In his opinion, with a big truck, they could probably move it back and forth three or four times. Although they wouldn’t be able to move all of them, they could still move most of them.
“I’m afraid only Tyrant can move the Heart of the Apocalypse.”
As they were talking, Kun Ba saw something, and his expression became strange.
Everyone followed Kun Ba’s gaze.
Not far away, Fang Heng brought a group of zombies and walked around from the back parking lot.
Behind him, five or six zombies were divided into small teams. They gathered together and used vines to directly wrap around the cart and pull it forward.
There were also the Lickers!
Their bodies were also tied with hemp ropes. The other ends of the hemp ropes were tied to the front of the cart with pulleys.
Kun Ba rubbed his eyes and turned to look at Kun Ta, who looked like he had seen a ghost. “Eh, Brother, is he going to... treat the Lickers as his labour workers?”
An hour later.
On the highway, the group of Dark Knights returned with a full load, occupying the entire main road.
Trucks and helicopters cleared the way in front, and at the back, a zombie team was transporting the carts slowly and moving forward.
As the carts were heavy, the team moved very slowly.
It was a strange scene.
Even now, Hao Zhou’s team still felt like they were in a dream.
D*mn it!
Two days ago, when they had just received the mission, they had indeed thought of emptying the art gallery.
But two days later, their dream came true!
They did it!
All the artworks in the gallery were taken away in one wave!
Kun Ba followed the group of zombies. As he walked, he suddenly couldn’t help but giggle.
When he went back, he would be able to complete the mission at least 10 times more! The reward would be at least 10 times more!
What level could he reach with this promotion?
He was looking forward to it!
Fang Heng was also looking forward to it.
The reward of a mission like a skill book was very rare. It was not easy to come across a skill book, naturally, he would try his best to find a way to increase the level of the reward!

The speed of the zombie team was slow and they spent another two hours transporting the items. When the time limit of the mission was almost over, the military trucks of the Dark Knights slowly drove into the apocalypse merchant camp of Dongxi District.
As the zombies could not transport the artwork into the camp, Fang Heng left them outside the camp to wait.
Seeing so many trucks driving into the camp, Hubbard, the merchant of the apocalypse camp, was stunned.
“Hey! Hubbard!”
Fang Heng saw an acquaintance, stuck his head out of the window and waved to greet
him.
He recognized Hubbard.

There was a time when the prison shelter needed a furnace to expand production. Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei used the space tearing device in the shelter to teleport around the world. One by one, they explored the apocalypse camp, selling materials and buying furnaces.
At that time, Fang Heng had emptied Hubbard’s shop, so his favorability rating with Hubbard was quite high. “It’s Fang Heng. I was wondering who else can transport materials to my truck by truck.”
Seeing the big customer come, Hubbard smiled. He took out a bottle of beer and threw it at Fang Heng.
“But I remember telling you last time. Our warehouse is full. We don’t need it for a while...”
Hearing the NPC merchant, Hao Zhou and the others looked at Fang Heng from the car window.
Didn’t he develop in the prison? How did he know the merchants here?
And he seemed to be on familiar terms with them.
Hao Zhou was even more curious. He wanted to know what Fang Heng had done to leave such a deep impression on the NPC.
e
Fang Heng took the beer bottle and also took out a bag of drunkard peanuts from his backpack and threw it at Hubbard.
“No, no, you’re wrong. I’m here to complete the mission.”
“Mission?” Hubbard glanced at the Dark Knights and Hao Zhou’s group who were moving the sculptures out of the truck.
“I got it. It’s that idiot Sandy Nelen.”
Hubbard came to a realization and sighed as he spoke.
“It’s already so late, and he still can’t forget his art gallery. What nonsense about art being the treasure of human civilization?”
“Can’t he understand it? In the current apocalypse outside, the most important thing is to survive!”
Hubbard was complaining when a surprised voice sounded from the side.
“Oh my god! You’ve done it! It’s done!”
“Oh! I can’t believe it!”
“You brought all these treasures back!”
“Be careful! This painting has been around for 20 years! Be gentle! Be gentle! I beg you!”
Fang Heng looked in the direction of the voice and saw an old man with a head full of white hair shouting in surprise.
“Hey! Sandy!”
Hubbard and Fang Heng walked forward together. He patted Sandy’s shoulder heavily and said snappily, “You didn’t say that there would be so many things here.”
“More? No, it’s too little!”
“Hubbard, you have to know that these artworks are the crystallization of our human civilization! They are the marks of our existence in this world, the spiritual civilization...”
Hubbard only felt a headache. He stopped Sandy from continuing, “Okay, okay. Then, how much are you willing to spend for these human treasures?”
“Money?!”
Sandy felt that he had been greatly insulted.
With a red face, he approached Hubbard aggressively. “This is art! Hubbard! It’s art! Don’t use your dirty money to measure art!”
Hubbard spread his hands and looked helpless.
“Sandy, I understand your art, but this is a shelter built for survival. I can’t put your things away. You need to find another place for your art.”
“You, you know nothing!!!”
Because he was too agitated, Sandy was trembling all over.
“These are treasures! You people don’t know what’s good for you! You will regret it!”

Sandy turned his head angrily and looked at Hao Zhou and the other players. “Hao Zhou! Did you hear what they said? These people don’t know what art is! I don’t want to stay here anymore! We will leave now!”
(Hint: Due to your outstanding completion of the mission to find the Heart of the Apocalypse, follow-up mission-the apocalypse artist has been triggered.)
Mission name: Apocalypse artist (Team).
Mission description: You have returned a large number of artworks from the art gallery in Yin City, but the apocalypse merchant camp cannot accommodate that many artworks.
Mission requirements: Please help find a home for Sandy’s artworks (please protect Sandy and his artworks in the meantime).
Mission difficulty: SSS.
Mission time limit: 10 days.

sentences.text: At the entrance of the art gallery, Hao Zhou and the others had just stuffed a small portion of the valuable paintings into the truck.
Kun Ba wiped the sweat off his forehead.
“It’s not enough.
There are still a lot of sculptures at the entrance of the first floor.
We need to make some space for them.”
“Okay, we’ll keep a big truck to carry the Heart of the Apocalypse.
After we send one batch, we’ll come back and move them a few more times.”
Hao Zhou wasn’t greedy.
In his opinion, with a big truck, they could probably move it back and forth three or four times.
Although they wouldn’t be able to move all of them, they could still move most of them.
“I’m afraid only Tyrant can move the Heart of the Apocalypse.”
As they were talking, Kun Ba saw something, and his expression became strange.
Everyone followed Kun Ba’s gaze.
Not far away, Fang Heng brought a group of zombies and walked around from the back parking lot.
Behind him, five or six zombies were divided into small teams.
They gathered together and used vines to directly wrap around the cart and pull it forward.
There were also the Lickers!
Their bodies were also tied with hemp ropes.
The other ends of the hemp ropes were tied to the front of the cart with pulleys.
Kun Ba rubbed his eyes and turned to look at Kun Ta, who looked like he had seen a ghost.
“Eh, Brother, is he going to... treat the Lickers as his labour workers?”
An hour later.
On the highway, the group of Dark Knights returned with a full load, occupying the entire main road.
Trucks and helicopters cleared the way in front, and at the back, a zombie team was transporting the carts slowly and moving forward.
As the carts were heavy, the team moved very slowly.
It was a strange scene.
Even now, Hao Zhou’s team still felt like they were in a dream.
D*mn it!
Two days ago, when they had just received the mission, they had indeed thought of emptying the art gallery.
But two days later, their dream came true!
They did it!
All the artworks in the gallery were taken away in one wave!
Kun Ba followed the group of zombies.
As he walked, he suddenly couldn’t help but giggle.
When he went back, he would be able to complete the mission at least 10 times more!
The reward would be at least 10 times more!
What level could he reach with this promotion?
He was looking forward to it!
Fang Heng was also looking forward to it.
The reward of a mission like a skill book was very rare.
It was not easy to come across a skill book, naturally, he would try his best to find a way to increase the level of the reward!
The speed of the zombie team was slow and they spent another two hours transporting the items.
When the time limit of the mission was almost over, the military trucks of the Dark Knights slowly drove into the apocalypse merchant camp of Dongxi District.
As the zombies could not transport the artwork into the camp, Fang Heng left them outside the camp to wait.
Seeing so many trucks driving into the camp, Hubbard, the merchant of the apocalypse camp, was stunned.
“Hey!
Hubbard!”
Fang Heng saw an acquaintance, stuck his head out of the window and waved to greet
him.
He recognized Hubbard.
There was a time when the prison shelter needed a furnace to expand production.
Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei used the space tearing device in the shelter to teleport around the world.
One by one, they explored the apocalypse camp, selling materials and buying furnaces.
At that time, Fang Heng had emptied Hubbard’s shop, so his favorability rating with Hubbard was quite high.
“It’s Fang Heng.
I was wondering who else can transport materials to my truck by truck.”
Seeing the big customer come, Hubbard smiled.
He took out a bottle of beer and threw it at Fang Heng.
“But I remember telling you last time.
Our warehouse is full.
We don’t need it for a while...”
Hearing the NPC merchant, Hao Zhou and the others looked at Fang Heng from the car window.
Didn’t he develop in the prison?
How did he know the merchants here?
And he seemed to be on familiar terms with them.
Hao Zhou was even more curious.
He wanted to know what Fang Heng had done to leave such a deep impression on the NPC.
e
Fang Heng took the beer bottle and also took out a bag of drunkard peanuts from his backpack and threw it at Hubbard.
“No, no, you’re wrong.
I’m here to complete the mission.”
“Mission?” Hubbard glanced at the Dark Knights and Hao Zhou’s group who were moving the sculptures out of the truck.
“I got it.
It’s that idiot Sandy Nelen.”
Hubbard came to a realization and sighed as he spoke.
“It’s already so late, and he still can’t forget his art gallery.
What nonsense about art being the treasure of human civilization?”
“Can’t he understand it?
In the current apocalypse outside, the most important thing is to survive!”
Hubbard was complaining when a surprised voice sounded from the side.
“Oh my god!
You’ve done it!
It’s done!”
“Oh!
I can’t believe it!”
“You brought all these treasures back!”
“Be careful!
This painting has been around for 20 years!
Be gentle!
Be gentle!
I beg you!”
Fang Heng looked in the direction of the voice and saw an old man with a head full of white hair shouting in surprise.
“Hey!
Sandy!”
Hubbard and Fang Heng walked forward together.
He patted Sandy’s shoulder heavily and said snappily, “You didn’t say that there would be so many things here.”
“More?
No, it’s too little!”
“Hubbard, you have to know that these artworks are the crystallization of our human civilization!
They are the marks of our existence in this world, the spiritual civilization...”
Hubbard only felt a headache.
He stopped Sandy from continuing, “Okay, okay.
Then, how much are you willing to spend for these human treasures?”
“Money?!”
Sandy felt that he had been greatly insulted.
With a red face, he approached Hubbard aggressively.
“This is art!
Hubbard!
It’s art!
Don’t use your dirty money to measure art!”
Hubbard spread his hands and looked helpless.
“Sandy, I understand your art, but this is a shelter built for survival.
I can’t put your things away.
You need to find another place for your art.”
“You, you know nothing!!!”
Because he was too agitated, Sandy was trembling all over.
“These are treasures!
You people don’t know what’s good for you!
You will regret it!”
Sandy turned his head angrily and looked at Hao Zhou and the other players.
“Hao Zhou!
Did you hear what they said?
These people don’t know what art is!
I don’t want to stay here anymore!
We will leave now!”

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - Eat up
paragraphs: Seeing the row of hints appearing on their retinas, everyone fell silent for a moment.
There was a follow-up mission?
Moreover, this follow-up mission was simply a joke.
Where could they find a place to store so many useless statues?
Hao Zhou quickly exchanged glances with the other team members.
He didn’t reject the mission immediately, nor did he agree to accept the mission. Instead, he tried to get more information from Sandy.
It was like an additional question.
It was very difficult, but he could think of a way to try.
“Mr Sandy, please don’t get too agitated. Do you know where I can bring your artwork to?”
“Of course not!”
Sandy said angrily, “These people only have money in their eyes. This is a stain on art!”
Hao Zhou’s heart sank.
This was bad. The additional question would most likely not have an answer.
Sister Li asked, “Mr Sandy, then do these artworks have any special abilities?”
“Humph! Of course, they have special abilities! I’ve said it before, they are all treasures left behind by the human civilization! They are priceless treasures! They cannot be measured by money!”
Sandy said with a heavy humph.
He took out a pack of tissues from his backpack, climbed up to the nearest sculpture and carefully wiped it.
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
The others also showed surprised expressions.
After Sandy wiped it, the sculpture that originally had the words ‘mission item’ on it changed.
Item: Sculpture-Chanter of the Church. Level: S.
Type: Artwork.
Description: The work of contemporary art master Anthony Gormley, placing it in the shelter can unlock the art layout (Art +19).
Description: When the shelter’s art level is above 100 and the shelter level is above Level 90, a special construction building-exhibition hall can be unlocked.

(An exhibition hall can enhance the attractiveness of the shelter, enhance the attractiveness of the shelter to certain special talents, and improve the morale and mood of the shelter members. The actual effect is related to the art level of the shelter).
Description: The artwork needs daily maintenance by special personnel. If the maintenance cannot be provided for some time, the artwork will have a negative effect.
It was an extremely rare S-level item in the game!
However, after looking at the description of the attribute of the item, Hao Zhou and the others had a faint feeling of pain in their balls.
After evaluating the artwork, they only had one word for it:
Rubbish!!
To a player, a statue took up too much space! They even had to employ someone to take care of it.
It was not ordinary maintenance. In the game, this kind of maintenance required NPCs with special skills, and maintenance items also cost money...
What was the use of it!
The exhibition hall looked pretty good.
However, the prerequisite of a Level 90 shelter had barred all players from building the exhibition hall.
A player could not afford it!
It was a complete late-stage item.
Only a large-scale player like the Federation would need it.
And the Federation was not stupid. They did not have enough food to eat, so they did not have the time to bother with these fancy artworks.
Fortunately, the only good news was that they still had 10 days of mission time to help Sandy find a sucker, find an NPC shelter in the game and throw the items inside.
Hao Zhou was very calm. He had already begun to think about rejecting this mission and just exchange for the Tier 1 reward.
It would be good if they could settle the additional question, but if they could not do it, it would be a waste of points, so there was no need.
At the moment, it seemed that the mission was almost impossible to complete.
Looking at the mission hint in detail, Fang Heng was very happy.
Great!
So it was not a useless piece of equipment!
Fang Heng had been thinking about it when he received the mission.
This Tier 2 mission was too troublesome. Should he just ‘eat up’ all the sculptures by himself?
After all, so many sculptures needed to be transported by truck. A day of delay would consume a lot of his honor points.
He might as well solve it as soon as possible and dump the artworks in his shelter!
Perhaps the other player’s shelter was too small to fit in, but his shelter level had already risen to Level 107!
There were already 30 warehouses for materials.
He didn’t have to worry about his debts. It was just a matter of building a few more warehouses!
But...
Would he look a little stupid if he piled so many whiteboard sculptures in his house?
Now, after confirming that these sculptures were not whiteboard equipment and that they could be used to build a special building such as an art gallery, Fang Heng gladly accepted them.
More or less, they could increase the attractiveness of the shelter. In the future, it would be easier to go out and trick NPCs to come to his shelter.
It was better than nothing!
Fang Heng made a decision, so he nodded and said, “Mr Sandy, I have a shelter that I built myself, and I am very willing to store your artwork in my shelter. I wonder if you are willing?”
“Really?!”
Sandy was pleasantly surprised. His face immediately changed as he looked at Fang Heng with great admiration.
“I knew it! There will still be people who know what’s good for them in this world!”
“But is your shelter big enough? Can it hold so many artworks? Also, is your shelter safe enough?”
“These expensive artworks need to be maintained. It will cost a little every day...”

Fang Heng nodded. “Of course, I promise you, Mr Sandy. Even though it’s the apocalypse, art is always art. I believe that when the end of the apocalypse comes, everyone will remember the contribution you made to the preservation of human civilization.”
“Fang Heng!!”
Sandy looked at Fang Heng excitedly, as if he was a close friend that he had known for hundreds of years.
“I know! I knew someone would understand me!!”
(Hint: Your friendship with Sandy has greatly increased.]
Hao Zhou and the others looked at each other silently.
They were just thinking about finding a sucker and now Fang Heng volunteered to be the sucker?
Hao Zhou felt even more indebted to Fang
Heng.
Who would be willing to pile such trash in the shelter?
Only for the sake of the mission did Fang Heng make such a sacrifice.

Hao Zhou sighed in his heart. He patted Fang Heng on the shoulder and whispered in his ear, “Fang Heng, don’t force yourself. It’s already very good to do this. You can give up on the Tier 2 mission.”
“It’s okay. It’s just a small matter.”
V
Fang Heng waved his hand and checked the map.
There was no doubt that these large-scale sculptures could not be transported through the space rift.
They could only be slowly dragged back by trucks and zombies.
This place was very far from the prison area. It would take about 17 to 18 hours to get there.
It would probably be the next day after they went back.
“Mr Sandy, my shelter is very far. We shouldn’t delay. We’ll set off now.”
Sandy nodded, “These are very precious. We must be careful!”
“Of course.”
Fang Heng signalled the Dark Knights to get on the car and set off for the prison shelter.
After bidding farewell to Hubbard, they bought a few barrels of gas tanks and filled them up. The long line set off again.
Hao Zhou and the others followed Fang Heng back to his shelter.
After walking for more than half an hour, Fang Heng felt sleepy and couldn’t help but yawn.
After staying up all night last night, he also felt a little tired, so he had to go back and sleep. “Aren’t you all sleepy? I have to go offline to rest. I’m a little tired.”
“We’re okay. Leave this to us.”
Kun Ba and Kun Ta each took out a bottle of coffee and gulped it down.
Although they were very sleepy, seeing that the mission was about to be completed and a large mission reward was about to be pocketed...
Who could sleep!
Hao Zhou was the same. He was extremely excited and didn’t feel sleepy at all.
“Alright, I’ll sleep first. If there’s a problem, call me anytime.”
Fang Heng gave Lucia the authority to control the zombies, then threw a simple bed into the truck and went offline.

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - Artist
paragraphs: After almost an entire day, the art convoy finally returned to the prison shelter.
Seeing such a powerful city defense structure and the scale of the shelter, Sandy’s expression was very exaggerated.
“Fang Heng, this place is beyond my expectations!”
“Your shelter’s defense is too strong. It’s much better than Hubbard’s shabby base!”
“But, Fang Heng, the maintenance of the artworks will consume a lot of resources. Can you promise to protect my artworks as best as you can?”
“Of course, this is art! They deserve the best protection!”
For the sake of the mission, Fang Heng agreed immediately, his face full of righteousness!
“And I will also build an exhibition hall in my shelter to conduct a formal artistic evaluation.”
Fang Heng thought to himself since he had so much artwork in his shelter, he naturally couldn’t treat them like trash!
He was going to build the art museum.
(Hint: Your favorability rating with Sandy has increased significantly!]
Sandy’s eyes lit up when he heard Fang Heng’s words!
He stared at Fang Heng as if he was looking at a beautiful piece of art.
“Oh my god! Fang Heng! You are different from those shallow survivors out there! I can see the sincerity in your eyes!”
“That’s great! That’s great!”
“This place exists just to store my artworks! I’m excited!”
Sandy was so excited that he was a little speechless. He nodded to himself.
“Yeah, I’ve decided. I’ll stay here with my artwork as well. I’ll take good care of them.”
Fang Heng: ??? In the next second, a game hint appeared in Fang Heng’s vision.
(Hint: Your favorability rating with Sandy has increased significantly.]
(Hint: Sandy has joined your shelter.]
(Hint: Player’s current shelter can build a special building-Sandy’s art gallery (Normal art gallery advanced building).]
(Hint: Your shelter’s attractiveness has increased.]
Fang Heng was speechless for a moment.
Hmm? Forcefully joining?
Sandy could also use cheats?
Fang Heng quickly opened Sandy’s attribute to check, muttering in his heart.
“If his attribute is trash, I have to think of a way to chase him away.”
Character: Sandy Nelen
Evaluation: S
Level: 5
Strength: 2
Physique: 3
Agility: 2
Perception: 4
Intelligence: 29
Will: 2
Current loyalty: 88
Skills:
Basic science (Level 5)
Appreciation of art (Level 97) Appraisal (Level 47)
Book-making (Level 27)
Cooking (Level 1)
Painting (Level 18) Efficient reading (Level 26) Will to survive (Level 42)
Hunger (Level 35)
Art forgery/forgery (Level 75)
Awakened talent skill: Art fanaticism (Level 3)
Talent skill level: S

Talent skill description: Increases shelter’s attractiveness by 5%, increases shelter’s survival radio’s range by 65%. For every level increase of this skill level, an additional 1% of attractiveness and 5% of the spread bonus will be gained, when persuading other NPCs, there will be an additional success rate bonus.
Fang Heng was surprised.
He didn’t expect it!
Sandy had reached the S-level threshold!
He was also an S- level character!
Alright then.
Fang Heng dismissed the idea of chasing Sandy away.
The shelter’s additional attractiveness and increased survival radio’s acceptance range were still very tempting.
Wait a minute...
Fang Heng suddenly thought of something.
The talent attribute effect could increase the success rate of convincing other NPCs?
Did that mean that the success rate of his poaching plan could be further increased?
For a moment, Fang Heng’s malicious gaze lingered on Sandy’s face.
Sandy did not notice Fang Heng’s gaze.
He dug into his pocket and took out five gold medals. He walked up to Hao Zhou’s team of players and personally put the medals on them.
“Thank you, everyone. You have risked your lives to save my artwork from that hell in Yin City.”
“You all have helped me so much along the way. You even provided me with such a good shelter to place my artwork.”
“I have nothing to show for it. This is the medal that the art gallery created during its 100th anniversary.”
“Please don’t underestimate it. It’s not just a simple medal, but an honor!”
“I believe that when the end of the apocalypse comes, your contribution to preserving the spirit of human civilization will be remembered by future generations.”
A game hint appeared in front of Fang Heng.
(Hint: You have completed the Tier 2 mission-apocalypse artist.]
(Hint: You have obtained an item-the art gallery’s 100th anniversary medal.]
Item: Art gallery’s 100th anniversary medal
Type: Medal (Special item, cannot be traded, does not bear weight, automatically activated in the backpack).
Description 1: Having a medal is regarded as qualifying to advance in the game.

Description 2: When you first choose to enter the advanced game world as the main world, you will receive a 20% attribute increase within 30 days and an additional 3 rebirth chances within 90 days (after the rebirth, you will not be punished by death, the rebirth chance will only be effective within 90 days).
“Not bad, three free resurrections within three months, but it doesn’t seem to be of use... and there’s no way to trade...”
Fang Heng muttered softly.
Sandy walked in front of Fang Heng, and he solemnly put on the medal for Fang Heng.

“Fang Heng, I noticed it when I first met you. You have a keen sense of art that surpasses that of ordinary people! Your understanding of art is beyond ordinary people, I think this book will be very suitable for you!”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
Good!
The additional reward was coming!
The advancement medal could only be considered a benefit. It was better than nothing.
What he cared about the most was the skill book!
“This is the reward that I prepared for you alone. It represents my most sincere friendship. I hope it will be useful to you.”
(Hint: After the team contribution assessment, you have completed the mission in excess and gained Sandy’s trust. Your mission reward will be increased by an additional 33.34 times.]
(Hint: The system has randomly selected three skills related to the storyline character, Sandy Nelen. You can choose one of the following rewards.]
(Option 1: Skill book (Art appreciation type) Skill level (A+).] [Option 2: Skill book (Reading type) Skill level (A+).]
(Option 3: Skill book (Book-making type) Skill level (A).]
All three skill books only had one name, but the specific attribute could not be seen.
Almost at a glance, Fang Heng’s gaze was attracted by the second reading type skill.
In the real world, he was troubled by reading books.
The occult skill book provided by Mo Yunxiao was too tiring to read!
The messy words in the book made Fang Heng dizzy.
He spent half an hour reading but only attained 0.21% of the reading progress. It would take at least a few months to finish reading it.
After acquiring the reading skill, wouldn’t he be able to improve a lot?

sentences.text: After almost an entire day, the art convoy finally returned to the prison shelter.
Seeing such a powerful city defense structure and the scale of the shelter, Sandy’s expression was very exaggerated.
“Fang Heng, this place is beyond my expectations!”
“Your shelter’s defense is too strong.
It’s much better than Hubbard’s shabby base!”
“But, Fang Heng, the maintenance of the artworks will consume a lot of resources.
Can you promise to protect my artworks as best as you can?”
“Of course, this is art!
They deserve the best protection!”
For the sake of the mission, Fang Heng agreed immediately, his face full of righteousness!
“And I will also build an exhibition hall in my shelter to conduct a formal artistic evaluation.”
Fang Heng thought to himself since he had so much artwork in his shelter, he naturally couldn’t treat them like trash!
He was going to build the art museum.
(Hint: Your favorability rating with Sandy has increased significantly!]
Sandy’s eyes lit up when he heard Fang Heng’s words!
He stared at Fang Heng as if he was looking at a beautiful piece of art.
“Oh my god!
Fang Heng!
You are different from those shallow survivors out there!
I can see the sincerity in your eyes!”
“That’s great!
That’s great!”
“This place exists just to store my artworks!
I’m excited!”
Sandy was so excited that he was a little speechless.
He nodded to himself.
“Yeah, I’ve decided.
I’ll stay here with my artwork as well.
I’ll take good care of them.”
Fang Heng: ???
In the next second, a game hint appeared in Fang Heng’s vision.
(Hint: Your favorability rating with Sandy has increased significantly.]
(Hint: Sandy has joined your shelter.]
(Hint: Player’s current shelter can build a special building-Sandy’s art gallery (Normal art gallery advanced building).]
(Hint: Your shelter’s attractiveness has increased.]
Fang Heng was speechless for a moment.
Hmm?
Forcefully joining?
Sandy could also use cheats?
Fang Heng quickly opened Sandy’s attribute to check, muttering in his heart.
“If his attribute is trash, I have to think of a way to chase him away.”
Character: Sandy Nelen
Evaluation: S
Level: 5
Strength: 2
Physique: 3
Agility: 2
Perception: 4
Intelligence: 29
Will: 2
Current loyalty: 88
Skills:
Basic science (Level 5)
Appreciation of art (Level 97) Appraisal (Level 47)
Book-making (Level 27)
Cooking (Level 1)
Painting (Level 18) Efficient reading (Level 26) Will to survive (Level 42)
Hunger (Level 35)
Art forgery/forgery (Level 75)
Awakened talent skill: Art fanaticism (Level 3)
Talent skill level: S
Talent skill description: Increases shelter’s attractiveness by 5%, increases shelter’s survival radio’s range by 65%.
For every level increase of this skill level, an additional 1% of attractiveness and 5% of the spread bonus will be gained, when persuading other NPCs, there will be an additional success rate bonus.
Fang Heng was surprised.
He didn’t expect it!
Sandy had reached the S-level threshold!
He was also an S- level character!
Alright then.
Fang Heng dismissed the idea of chasing Sandy away.
The shelter’s additional attractiveness and increased survival radio’s acceptance range were still very tempting.
Wait a minute...
Fang Heng suddenly thought of something.
The talent attribute effect could increase the success rate of convincing other NPCs?
Did that mean that the success rate of his poaching plan could be further increased?
For a moment, Fang Heng’s malicious gaze lingered on Sandy’s face.
Sandy did not notice Fang Heng’s gaze.
He dug into his pocket and took out five gold medals.
He walked up to Hao Zhou’s team of players and personally put the medals on them.
“Thank you, everyone.
You have risked your lives to save my artwork from that hell in Yin City.”
“You all have helped me so much along the way.
You even provided me with such a good shelter to place my artwork.”
“I have nothing to show for it.
This is the medal that the art gallery created during its 100th anniversary.”
“Please don’t underestimate it.
It’s not just a simple medal, but an honor!”
“I believe that when the end of the apocalypse comes, your contribution to preserving the spirit of human civilization will be remembered by future generations.”
A game hint appeared in front of Fang Heng.
(Hint: You have completed the Tier 2 mission-apocalypse artist.]
(Hint: You have obtained an item-the art gallery’s 100th anniversary medal.]
Item: Art gallery’s 100th anniversary medal
Type: Medal (Special item, cannot be traded, does not bear weight, automatically activated in the backpack).
Description 1: Having a medal is regarded as qualifying to advance in the game.

Description 2: When you first choose to enter the advanced game world as the main world, you will receive a 20% attribute increase within 30 days and an additional 3 rebirth chances within 90 days (after the rebirth, you will not be punished by death, the rebirth chance will only be effective within 90 days).
“Not bad, three free resurrections within three months, but it doesn’t seem to be of use... and there’s no way to trade...”
Fang Heng muttered softly.
Sandy walked in front of Fang Heng, and he solemnly put on the medal for Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng, I noticed it when I first met you.
You have a keen sense of art that surpasses that of ordinary people!
Your understanding of art is beyond ordinary people, I think this book will be very suitable for you!”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
Good!
The additional reward was coming!
The advancement medal could only be considered a benefit.
It was better than nothing.
What he cared about the most was the skill book!
“This is the reward that I prepared for you alone.
It represents my most sincere friendship.
I hope it will be useful to you.”
(Hint: After the team contribution assessment, you have completed the mission in excess and gained Sandy’s trust.
Your mission reward will be increased by an additional 33.34 times.]
(Hint: The system has randomly selected three skills related to the storyline character, Sandy Nelen.
You can choose one of the following rewards.]
(Option 1: Skill book (Art appreciation type) Skill level (A+).] [Option 2: Skill book (Reading type) Skill level (A+).]
(Option 3: Skill book (Book-making type) Skill level (A).]
All three skill books only had one name, but the specific attribute could not be seen.
Almost at a glance, Fang Heng’s gaze was attracted by the second reading type skill.
In the real world, he was troubled by reading books.
The occult skill book provided by Mo Yunxiao was too tiring to read!
The messy words in the book made Fang Heng dizzy.
He spent half an hour reading but only attained 0.21% of the reading progress.
It would take at least a few months to finish reading it.
After acquiring the reading skill, wouldn’t he be able to improve a lot?

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - Intelligence
paragraphs: “It doesn’t seem right either.”
Fang Heng pondered in his heart.

He was currently only at Tier 1 materialization, so his skills in the game could not be used outside of the game. After calming his mind, Fang Heng carefully checked the remaining options 1 and 3. Option 3’s book-making was only an A-level skill.
Eliminated!
It would be a loss if he learned it!
He had to learn an A+ level skill!
As for the remaining options 1 and 2...
He had to take a gamble!
Fang Heng felt that the remaining two skills were incomprehensible, so he might as well choose the second option that was most likely to help him improve: reading skill type.
(Hint: Your outstanding performance in the mission has earned you a special reward-skill book: efficient reading.]
Skill book: Efficient reading (soul binding)
Skill level: A+
Description: After use, you can immediately master the skill of efficient reading.

Skill level 1: Increases player’s intelligence by 5 points. Increases player’s reading efficiency by 50%. For every 1 level increase in skill level, an additional 0.4 intelligence (This skill can be upgraded to Level 30).
Skill description 2: Reading can improve your temperament, this will give you an additional favorability rating when you meet a certain character for the first time.
Skill description 3: Actively using the skill allows the player to enter an efficient reading state, increase reading efficiency by 500% and consume 1% of the current maximum stamina per minute.
Good!
He made a good choice!
It’s intelligence!
A skill book that increases intelligence!
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up in excitement.
Regardless of whether or not the increase in reading efficiency was useful outside of the game, just the increase in basic intelligence was enough to earn back the ticket price of this mission!
Among all the attributes, Fang Heng’s weakest attribute was intelligence!
And in the game world, reading certain books required intelligence as the foundation.
If his intelligence attribute was not enough, then he would not be able to read higher-level occult books!
High-efficiency reading could be considered as making up for his weakness!
This was a bloody win!
Fang Heng thought as he slapped the skill book on his head.
A faint white light flashed.
(Hint: You have learned a skill-efficient reading.)
Hao Zhou and the others were also extremely satisfied with the medal they obtained after some research about it.
The attribute of the medal was much better than the free resurrection that they had previously expected!
The free 3 deaths within 90 days gave them a lot of room to make mistakes, allowing them to take risks and complete some high-difficulty missions after entering the intermediate game!
They would take a gamble!
They would enter the intermediate game and make a perfect start!
“Fang Heng, thank you so much. If it weren’t for you, we wouldn’t have been able to complete the mission this time.”
Hao Zhou and the others gathered around Fang Heng and thanked him together.
“Don’t be so polite. We’re already so familiar with each other. Everyone benefits from each other. I’ve also earned an advanced skill book.”
“Next, we’re going to form a team and enter the intermediate game together.”
As Hao Zhou spoke, he looked at the luxurious prison shelter behind Fang Heng.
When they first saw the shelter, Hao Zhou’s team was shocked.
With the size of a shelter of this level, Fang Heng was going for the overlord of the entire server!
“I think you will still choose to stay here for a while, right?”
“Yes, indeed. The development of the shelter is not bad. I have no plans to enter a higher level game for the time being.”
Intermediate games were different from elementary games.
Most players who chose to enter intermediate games had strong confidence in themselves. They were confident that they could survive in a worse environment.
In comparison, they were more ambitious and more difficult to deal with.
Hao Zhou and the others looked at each other. He said, “Fang Heng we have obtained some insider information about the game.”
“Our world is undergoing a huge change. Only by entering a higher level game can we obtain enough strength to protect ourselves.”
“This was revealed to me by a comrade of mine in the Federation. I have a deep relationship with him, so I believe what he
said.”
“That’s right, Fang Heng, why don’t you come with us to the higher level game!”

Kun Ba also invited Fang Heng along, “Fang Heng, with your strength, you’ll be able to make a name for yourself after entering a higher level game. At most, you’ll be able to eat and drink without worries for the rest of your life here. It’s indeed very comfortable, but don’t wear down your spirit.”
“You rascal, if you don’t know how to speak, then don’t speak.”
Kun Ta grabbed his shoulder and stopped him from continuing

“Fang Heng, think about it. The intermediate game is the true start of the game. That’s where you’ll be able to display your strength. This place is still too small for you. Resources are also limited, and the upper limit is too low.”
Fang Heng could feel that everyone’s persuasion came from their hearts.
He also understood the danger that Kun Ta and the others said.
The game was about to invade reality.

Since the Night Owl organization could already use the space tearing device in the game to attack the server, it was very likely that the intermediate game could also use some special methods to invade the elementary game server.
At that time, there was a high chance that the Zombie Apocalypse would be crushed by the advanced game...
And...
Fang Heng’s face was serious.
He had to be prepared.

While thinking, Fang Heng raised his head and said, “Yes, thank you. I understand. I’ve heard about the great changes in the world. However, I still want to save up for some time in the elementary game.”
Hao Zhou patted Fang Heng’s shoulder and said, “Well, you’re better than us. We believe that you have your judgment. Let’s not talk about it anymore. Good luck.”
Fang Heng nodded and said jokingly, “You guys too. Maybe we’ll meet in the advanced game world soon. Next time we meet, don’t pull your hips too hard.”

“Hahaha! Okay! Then we’ll leave first and wait for you in the advanced game!” Hao Zhou also laughed out loud. “In the future, when you enter the intermediate game, feel free to look for me if you encounter any trouble.”
“You’re not in a hurry to leave right now. Why don’t you stay here tonight? I’ll treat you guys to barbecue?”
Upon mentioning Fang Heng’s barbecue, Kun Ba immediately nodded in agreement. “That’s great, Fang Heng!! I love barbecue!”
om
jas
In the messy rented room, Old Black was facing a computer.
“The Federation has already discovered that the first-generation meteorite has been destroyed. It’s much faster than we expected.”
“Unfortunately, no matter how fast it is, it’s already too late. I think they’ve already realized that all the top engineers in the server have died.”
As Old Black spoke, Fang Heng’s face appeared in his mind. Following this, a sinister smile appeared on his lips.
“Unless they’re willing to activate that thing, otherwise...”
“There’s no such possibility. The Federation will not do that. This will cause a large number of player deaths. The Federation cannot afford such losses.”
A gloomy voice sounded from the other end of the phone.

“The Federation has already detected our presence. They are now focusing their attention on Servers 2, 3 and 5. The pressure is extremely great. Activate the emergency plan and divert their attention.”
“Alright. Is there enough time? How much more time does the twelve corporations need to get ready?”
“Soon, just a little bit more.”
“Don’t worry, everything is planned. Soon, the end will come.”
Old Black shrugged. “Alright, I look forward to witnessing that day with you. Remember to transfer the money to my account first.”
After hanging up, Old Black thought for a while and reached out to call Fang Heng.
After three busy sounds, Old Black pressed the phone and sent a text message.

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - Practice
paragraphs: At night, they ate and drank to their heart’s content.
Fang Heng invited the players from Hao Zhou’s team to stay in a luxurious single room in the shelter for a day.
After a day’s rest, Hao Zhou and the others would officially form a team and enter the advanced game world.
Fang Heng did not have any plans to enter the advanced game world for a short period.
He still had more important things to deal with.
When he was delivering the goods, Fang Heng had been offline for more than ten hours, so he wasn’t sleepy at all.
He would try out the skill book that he obtained!
Fang Heng brought more than ten zombie clones to the basement of the shelter.
In the game, the player had to read a few specific books to learn about them.
It was very troublesome.
Fang Heng had tried to let the zombie clones do it for him before.
Unfortunately, zombies couldn’t read.
But now, it was different.
The skill-efficient reading could also be activated by consuming vitality.
So...
Could it also work on zombies?
Zombies didn’t have vitality.
Unlimited reading!
Fang Heng pondered for a moment and prepared to try it out.
He took out a few miscellaneous books from the warehouse and then controlled the zombie clone to walk up to him and use the efficient reading skill to forcefully read the books.
The zombie clone held a book and quickly flipped through the pages. A long reading progress bar appeared above its head.
At the same time, a hint appeared in Fang Heng’s vision.
(Hint: Your zombie clone has entered the efficient reading state. By reading the book “How To Become A Top Actor”, you have gained 1 experience point for the efficient reading skill.)
“Ha! It works!”
Fang Heng slapped his thigh excitedly and immediately called a group of zombies over to the basement.
The zombie clones lined up in front of Fang Heng and took out some miscellaneous books from the storage box that were meant for the players to do pleasure reading.
Rows of game hints floated across Fang Heng’s vision.
(Hint: Your zombie clone has entered the efficient reading state. You have finished reading the book “996! Let’s All Roll It Up!” You have gained 6 experience points for the efficient reading skill.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone...)
(Hint: Your skill has been upgraded to Level 17, the current upper limit. Please upgrade your character’s level.]
In just half an hour, the zombie clones had maxed out the efficient reading skill!
It was done!
Seeing the game hints, Fang Heng threw the “2020 Hengtong Movie Theatre Guard’s Diary” he was reading into the bonfire.
He immediately opened the character’s attribute to check.
The effect of the A+ level skill was remarkable!
The efficient reading skill provided him with 11.8 basic intelligence points!
The current character’s total score was 19.5 basic intelligence points!
Compared to before levelling up the skill, it had more than doubled!
He would go to the real world to try out the skill effect!
Fang Heng threw a simple bed on the spot and went offline.
Offline, Fang Heng couldn’t wait to return to the study room behind the villa, eager to start reading
“Eh?!
Fang Heng turned on his phone to take a look.

Apart from the important summary of the company’s information sent by his assistant Pei Anan every day, as well as Xia Xi’s persistent greetings and recent reports, he also received a text message from an unknown source.
There were only a few words on the text message.
“Server 5-Old Black.”
What did it mean?
Fang Heng was stunned.
What happened to Server 5?
The cell phone number that sent the text message was empty. He could not dial it back even if he wanted to.
“Tch, the Riddler would die!!”
After thinking for a moment, Fang Heng cursed softly.
Who cares!
He had more important things to do now.
Previously, when he was learning the skill, Fang Heng had a premonition.
Since efficient reading increased the basic attribute of intelligence, did that mean that the speed and efficiency of reading were also related to intelligence?
The more Fang Heng thought about it, the more he felt that this guess made sense!
Back in the study, Fang Heng sat on the futon and meditated.
After all the distracting thoughts were removed from his mind, Fang Heng once again picked up the “Occult Guide” on the low table.
(Hint: Given that your will has passed the test, your intelligence has also passed the test.]
(Hint: You have obtained the book-Occult Guide (current reading progress: 0.21%).]
Focusing on reading, Fang Heng quickly immersed himself in the contents of the book.
The next day, the morning sun gradually lit up the room.
The drowsy feeling came again.
“I can’t read anymore.”
Fang Heng stretched himself and put the book by the side.
He casually looked out of the window.
What? It’s already dawn?
Did he read all night?
Fang Heng was pleasantly surprised.
Last time, he only read for half an hour and already felt dizzy. This time, not only did he suddenly become engrossed in reading, he managed to read for six hours in a row!
That’s right! Intelligence must have something to do with reading!
Fang Heng lowered his head to check the reading progress again.
(Hint: Current book-“Occult Guide” reading progress 2.82%.]
Compared to last time, the reading progress had greatly increased!
However, Fang Heng was still not satisfied.
The reading efficiency was still a little slow.
If he wanted to finish reading all the books, he would need to spend more time.
Feeling a bit helpless, Fang Heng closed the book and sat on the futon. He focused his mind and meditated, quickly recovering the mental strength that he had used up.
(Hint: Your shelter has completed the construction of Sandy’s art gallery.]
(Hint: Your shelter’s attractiveness has been increased.]
(Hint: The probability of your shelter’s NPC defecting has been permanently reduced by 10%.]

(Hint: Your shelter unlocked art attribute. This attribute can increase the range of your survival radio’s reception and transmission. At the same time, it makes it easier for you to meet NPC survivors.]

(Hint: Every month, you can receive an additional 3 NPCs with specific expertise (hint: only non-hidden expertise; the level of the NPC obtained is random and the highest level obtained is A+. You can increase the probability of obtaining high-level NPCs by raising the art level).]
There was such a good thing?
Every month, he would get three NPC survivors with specific expertise for free!
Fang Heng immediately chose the research staff that the shelter currently lacked the most.
(Hint: Three random NPC survivors with scientific research expertise will visit your shelter within 24 hours. Please be prepared.]
“Fang Heng, look! It’s too beautiful! Isn’t it!”
Sandy stood in the centre of the vast art gallery. He opened his hands and closed his eyes slightly, feeling the aura of art.
“Hmm... maybe, maybe...”
The construction of the art gallery was very simple. It was all basic materials. Once it was ready, it would be built directly via the game system.
Fang Heng pondered in his heart.
There were so many players in the prison now. Should he open the art gallery to them and charge another them entrance fees?
Sandy said excitedly, “Fang Heng, to commemorate this incredible day given the reconstruction of an art gallery, I suggest that we celebrate!”
“Of course! Let’s celebrate. Tonight, we’ll take in a few more survivors and researchers who are wandering outside!”
“Hey! Fang Heng!” Sandy protested, “Even though our relationship is very good, I don’t like to keep running outside. My artwork needs my care, do you understand what I mean?”
(Hint: Sandy’s loyalty has been reduced to 97.]

Fang Heng had tried to let the zombie clones do it for him before.
Unfortunately, zombies couldn’t read.
But now, it was different.
The skill-efficient reading could also be activated by consuming vitality.
So...
Could it also work on zombies?
Zombies didn’t have vitality.
Unlimited reading!
Fang Heng pondered for a moment and prepared to try it out.
He took out a few miscellaneous books from the warehouse and then controlled the zombie clone to walk up to him and use the efficient reading skill to forcefully read the books.
The zombie clone held a book and quickly flipped through the pages.
A long reading progress bar appeared above its head.
At the same time, a hint appeared in Fang Heng’s vision.
(Hint: Your zombie clone has entered the efficient reading state.
By reading the book “How To Become A Top Actor”, you have gained 1 experience point for the efficient reading skill.)
“Ha!
It works!”
Fang Heng slapped his thigh excitedly and immediately called a group of zombies over to the basement.
The zombie clones lined up in front of Fang Heng and took out some miscellaneous books from the storage box that were meant for the players to do pleasure reading.
Rows of game hints floated across Fang Heng’s vision.
(Hint: Your zombie clone has entered the efficient reading state.
You have finished reading the book “996!
Let’s All Roll It Up!” You have gained 6 experience points for the efficient reading skill.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone...)
(Hint: Your skill has been upgraded to Level 17, the current upper limit.
Please upgrade your character’s level.]
In just half an hour, the zombie clones had maxed out the efficient reading skill!
It was done!
Seeing the game hints, Fang Heng threw the “2020 Hengtong Movie Theatre Guard’s Diary” he was reading into the bonfire.
He immediately opened the character’s attribute to check.
The effect of the A+ level skill was remarkable!
The efficient reading skill provided him with 11.8 basic intelligence points!
The current character’s total score was 19.5 basic intelligence points!
Compared to before levelling up the skill, it had more than doubled!
He would go to the real world to try out the skill effect!
Fang Heng threw a simple bed on the spot and went offline.
Offline, Fang Heng couldn’t wait to return to the study room behind the villa, eager to start reading
“Eh?!
Fang Heng turned on his phone to take a look.

Apart from the important summary of the company’s information sent by his assistant Pei Anan every day, as well as Xia Xi’s persistent greetings and recent reports, he also received a text message from an unknown source.
There were only a few words on the text message.
“Server 5-Old Black.”
What did it mean?
Fang Heng was stunned.
What happened to Server 5?
The cell phone number that sent the text message was empty.
He could not dial it back even if he wanted to.
“Tch, the Riddler would die!!”
After thinking for a moment, Fang Heng cursed softly.
Who cares!
He had more important things to do now.
Previously, when he was learning the skill, Fang Heng had a premonition.
Since efficient reading increased the basic attribute of intelligence, did that mean that the speed and efficiency of reading were also related to intelligence?
The more Fang Heng thought about it, the more he felt that this guess made sense!
Back in the study, Fang Heng sat on the futon and meditated.
After all the distracting thoughts were removed from his mind, Fang Heng once again picked up the “Occult Guide” on the low table.
(Hint: Given that your will has passed the test, your intelligence has also passed the test.]
(Hint: You have obtained the book-Occult Guide (current reading progress: 0.21%).]
Focusing on reading, Fang Heng quickly immersed himself in the contents of the book.
The next day, the morning sun gradually lit up the room.
The drowsy feeling came again.
“I can’t read anymore.”
Fang Heng stretched himself and put the book by the side.
He casually looked out of the window.
What?
It’s already dawn?
Did he read all night?
Fang Heng was pleasantly surprised.
Last time, he only read for half an hour and already felt dizzy.
This time, not only did he suddenly become engrossed in reading, he managed to read for six hours in a row!
That’s right!
Intelligence must have something to do with reading!
Fang Heng lowered his head to check the reading progress again.
(Hint: Current book-“Occult Guide” reading progress 2.82%.]
Compared to last time, the reading progress had greatly increased!
However, Fang Heng was still not satisfied.
The reading efficiency was still a little slow.
If he wanted to finish reading all the books, he would need to spend more time.
Feeling a bit helpless, Fang Heng closed the book and sat on the futon.
He focused his mind and meditated, quickly recovering the mental strength that he had used up.
(Hint: Your shelter has completed the construction of Sandy’s art gallery.]
(Hint: Your shelter’s attractiveness has been increased.]
(Hint: The probability of your shelter’s NPC defecting has been permanently reduced by 10%.]
(Hint: Your shelter unlocked art attribute.
This attribute can increase the range of your survival radio’s reception and transmission.
At the same time, it makes it easier for you to meet NPC survivors.]
(Hint: Every month, you can receive an additional 3 NPCs with specific expertise (hint: only non-hidden expertise; the level of the NPC obtained is random and the highest level obtained is A+.
You can increase the probability of obtaining high-level NPCs by raising the art level).]
There was such a good thing?
Every month, he would get three NPC survivors with specific expertise for free!
Fang Heng immediately chose the research staff that the shelter currently lacked the most.
(Hint: Three random NPC survivors with scientific research expertise will visit your shelter within 24 hours.
Please be prepared.]
“Fang Heng, look!
It’s too beautiful!
Isn’t it!”
Sandy stood in the centre of the vast art gallery.
He opened his hands and closed his eyes slightly, feeling the aura of art.
“Hmm... maybe, maybe...”
The construction of the art gallery was very simple.
It was all basic materials.
Once it was ready, it would be built directly via the game system.
Fang Heng pondered in his heart.
There were so many players in the prison now.
Should he open the art gallery to them and charge another them entrance fees?
Sandy said excitedly, “Fang Heng, to commemorate this incredible day given the reconstruction of an art gallery, I suggest that we celebrate!”
“Of course!
Let’s celebrate.
Tonight, we’ll take in a few more survivors and researchers who are wandering outside!”
“Hey!
Fang Heng!” Sandy protested, “Even though our relationship is very good, I don’t like to keep running outside.
My artwork needs my care, do you understand what I mean?”
(Hint: Sandy’s loyalty has been reduced to 97.]

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - Modification
paragraphs: Fang Heng glanced at Sandy.
For the past two days, he had brought Sandy to the Dark Knights every night to accept missions and carry out the plan to poach them.
The effect was exceptionally good!
They had poached nearly 20 researchers in total, including two A-level researchers!
“Celebrate? What suggestions do you have?”

“How about making a batch of gold commemorative medals? Carve my name ‘Sandy’ on the back of the medals. This historic moment should be remembered! Our names should be forever recorded in the history books!”
Fang Heng thought that this proposal was not very good.
Medals did not have any attribute and it was a waste of gold resources.
“Alright, persuade a researcher to join the shelter in exchange for a customized commemorative medal.”
“You... Fang Heng! This is art! This is an insult to art! I thought you could understand me!” This was Sandy’s sore point. He gritted his teeth and insisted, “At least three!”
“Deal.”
“Very good! When can we leave?”
Sandy was full of energy again and returned to his usual fanaticism. “I will convince them to join our shelter. Believe me, this is a haven for artists. They have no reason to refuse to join us!”
“Right now is fine.”
Fang Heng was about to take Sandy with him when a C-level researcher, who had just joined the shelter, knocked on the door and came in.
“Boss, God Qiu asked you to come over. The second phase of the Licker experiment is ready to begin.”
“The second phase of the experiment is ready?”
Fang Heng was pleasantly surprised!
During this period, it was useful to poach so many people to come to the shelter. The research level of the shelter had increased by 10 levels and the research speed had also increased significantly.
“Great! I’ll go now!”
Fang Heng changed into a protective suit and went to the large-scale research room in the newly built basement.
More than 30 researchers gathered behind Qiu Yaokang
They each took notes with pen and paper, looking very respectful.
“Licker Phase II clinical experiment, testing the effectiveness of the Licker modified T-virus, testing the success rate of the T-virus optimization and modification on the Licker.”
Qiu Yaokang’s tone was as calm as usual. He held a checklist in his hand and turned to look at Fang Heng who had just pushed the door open.
“Can we begin?”
“Of course, anytime!”
Qiu Yaokang pressed the red button.
“Ka Ka Ka...”
Three cultivation pod doors opened at the same time.

“The current Phase II clinical experiment is based on the modified T-virus following the Meteorite Company. Once the experiment is successful, theoretically, we can carry out Licker modification without limit.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
Unlimited modifications were good!
However, he would not choose to convert all the zombie clones into Lickers.
Lickers could only be used as a combat unit, and could not be used for resource collection and other operations.
Most of the zombie clones had to be used for development.
“Currently, I’m at Level 17 and I have a total of 202 zombie clones.”
Fang Heng made a mental calculation.
The number of Lickers should be around 50. The remaining three-quarters of the zombie clones needed to be used for daily resource collection and shelter construction.
As for combat, 50 Lickers and proliferator clones made a total of 200.
That was enough!
200 Lickers were enough to trigger a qualitative change.

“Of course, the prerequisite for unlimited Licker modification is sufficient raw materials.” Qiu Yaokang nodded and said, “The synthesis of the Licker modified T-virus requires some special materials, which are difficult to find.”
“Anyway, let’s start the test.”
While speaking, Qiu Yaokang gestured to the three cultivation pods with his eyes.
Fang Heng nodded, then controlled the three zombies to walk into the three cultivation pods.
“Bang!”
The door of the cultivation pod closed at the same time.
“Gulp, gulp, gulp...”
The yellow liquid was injected into the cultivation pod.
A series of bubbles appeared in the cultivation pod.
(Hint: Your zombie life form is changing...]
(Hint: Current evolvable transformation detected, direction-Licker transformation.]
(Hint: Current evolvable transformation success rate: 100%.]
(Hint: You have spent 500 survival points*3 to accelerate Licker evolution transformation.]
(Hint: You have spent 8000 survival points*3; complete evolution crystal*15, permanent solidification to complete the evolution of Licker*3.]
A row of game hints quickly swept across Fang Heng’s eyes.
The zombie’s skin that was soaked in the solution quickly festered, and the limbs of its body quickly mutated.
The many NPC researchers who stood behind Qiu Yaokang and watched the experiment let out soft exclamations. Their eyes lit up as they buried their heads and recorded their observations.
Fang Heng could not help but look back at Qiu Yaokang
Amazing! God Qiu!
Last time, he had a success rate of more than 80, but this time, he directly upped it to 100!
“Bang! Bang! Bang!!”
In a short moment, the Licker transformation was completed, and the hatch opened again.
(Hint: You have completed the Licker transformation*3.)
Three Lickers climbed out of the cultivation pod and docilely climbed to Fang Heng’s side.
Under the watchful eyes of many researchers, Qiu Yaokang walked to the Licker, squatted down again and poked the Licker’s head with the tip of the pen.
The Licker stuck out its red tongue as if it was demonstrating its power.
Qiu Yaokang looked at it coldly and lowered his head to record the data.
“Phase II experiment successful.” “Clap Clap Clap Clap...” The NPC researchers in the laboratory applauded one after another, looking at Qiu Yaokang with admiration.
(Hint: Your shelter has completed the Licker transformation research. Your shelter’s researchers are in high spirits, character experience points gained.]
(Hint: Some of your researcher’s character levels have increased.]
“Just as I thought. After the last modification, the success rate has increased.”
Amidst the applause, Qiu Yaokang slowly turned around.
He felt that the success of the clinical trial was the norm.
“Currently, the remaining research materials can be converted about 72 times at most. If there are any more, I will need more T-virus raw materials and other rare resources.”
As he said that, Qiu Yaokang stood up and turned to look at Fang Heng. “How is it? What are your thoughts?”
“My thoughts? Eh, I think you are a genius! Qiu Yaokang!”
“Don’t repeat this kind of fact. It’s a waste of time.”
Qiu Yaokang looked at the group of NPC researchers behind him.
“The next stage of research is how to fuse the vine parasite with the Licker.”
“After we go back, everyone draws up a feasibility report and analysis research plan. I want to see it tomorrow morning.”
As soon as he finished speaking, the smiles on the researchers’ faces froze.
Fang Heng felt that the atmosphere in the entire room had suddenly become extremely depressing
Qiu Yaokang’s gaze swept across every researcher.
“Aren’t you going back yet? Are you guys not going to sleep tonight?”
The NPC researchers came to a realization one after another, and in the blink of an eye, they had all dispersed.
