chapters.title: Chapter 287 - New Activity
paragraphs: After the researchers left, Fang Heng hurriedly asked, “A Licker that can fuse with a vine zombie? Can that be done?”
The Licker’s predatory ability, coupled with the vine zombie’s strong defensive ability...
Wouldn’t that mean there would be no shortcomings!

“There are still a few challenges that need to be overcome. The problem isn’t too big. We can use this opportunity to train these students. They are still too inexperienced. There are only a few that are of some use.”
Fang Heng opened his mouth.
He felt that Qiu Yaokang’s expectations were too high.
Probably only an A-level researcher was competent enough for him.
“Let’s begin. How many Lickers are you going to transform this time?”
Fang Heng rubbed his hands.
“Let’s make it a whole number! We will start with fifty Lickers first.”
(Hint: Current book-“Occult Guide” reading progress 6.22%.]
After reading every day, Fang Heng stretched his body and was ready to find something to eat.
Just as he left the study, his cell phone rang.
“Deng Xin?”
Seeing the name on the caller ID, Fang Heng was a little surprised.
He wondered if Deng Xin’s luck had always been bad.
Twice in a row, after she received Old Black’s mission, she happened to meet Fang Heng who sabotaged her mission.
The last time, Deng Xin followed Fang Heng to the quarantine zone for a mission. After that, she wisely chose to join Fang Heng’s work studio and sign a contract.
Recently, Fang Heng had not paid much attention to Deng Xin. He had almost forgotten about her.
He did not expect Deng Xin to suddenly take the initiative to contact him.
“Fang Heng, Old Black has contacted me!”
“Huh?”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows and his curiosity was immediately piqued.
Old Black!
Didn’t Night Owl already cut off all the main storyline missions in Server 8?
In theory, their goal had already been achieved.
What’s the next step?
“What’s the matter? Tell me in detail.”
When she initially decided to work with Fang Heng, Deng Xin was still apprehensive.
Although she had signed a contract with Fang Heng’s gaming company, it was still possible for her to hide it if she wanted to.
After some thought, Deng Xin and the team discussed for a while and everyone unanimously decided to be on Fang Heng’s side.
Recently, with the popularity of the prison faction on the internet, Deng Xin was even more determined about this idea.
On one side, there was the dangerous character, Old Black, who was related to the anti-federation forces; and on the other side was the popular and promising Fang Heng.
Even a fool would know which side to choose!

“The specific target of the mission is still unclear. Twenty hours ago, I received an invitation from Old Black and immediately went to the target location to gather. I wanted to contact you at that time, but I couldn’t get in touch.”
“I’m now in a transport van. It wasn’t easy for me to find an opportunity to secretly go offline and call you.”
Fang Heng asked, “Hmm, what else do you know?”
“Old Black didn’t reveal any information related to the mission.”
“I only heard that Old Black has been secretly recruiting a group of people recently. We’re not the only team in the black market that accepted his invitation.”
“As usual, Old Black requested that the entire mission be kept secret.”
Deng Xin was worried that Fang Heng didn’t trust her, so she explained, “Old Black has always been very careful. He’s always been like this. He only tells us the mission information at the end.”
“What’s the specific location of the mission?”
“I’m now in the Gobi District (2813, 9982). I’ve secretly asked the driver about it before. It’s about an hour away.”
Deng Xin reported the coordinates to Fang Heng.

“Old Black is very steady. Once we accept the mission, we’re not allowed to go offline during the period. We’ll stay in the game by drinking coffee until the whole mission is over. I can’t go offline for too long in case I get discovered.”

“Okay, I will rush over now.” Fang Heng lowered his head and thought for a while, then said, “Everything will be as usual for now. When the time comes, I will contact you through the in-game survival radio.”
“Okay, be careful.”
After hanging up the phone, Fang Heng immediately thought of the text message he received from Old Black not long ago.
He did not quite understand the meaning of the text message, but one thing was certain.
Night Owl organization was preparing to play some tricks again.
The matter of the first-generation meteorite had been set up by Night Owl, causing the main storyline mission to be temporarily frozen. Fang Heng had been feeling dispirited because of this.
He would need to create some trouble for them!
It would be best if he could reap some benefits along the way.
Fang Heng decided to go over personally to take a look.
After making up his mind, Fang Heng immediately returned to the game.
Through the teleportation passage, Fang Heng arrived at the Dark Knights’ contact point closest to Deng Xin’s coordinates. A barren desert region.
In the game, survival in the desert region was relatively difficult. Perhaps to balance the difficulty of the game, a cactus plant could often be seen in the desert.
The juice of the plant could provide sufficient water.
However, food was scarce.
Hence, the desert was considered a beginner’s death zone by the player.
Fang Heng rented a motorcycle from the Dark Knights’ contact point and rushed along the desert road to the coordinates.
Halfway there, Fang Heng noticed a military truck speeding past him.
He looked up and saw two black shadows in the distance.
It was a large sentry tower!
The height of the sentry tower was about 15 meters tall. At this stage, very few player shelters could build such a high-level sentry tower. Was it an NPC?
Or perhaps...
The Federation!
Fang Heng opened the built-in map to check.
That’s right, not far away in the desert region, there was a large-scale shelter built by the Federation!
It had been more than a month since the game started.

The Federation mobilized all sorts of resources and completed the construction of the first batch of shelters in the server of District 8. There were a total of five shelters, which were located in various corners of the game world.
There were good and bad things about building a shelter in the desert region.

The good thing was that the vision of the desert region was clear. If they were attacked by the enemy, they could be discovered and dealt with early. In addition, it was easier to mine oil shale and other fuel resources in the desert.
The troublesome part was obtaining food.
Fang Heng rode his motorcycle on the road before the Federation’s large-scale shelter.
A few Federation players looked at Fang Heng warily.
At this stage, the Federation’s shelter was not open to ordinary players. Many of the people living in it were relatives of the Federation’s higher-ups.
Therefore, the establishment of the shelter was exceptionally strong.
The area near the shelter was also guarded by the Federation soldiers. Any player who approached it would be dismissed.
Fang Heng observed the situation briefly and rode his motorcycle away quickly.
On the way, Fang Heng received a message from Deng Xin’s survival radio.
Deng Xin: “We’re here. The coordinates for the Gobi District (2789, 9910).”
The map showed that the gathering place where Deng Xin and the others were was about three kilometres away from the Federation shelter.
So close?
Old Black couldn’t be planning to attack the Federation’s shelter, right?
Fang Heng pondered in his heart.
He felt that it would be a bit difficult to rely on Old Black’s hired men to fight against the Federation’s shelter.
They most likely had other plans!
It would be too conspicuous to make any movements during the day. If they were discovered, they would be in trouble.
Fang Heng stopped his motorcycle and rested by the side of the road.
When the sun was setting and the sky was completely dark, he got up and left the road, heading towards the coordinate point area.

On one side, there was the dangerous character, Old Black, who was related to the anti-federation forces; and on the other side was the popular and promising Fang Heng.
Even a fool would know which side to choose!
“The specific target of the mission is still unclear.
Twenty hours ago, I received an invitation from Old Black and immediately went to the target location to gather.
I wanted to contact you at that time, but I couldn’t get in touch.”
“I’m now in a transport van.
It wasn’t easy for me to find an opportunity to secretly go offline and call you.”
Fang Heng asked, “Hmm, what else do you know?”
“Old Black didn’t reveal any information related to the mission.”
“I only heard that Old Black has been secretly recruiting a group of people recently.
We’re not the only team in the black market that accepted his invitation.”
“As usual, Old Black requested that the entire mission be kept secret.”
Deng Xin was worried that Fang Heng didn’t trust her, so she explained, “Old Black has always been very careful.
He’s always been like this.
He only tells us the mission information at the end.”
“What’s the specific location of the mission?”
“I’m now in the Gobi District (2813, 9982).
I’ve secretly asked the driver about it before.
It’s about an hour away.”
Deng Xin reported the coordinates to Fang Heng.
“Old Black is very steady.
Once we accept the mission, we’re not allowed to go offline during the period.
We’ll stay in the game by drinking coffee until the whole mission is over.
I can’t go offline for too long in case I get discovered.”
“Okay, I will rush over now.” Fang Heng lowered his head and thought for a while, then said, “Everything will be as usual for now.
When the time comes, I will contact you through the in-game survival radio.”
“Okay, be careful.”
After hanging up the phone, Fang Heng immediately thought of the text message he received from Old Black not long ago.
He did not quite understand the meaning of the text message, but one thing was certain.
Night Owl organization was preparing to play some tricks again.
The matter of the first-generation meteorite had been set up by Night Owl, causing the main storyline mission to be temporarily frozen.
Fang Heng had been feeling dispirited because of this.
He would need to create some trouble for them!
It would be best if he could reap some benefits along the way.
Fang Heng decided to go over personally to take a look.
After making up his mind, Fang Heng immediately returned to the game.
Through the teleportation passage, Fang Heng arrived at the Dark Knights’ contact point closest to Deng Xin’s coordinates.
A barren desert region.
In the game, survival in the desert region was relatively difficult.
Perhaps to balance the difficulty of the game, a cactus plant could often be seen in the desert.
The juice of the plant could provide sufficient water.
However, food was scarce.
Hence, the desert was considered a beginner’s death zone by the player.
Fang Heng rented a motorcycle from the Dark Knights’ contact point and rushed along the desert road to the coordinates.
Halfway there, Fang Heng noticed a military truck speeding past him.
He looked up and saw two black shadows in the distance.
It was a large sentry tower!
The height of the sentry tower was about 15 meters tall.
At this stage, very few player shelters could build such a high-level sentry tower.
Was it an NPC?
Or perhaps...
The Federation!
Fang Heng opened the built-in map to check.
That’s right, not far away in the desert region, there was a large-scale shelter built by the Federation!
It had been more than a month since the game started.
The Federation mobilized all sorts of resources and completed the construction of the first batch of shelters in the server of District 8.
There were a total of five shelters, which were located in various corners of the game world.
There were good and bad things about building a shelter in the desert region.
The good thing was that the vision of the desert region was clear.
If they were attacked by the enemy, they could be discovered and dealt with early.
In addition, it was easier to mine oil shale and other fuel resources in the desert.
The troublesome part was obtaining food.
Fang Heng rode his motorcycle on the road before the Federation’s large-scale shelter.
A few Federation players looked at Fang Heng warily.
At this stage, the Federation’s shelter was not open to ordinary players.
Many of the people living in it were relatives of the Federation’s higher-ups.
Therefore, the establishment of the shelter was exceptionally strong.
The area near the shelter was also guarded by the Federation soldiers.
Any player who approached it would be dismissed.
Fang Heng observed the situation briefly and rode his motorcycle away quickly.
On the way, Fang Heng received a message from Deng Xin’s survival radio.
Deng Xin: “We’re here.
The coordinates for the Gobi District (2789, 9910).”
The map showed that the gathering place where Deng Xin and the others were was about three kilometres away from the Federation shelter.
So close?
Old Black couldn’t be planning to attack the Federation’s shelter, right?
Fang Heng pondered in his heart.
He felt that it would be a bit difficult to rely on Old Black’s hired men to fight against the Federation’s shelter.
They most likely had other plans!
It would be too conspicuous to make any movements during the day.
If they were discovered, they would be in trouble.
Fang Heng stopped his motorcycle and rested by the side of the road.
When the sun was setting and the sky was completely dark, he got up and left the road, heading towards the coordinate point area.

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - Prey
paragraphs: Fang Heng’s high physique attribute and the vampire bloodline’s night vision ability made him largely immune to the effects of ‘dark fear’.
Soon, when he was close to the coordinates, Fang Heng noticed that there was a flash of fire in the Gobi Desert not far ahead.
There was a cave entrance in the middle of the Gobi Desert’s bare rock.
The fire was coming from inside the cave.
Fang Heng didn’t go in to investigate immediately. Instead, he hid behind a rock and tried to send a message to Deng Xin to ask about the situation through the survival radio.
Fang Heng: “I’m outside the cave. Are you inside the cave? How’s the situation?”

Deng Xin: “Yes, my team and I are now gathered in the cave. Old Black didn’t show up for this operation. The operation is headed by Liu Keyi. After entering the iron mine, she gave us a shovel and asked us to dig inside the iron mine.” “Dig a cave?”
Seeing Deng Xin’s reply, Fang Heng became even more curious.
He tried to feel in the direction of the rock wall.
“Eh? What’s that?”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes slightly.
With the help of the vampire bloodline’s night vision ability and high perception attribute, Fang Heng noticed that two black shadows were hiding behind the desert rocks not far away.
They were players!
Who could they be?
Fang Heng was puzzled.
He lowered his footsteps and activated his aura concealment skill, carefully approaching the two players.
The two players did not notice that someone was approaching from behind. They were hiding behind a rock, carefully observing the cave ahead through binoculars.
As they got closer, Fang Heng heard the two of them whispering to each other.
“Hiss, this godforsaken place, why don’t we light up a bonfire, it’s so cold.”
“What are you thinking about? Light a bonfire? Aren’t you afraid that others will see you? This mission is very important. Superiors have warned us not to disturb them.”
“I know. I’m just saying. You said that they have been in there for so long, but why haven’t they made any movements? What are they doing in there?”
“Don’t worry about it, as long as the investigation records are fine... once they leave the cave, immediately notify the shelter.”
Fang Heng stopped in his tracks and gave up on the idea of going over to say hello. He dodged into the darkness.
Were they from the Federation?
Thinking about it carefully, it seemed to make sense.
The current game environment was still in the early stages of the game.
Other than a small number of players with special talent attributes, most of the other players could not move at night.
Only the Federation and some large gaming companies could find such a player to conduct investigative work.
And there was only the Federation’s large-scale shelter within a radius of a hundred miles.
Listening to the conversation between these two players, the Federation had already discovered traces of Night Owl.
Moreover, they had not made a move at the first moment. Instead, they were hiding outside the iron mine to observe?
Fang Heng felt that this was getting more and more interesting.
After retreating into the darkness, Fang Heng put on a mask and activated his aura concealment state. He circled from the side and approached the cave entrance.
There were two player guards outside the cave entrance.
Fang Heng leaned against the rock wall and slowly approached. He hid in the blind spot of the two player’s field of vision and once again sent a message to Deng Xin via the survival radio.
Fang Heng: “I’m at the side of the rock wall outside the cave entrance. You think of a way to come out so that we can have a chat”.
Deng Xin: “I’ll give it a try.”.
In just a moment, Deng Xin walked out of the cave.

Deng Xin said to the two players guarding the cave entrance, “The next group of players will take the shift in ten minutes. Go back and report the situation to Liu Keyi. I’ll watch for you for a while.”
“Thank you.”
The two player guards didn’t think much of it. They just thanked her casually and walked into the cave together.
In the cave, there were still a few pairs of eyes staring at Deng Xin.
Deng Xin didn’t leave the line of sight of the others. She pretended to want to breathe fresh air and walked out of the cave casually.
Soon, she heard a soft shout from the side.
“Deng Xin.”
Deng Xin stopped and pretended to be casual. She stretched and responded in a soft voice.

“Fang Heng, I’ve checked. The interior of the cave used to be an abandoned laboratory of the Meteorite Company. For some reason, it was completely blocked by the Meteorite Company. The passage was completely blown
up.”
“Liu Keyi wants us to dig out the entire passage and enter the laboratory.”
“I just saw the construction map provided by Liu Keyi. Given our speed, it will take about two days to completely dig through the passage.”
Fang Heng frowned when he heard that.
Meteorite Company?
Abandoned laboratory?
Sounded like a fancy business!
What tricks was Night Owl up to this time?
Deng Xin said as she turned around and threw a piece of paper in Fang Heng’s direction.
“This is the construction map that I drew based on my memory. Also, this rock is very strange. My team members accidentally dug it when they were digging the passage.”
“Liu Keyi also told us to try our best to collect these rocks.”
“Okay, I got it.”
Fang Heng picked up the piece of paper that Deng Xin threw from the ground.
When he opened it, he saw that the map on the paper was hand-drawn.
He could roughly tell that this was the interior structure of the cave.
There was also a small piece of shrapnel wrapped in the paper ball.
Fang Heng held the shrapnel in his palm and observed it.
[Item: Special small rocks.]
Description: This is a relatively special rock. Upon closer inspection, one could see that there was a blue fluorescent light coming out from it. It looked very strange.
Additional description: You can feel that the rock seems to contain some kind of special energy (Perception attribute greater than 20, additional information obtained).
Was it an ore?
Fang Heng was even more puzzled.
“I heard that this operation is related to the Federation.”
“Night Owl is planning to use this opportunity to strike hard at the Federation’s influence in Server 8.”
“Also, I just noticed that there’s a large number of explosives hidden in the cave.”
“The power of the explosives is enough to blow up the entire cave.”
Explosives again!
What exactly was Night Owl trying to do!
Fang Heng became more and more perplexed.
“Fang Heng, Liu Keyi might get suspicious. I have to go back first.”
“Okay, if there’s anything, contact me through the survival radio.”
The two of them exchanged a few simple words and left.
Fang Heng glanced at the Federation’s surveillance team’s location in the distance and returned the way he came.
He was not sure if the Federation people had noticed him.
But this wasn’t important.
Fang Heng decided to return first. The Federation might know something, so he first found a safe place and went offline to ask Chen Yu about the situation.
If it didn’t work out, at least Phase II of the Licker transformation experiment was about to be completed.
When the time came, he would directly bring the Lickers over and crush them all the way!
“So, Fang Heng, our Federation is the same as you. We were all ruthlessly tricked by Night Owl!”
“Sigh!”
On the other end of the phone, Chen Yu felt a heavy sense of powerlessness.
He was unwilling to accept this fact and sighed deeply.
“The possibility of continuing with the main storyline mission in District 8 is not high anymore.”
“I suggest that you focus on other missions and not fight to the death with the main storyline mission.”
Chen Yu thought that Fang Heng was here to ask him about the main storyline mission, so he persuaded Fang Heng to give up.

Fang Heng nodded. What he learned from Chen Yu was about the same as what he had guessed. The first-generation meteorite had been destroyed. When the Federation came back to their senses, they realized that most of the great engineers in Server 8 had already died.

Chen Yu said, “But it doesn’t matter. If the main storyline mission cannot be completed, it won’t affect the players too much. The Federation will do its best to protect the safety of the people and completely eradicate Night Owl.”
Fang Heng didn’t call because of this matter. He immediately redirected the conversation to the main topic.
“Alright, do you have any news related to the Night Owl organization recently?”

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - Crystal Ore
paragraphs: “Oh, Night Owl...”
Chen Yu stammered.
“About that... actually, I’ve recently been... deployed somewhere. I’m no longer in charge of that side. Why are you asking about this...”
The corners of Fang Heng’s mouth twitched, and he said, “So after you have been used, they kicked you out of the investigation team, is it?”
“Uh... Fang Heng, Don’t rub salt into the wound at this time...”
Chen Yu smiled bitterly in his heart, picked up the coffee on his desk and took a small sip.
“I’ve been entrusted with another role by the leaders. Recently, I’m mainly in charge of the overall planning of the recent Blood Moon incident in Server 8.”
Fang Heng interrupted, “Do me a favour. I heard that Night Owl might be doing something in the Desert Gobi region. Help me find out if there’s any specific news from there?”
“Is that so? I haven’t heard about it. I’ll go and ask around. Wait for my call.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng hung up the phone, sat cross-legged on the futon and closed his eyes to meditate.
About half an hour later, Chen Yu’s call came again.
“Fang Heng, you’re right. I’ve asked a few friends about it. There has indeed been a secret emergency operation in the past two days. The location is in the Desert Gobi region.”
“I have a feeling that this matter might be related to Night Owl because the person in charge of the operation is Zhang Zhe.”
Chen Yu’s tone was also a little uncomfortable.
“I just tried to ask Zhang Zhe, but he said ‘it’s a secret’ and did not reveal anything after that.”
Fang Heng pursed his lips.
It’s him again! Zhang Zhe!
Fang Heng’s impression of Zhang Zhe had never been very good.
If it was Chen Yu who was in charge, Fang Heng was prepared to discuss it with him and seek revenge on Night Owl together.
Since the person in charge was Zhang Zhe, there was no need to do that.
Sensing that Fang Heng had gone silent, Chen Yu had a bad feeling.
“Uh, Fang Heng, something on your mind?”
“Don’t do anything rash. Leave it to our Federation to handle.”
“Yes, I know. Contact me if there’s anything next time.”
Hearing the call hang up, Chen Yu sighed silently.
He felt that with Fang Heng’s personality, he would most likely cause some trouble again.
After thinking about it, Chen Yu decided to send a message to Fang Heng to tell him to be more vigilant and be more careful.
He had just finished typing and sent it over.
“Fang Heng refuses to accept your call...” He was blocked!
Chen Yu gritted his teeth and turned off his phone.
Fang Heng decided to do it himself.
Federation? Night Owl?
His 200 Lickers would be enough to crush them, right?
As the saying goes, “The mantis stalks the cicada and the oriole follows.” He would let them fight first, and then he would sit back and reap the benefits.
After making up his mind, Fang Heng returned to the research room and prepared to lead the group of Lickers that had just completed their evolutionary transformation to join the battle.
“Qiu Yaokang, how’s the Licker transformation going?”
Qiu Yaokang was operating the machine table with a few researchers. He did not even turn his head. “The last batch is still in the process of transformation. It will be completed in ten minutes.”
Fang Heng nodded.
To save some money, Fang Heng did not choose to use his survival points to complete the transformation in an instant. Instead, he would use the time slowly.
He walked to the side of Qiu Yaokang.
“Oh right, there’s still this thing. Help me check it.”
Qiu Yaokang took the small rock in Fang Heng’s hand and carefully examined it under the light. “Interesting. Where did it come from?”
“I picked it up from a cave in the desert.”
Qiu Yaokang walked to the experiment table at the side and put the rock under the microscope to observe.
“It’s a very strange crystal structure. It’s very rare. I need to conduct a thorough examination.”
Half an hour later, Qiu Yaokang found Fang Heng with a detailed inspection report.
“Fang Heng, you found another good thing.”
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched.
Even Qiu Yaokang thought it was a good thing...
“What is it?”
“Do you still remember the high-level energy crystal that you obtained from the Meteorite Company in Pine City not long ago?”
“It’s this?”
Fang Heng had a very good impression of the high-level energy crystal.
It was a blue square crystal.
The high-level energy crystal contained extremely powerful energy.
It was a little difficult to use as a power source, but it could be used to activate the space tearing device.

“Yes, it’s a homologous ore, but the ore in your hand is a very low-quality crystal. Its utilization rate is very low, so it can’t be made into a high-level energy crystal. It can be made into the lowest-level energy crystal.”
“I’ve seen the information you brought out from the Meteorite Company. Where did you find it? I’m sure there should be a high-level crystal ore nearby.”
“High-level crystal ores are usually produced in small quantities. If there’s a chance, it’s best to think of a way to collect them.”
It was a high-level ore!
Fang Heng was first delighted, but then he realized that something was not right.
Night Owl had gathered a group of players from the black market just to mine?
There must be a problem!
Combined with the information from Chen Yu and Deng Xin, there were very few official members of the Night Owl organization who were operating in Server 8!
Most of Night Owl’s operations were through Old Black acting as a middleman, recruiting mercenary groups like Deng Xin from the black market to work.
This meant that the investment of the Night Owl organization in Server 8 was very small.
At this stage, they had no intention of establishing a shelter at all.
If that was the case, did Night Owl need this kind of high-level energy crystal?
Not only did they not have the space tearing device, but they also had no way to transport the ores to another game world.
Just to sell for money?
Fang Heng lowered his head.
He suddenly thought of what Deng Xin had said, that Night Owl had buried a large number of explosives in the iron mine...
Could it be...
A trap?
Night Owl had deliberately let the Federation discover them, then lured the Federation into the passage, and then thought of a way to bury them alive together with the crystal ores?
Good fellow!
Fang Heng called him a good fellow.
The best hunters often appeared as prey.
Was it the Federation who had set up a trap for Night Owl or Night Owl who had plotted to trap the Federation?
But if that was the case, what would happen to the laboratory that had been deliberately sealed and buried by the Meteorite Company?
Fang Heng scratched his head.
He felt that his intelligence was a little lacking.
Fang Heng cursed softly.
Regardless of whether the Federation had taken the bait or not, he had already taken the bait.
The space tearing device was too useful! It was too convenient!
During this period, he often used the space tearing device to run around the world.
He was already addicted.
The remaining high-level energy crystal could continue to open the space tearing passage for about a day. If he did not find new energy, he would not be able to continue using the device to teleport.
In addition, after the completion of the Tier 3 space tearing device, there was also a gap in the energy.
According to Victor, the Tier 3 space tearing device would give rise to a time passage. At that time, it would consume even more energy!
He needed more high-level energy crystals!
Crystal ores!
He had to get them!
Fang Heng took out the hand-drawn map made by Deng Xin from his backpack.
“No matter what tricks Night Owl and the Federation are up to, I want these crystal ores...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
“It doesn’t matter if it’s by brute force or dirty means...”

About half an hour later, Chen Yu’s call came again.
“Fang Heng, you’re right.
I’ve asked a few friends about it.
There has indeed been a secret emergency operation in the past two days.
The location is in the Desert Gobi region.”
“I have a feeling that this matter might be related to Night Owl because the person in charge of the operation is Zhang Zhe.”
Chen Yu’s tone was also a little uncomfortable.
“I just tried to ask Zhang Zhe, but he said ‘it’s a secret’ and did not reveal anything after that.”
Fang Heng pursed his lips.
It’s him again!
Zhang Zhe!
Fang Heng’s impression of Zhang Zhe had never been very good.
If it was Chen Yu who was in charge, Fang Heng was prepared to discuss it with him and seek revenge on Night Owl together.
Since the person in charge was Zhang Zhe, there was no need to do that.
Sensing that Fang Heng had gone silent, Chen Yu had a bad feeling.
“Uh, Fang Heng, something on your mind?”
“Don’t do anything rash.
Leave it to our Federation to handle.”
“Yes, I know.
Contact me if there’s anything next time.”
Hearing the call hang up, Chen Yu sighed silently.
He felt that with Fang Heng’s personality, he would most likely cause some trouble again.
After thinking about it, Chen Yu decided to send a message to Fang Heng to tell him to be more vigilant and be more careful.
He had just finished typing and sent it over.
“Fang Heng refuses to accept your call...” He was blocked!
Chen Yu gritted his teeth and turned off his phone.
Fang Heng decided to do it himself.
Federation?
Night Owl?
His 200 Lickers would be enough to crush them, right?
As the saying goes, “The mantis stalks the cicada and the oriole follows.” He would let them fight first, and then he would sit back and reap the benefits.
After making up his mind, Fang Heng returned to the research room and prepared to lead the group of Lickers that had just completed their evolutionary transformation to join the battle.
“Qiu Yaokang, how’s the Licker transformation going?”
Qiu Yaokang was operating the machine table with a few researchers.
He did not even turn his head.
“The last batch is still in the process of transformation.
It will be completed in ten minutes.”
Fang Heng nodded.
To save some money, Fang Heng did not choose to use his survival points to complete the transformation in an instant.
Instead, he would use the time slowly.
He walked to the side of Qiu Yaokang.
“Oh right, there’s still this thing.
Help me check it.”
Qiu Yaokang took the small rock in Fang Heng’s hand and carefully examined it under the light.
“Interesting.
Where did it come from?”
“I picked it up from a cave in the desert.”
Qiu Yaokang walked to the experiment table at the side and put the rock under the microscope to observe.
“It’s a very strange crystal structure.
It’s very rare.
I need to conduct a thorough examination.”
Half an hour later, Qiu Yaokang found Fang Heng with a detailed inspection report.
“Fang Heng, you found another good thing.”
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched.
Even Qiu Yaokang thought it was a good thing...
“What is it?”
“Do you still remember the high-level energy crystal that you obtained from the Meteorite Company in Pine City not long ago?”
“It’s this?”
Fang Heng had a very good impression of the high-level energy crystal.
It was a blue square crystal.
The high-level energy crystal contained extremely powerful energy.
It was a little difficult to use as a power source, but it could be used to activate the space tearing device.
“Yes, it’s a homologous ore, but the ore in your hand is a very low-quality crystal.
Its utilization rate is very low, so it can’t be made into a high-level energy crystal.
It can be made into the lowest-level energy crystal.”
“I’ve seen the information you brought out from the Meteorite Company.
Where did you find it?
I’m sure there should be a high-level crystal ore nearby.”
“High-level crystal ores are usually produced in small quantities.
If there’s a chance, it’s best to think of a way to collect them.”
It was a high-level ore!
Fang Heng was first delighted, but then he realized that something was not right.
Night Owl had gathered a group of players from the black market just to mine?
There must be a problem!
Combined with the information from Chen Yu and Deng Xin, there were very few official members of the Night Owl organization who were operating in Server 8!
Most of Night Owl’s operations were through Old Black acting as a middleman, recruiting mercenary groups like Deng Xin from the black market to work.
This meant that the investment of the Night Owl organization in Server 8 was very small.
At this stage, they had no intention of establishing a shelter at all.
If that was the case, did Night Owl need this kind of high-level energy crystal?
Not only did they not have the space tearing device, but they also had no way to transport the ores to another game world.
Just to sell for money?
Fang Heng lowered his head.
He suddenly thought of what Deng Xin had said, that Night Owl had buried a large number of explosives in the iron mine...
Could it be...
A trap?
Night Owl had deliberately let the Federation discover them, then lured the Federation into the passage, and then thought of a way to bury them alive together with the crystal ores?
Good fellow!
Fang Heng called him a good fellow.
The best hunters often appeared as prey.
Was it the Federation who had set up a trap for Night Owl or Night Owl who had plotted to trap the Federation?
But if that was the case, what would happen to the laboratory that had been deliberately sealed and buried by the Meteorite Company?
Fang Heng scratched his head.
He felt that his intelligence was a little lacking.
Fang Heng cursed softly.
Regardless of whether the Federation had taken the bait or not, he had already taken the bait.
The space tearing device was too useful!
It was too convenient!
During this period, he often used the space tearing device to run around the world.
He was already addicted.
The remaining high-level energy crystal could continue to open the space tearing passage for about a day.
If he did not find new energy, he would not be able to continue using the device to teleport.
In addition, after the completion of the Tier 3 space tearing device, there was also a gap in the energy.
According to Victor, the Tier 3 space tearing device would give rise to a time passage.
At that time, it would consume even more energy!
He needed more high-level energy crystals!
Crystal ores!
He had to get them!
Fang Heng took out the hand-drawn map made by Deng Xin from his backpack.
“No matter what tricks Night Owl and the Federation are up to, I want these crystal ores...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
“It doesn’t matter if it’s by brute force or dirty means...”

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - Praising
paragraphs: “What? You’ve been together with him for so long, and there’s no progress at all?”
Qiao Ling was surprised and she covered her mouth in disbelief.
“Sister’s figure is so good, but Fang Heng can withstand it? That’s impossible...”
Lucia also felt wronged. She lowered her head and silently used the whetstone to sharpen her short dagger.
Qiao Ling suddenly thought of something and looked at Lucia with sympathy.
“Sister, Fang Heng isn’t... from Nantong University’s School of Infrastructure, is he?”
“Huh? What?”
Lucia looked up, her face full of bafflement. She didn’t understand what Qiao Ling was saying.
“Sister Lucia, didn’t you notice that the relationship between Colonel Fang Heng and First Lieutenant Mo Jiawei is not so simple?”
Qiao Ling explained in a serious tone, “It seems that they are always together during every operation, right? Do you think... they
are?
“Ah? The two of them?”
Qiao Ling nodded crazily.
“Something’s wrong!”
Lucia kept silent, lowered her head and continued to sharpen her knife.
Her sharp and cold eyes were reflected on the shiny blade. “Don’t give up! Sister is so charming. Even a gay can be straightened by you!”
“Oh right, I spent a lot of effort to find the tea ceremony last time. Did you see it?”
“Does it work? I tried it last time, but it didn’t work well.”
“Yes, yes! It works! You have to persevere! Sister Lucia!”
Qiao Ling nodded, “Just like what I said last time, a man is a creature that likes to be worshipped. Praise him, praise him fiercely! I don’t believe that he can control himself!”
Lucia nodded and muttered to herself, “Praise him fiercely, praise him fiercely...”
David walked in.
“Lucia, Colonel Fang Heng just came to look for me. He looked very anxious and said that he needs your help. Do you have time to go find him? He just left.”
Hearing Fang Heng’s name, Lucia suddenly stood up and clenched the dagger in her hand.
“Okay! I’ll go over now!”
Qiao Ling waved at Lucia, “Sister Lucia! Good luck! Remember! Praise fiercely!”
“Sir, we have already compared some of the images we have captured with the database.”
“Most of the players who appeared in the cave are often active in the black market.”
“We have confirmed that the Night Owl organization hired these players behind the scenes. We suspect that they are excavating inside the iron mine. The target may be a special crystallized creature.”
Zhang Zhe did not speak. He carefully flipped through the files in his hands.
He had experienced a similar mission in the old district.
The crystallized creature and main storyline mission had a lot of relevance, but this mission was not important.
It was equivalent to a relatively late-stage side mission.
Completing the mission could increase the completion rate of the main storyline and change the direction of the outcome.
The prerequisite was that the player needed to complete the main storyline mission!
If the main storyline mission could not be completed, then no matter how many side missions there were, it would be a waste.
The mission difficulty was quite high. For the Federation, now was not the best time to trigger the mission.
In addition, the crystal ore related to the mission was also very valuable for mining.
That was the raw ore of the late-stage high-level energy crystal!
However, the extraction and synthesis of the high-level energy crystal were very complicated, and it was also very troublesome to gather, so it was not needed in the early stages...
For various reasons, the Federation was unable to take out so much manpower and material resources in the early stages to mine ore resources that were not needed for at least half a year.

However, the Federation was also very clear about the importance of the blue crystal ore, which was why they had chosen to establish a shelter in the nearby desert area and send people to guard the crystal mine area.
Zhang Zhe did not expect Night Owl to make a move so quickly, and it was aimed at the crystal mine.

“Sir, the reserve fighters have already gathered in the shelter and are on standby. They are ready to attack at any time and capture all the members of the Night Owl organization who participated in this operation.”
“No, wait a little longer.”

“Do we still have to wait?” The vice-captain of the temporary combat team, Tang Chu, frowned slightly. “Sir, if we wait any longer, will there be any accidents? If the ore is collected by Night Owl in advance or destroyed...”
“There’s no rush. Crystal ores are different from ordinary ores.”
“Different?”
Zhang Zhe shook his head and did not answer.
He did not feel like explaining to these people, nor did he want to explain to them.
As it involved part of the main storyline mission, once he explained, his King of Gods’ points and personal survival points would be deducted.
The more information was leaked, the greater the deduction. After deducting his points, they would deduct his basic attributes.
No one could withstand such a punishment.
A Federation soldier knocked on the door and walked into the room.
“Captain, it’s an emergency. The investigation team found a large number of zombies moving along Highway No. 702. There are about 400 to 500 of them.”
Tang Chu frowned and looked at Zhang Zhe. At this time? Could it be related to the Night Owl organization?
Zhang Zhe immediately put down the file in his hand.
“Take me there to have a look!”
Everyone quickly came to the sentry towers.
Zhang Zhe took the binoculars and looked at the highway.
On the road, a large group of zombies were huddled together, staggering along the road.
“Their target is not the shelter.”
Noticing that the target of this wave of wandering zombies was not the shelter, Tang Chu heaved a sigh of relief.
Zhang Zhe frowned.
He felt that there was something wrong with this wave of zombies!
However, he couldn’t tell what exactly was wrong.
On the surface, everything looked normal.
A Federation soldier said, “It should be a random zombie tide. It will disperse soon. If we don’t provoke it, we won’t be attacked.”
“Sir, should we call our people back?”
“No, we don’t need to. Send a few more people to follow them. Ask them to check the crystal mine again.”
Zhang Zhe was a little uneasy. He decided to send a few people to follow them to take a look.
“Yes!”
The Federation soldier saluted and was about to go downstairs to pass on the order.
“Sir, sir...” At the side, a recruit’s lips trembled. “Look over there, what’s That?”
Everyone followed the recruit’s gaze and looked into the distance.
A faint red colour appeared on the horizon.
The red colour gradually formed a line.
Zhang Zhe’s pupils constricted.
Lickers?!
Hundreds of Lickers gathered together and quickly swept across the road!
From afar, it looked like a red wave.
They were heading straight for the shelter! The players on the sentry tower felt their scalps go numb.
So many Lickers?!
Several thoughts flashed through Zhang Zhe’s mind.
Were the Lickers controlled by the Night Owl organization?
They were heading for the shelter?
Why?
Was this part of Night Owl’s plan?
Night Owl’s goal was the shelter? Then what was the situation at the crystal mine?
“Not good! They’re heading towards the shelter!”
Tang Chu was the first to react. He immediately turned around and gave the Federation soldier an order.
“Sound Level 1 alarm! All players enter combat mode. Summon all reserve players to come online immediately.”
“Everyone gather and prepare for battle!”

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - Luck
paragraphs: [Hint: Your zombie clone has excavated. You have obtained shrapnel*2.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has excavated. You have obtained small rocks*4...]
In front of Gobi Desert.
Fang Heng opened a packet of durian-flavoured Oreos and stuffed one into his mouth. Then, he handed the rest to Mo Jiawei.
“Here? Have a taste?”
“No need, God. I’m not hungry yet.”
Mo Jiawei and Fang Heng were standing on a high cliff not far away, looking down.
More than 300 zombies gathered together, wielding iron picks and constantly digging into the interior of the mountain wall.
The rocks they dug out had already piled up to a few small hills.
Fang Heng stuffed another piece of biscuit into his mouth.
After thinking for a while, he decided to play dirty this time.
“Fang Heng, have you noticed that Lucia seems a little weird today?”
“Eh? What’s weird about her?”
“I think she looks at me with a murderous look in her eyes.”
Mo Jiawei rubbed his chin and thought for a while, then asked with confusion, “Am I overthinking? I don’t think I’ve ever offended her.”
“Yeah, I don’t understand either. I think you’re overthinking.”
Mo Jiawei didn’t think about it anymore. He looked at the big hole dug by the zombie team and asked, “Is the crystal ore we’re looking for inside?”
“I think so.”
Fang Heng opened the blueprint of the cave and explained it to Mo Jiawei.
“It’s like this. The Night Owl organization has prepared explosives in the passage opening on the other side.”
“The Federation should also know about Night Owl’s actions, but they haven’t made any moves yet. They’re just secretly observing from the side.”
“I also don’t know what kind of trick they’re playing, so let’s be straightforward and dig a passage through here directly. We’ll think of a way to be faster than Night Owl’s people.”
“We will secretly dig out all the ores inside, pack them up and take them away.”
Fang Heng once again reiterated the strategy to Mo Jiawei.
“In short, try to get as many benefits as possible. Don’t get into a conflict with the Federation and Night Owl’s people. They can fight each other, and we can mine the ores.”
Hearing that, Mo Jiawei nodded in agreement.
He then lowered his head to look at the zombie team that was busy digging.
“But, Fang Heng, with so many zombies gathered together, isn’t the commotion a little big? We won’t be discovered by night owl or the federation, Right?”

“We only started digging after crossing the other side of the Gobi Desert. If anyone wants to discover us, they have to cross the Gobi Desert as well. Night Owl’s people are still busy digging, so theoretically, they won’t be able to discover us.”
“What about the Federation?”
Mo Jiawei was more worried about the Federation.

“The people of the Federation have been keeping an eye on this mine and the Night Owl organization. It’s a little troublesome to investigate at night. It’s daytime now. If we send more people to strengthen the inspection, I’m afraid we might be exposed.”
“You’re right. So to prevent accidents, I asked Lucia to bring the Lickers to play with the people from the Federation. Let them get busy.”
“Play...”
Listening to Fang Heng’s casual narration, Mo Jiawei felt a chill down his spine.
He wasn’t sure what Fang Heng meant by playing with toys.
However, when Mo Jiawei was called by Fang Heng to participate in the special mission last night, he had seen the red Lickers with his own eyes.
It was too terrifying.
If he were in the Federation, he wouldn’t have the mood to go to the other side of the Gobi Desert to investigate when he saw a group of Lickers surrounding the shelter early in the morning.
Fang Heng yawned as he spoke.
He hadn’t slept all night, so he was a little tired.
He forced himself to perk up.
“I’ll have to rely on you from now on, Jiawei!”
“Huh?”
Mo Jiawei was confused. He pointed at his nose.
“Up to me? What do I have to do with it?”
Mo Jiawei felt strange. He was woken up by Fang Heng in the middle of the night, and then came to watch the zombies mine.
He felt that he didn’t have much use. At most, he would help Fang Heng look after the simple bed when he went offline.
“Of course, there’s something to do.”
Fang Heng’s expression was exceptionally serious.
“Brother, stop pretending. I already know everything. During this period, I often go to the gym. I’ve heard of your amazing deeds. You’re very lucky, right?”
When Mo Jiawei heard this, his expression froze.
“Fang Heng, don’t listen to their nonsense. It’s all fake! It’s a lie!”
“It can’t be fake. In the beginning, I was also skeptical. Later on, I thought about it and realized that it was true.”

“Generally speaking, you were born as the chosen one, the direct heir of North River Heavy Industry. You’re the only one and there is no competitor. Once you enter the game, you immediately have an S-level talent, and the mission that you randomly accepted turns out to be the main storyline of the Dark Knights...”
“Going into details, when the sewer exploded, the shrapnel that fell from your head was always the smallest.”

“I also heard from the other brothers in the gym that when you were young, your great-grandfather tested your uncles’ business skills and gave them a sum of money to invest in their businesses. He wanted to see which of them could get 100 million as fast as possible.”
“In the end, your Sixth Uncle brought you to the casino. Is that true?”
Listening to Fang Heng’s serious narration, Mo Jiawei felt like crying.
“Indeed, but... but that time at the casino, my Sixth Uncle even lost his underwear...”
Fang Heng’s words were conclusive.
“Then there must be something wrong with this casino.”
“There’s no choice. The time is too short, and I can’t find a high-level geological exploration player to find the specific mineral point of the crystal ores, so I’m relying on you.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he handed the hand-drawn map to Mo Jiawei.
“Come, point at a random location.”
“Fang Heng, don’t do these metaphysical things.”
“Hurry up and pick a random location. I won’t let you take the blame.”
Mo Jiawei had never thought that Fang Heng had dragged him here for this.
Seeing that he couldn’t escape from it, he could only silently point at a random location. “Then, let’s do it here. What do you think?”
“I think it’s not bad either.”
Fang Heng glanced at the spot that Mo Jiawei pointed at, then controlled a part of the zombie team to change the angle and start digging in another direction.
Eight hours later.
Mo Jiawei and Fang Heng each drank two tons of coffee.
“Fang Heng, we’ve been digging for so long, but there’s still no movement. Did we pick the right place?”
“Don’t worry. We’ll see. You have to believe in your ability.”
Mo Jiawei thought to himself, “What ability do I have?”
Fang Heng was calm.
At this stage of the game, the player’s level was too low. There was no way to find the exact location of the crystal mine.
Anyway, it was just a random bet.
He was half serious and half joking when he asked Mo Jiawei to guess.
Fang Heng had a backup plan.

A large number of zombies crowded together to dig, which would affect the efficiency. Therefore, he divided the zombie team into three teams. Two teams were digging in different directions, and one team was responsible for transporting the excavated stones.
One team was digging along the passage pointed out by Mo Jiawei, while the other team was digging toward the location of the laboratory marked on Deng Xin’s hand-drawn map.
Fang Heng felt that if Mo Jiawei failed, he could still try to get information about the crystal ore from the laboratory.
Anyway, there was still plenty of time.
While he was thinking, the game suddenly gave a hint of a new message.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has excavated, you have obtained inferior blue crystal ore*2.]
[Hint: You have learned the method to identify blue crystal ore from the NPC Qiu Yaokang.]
It’s here!
Huh?
It’s from Mo Jiawei’s passage!

“Yeah, I don’t understand either.
I think you’re overthinking.”
Mo Jiawei didn’t think about it anymore.
He looked at the big hole dug by the zombie team and asked, “Is the crystal ore we’re looking for inside?”
“I think so.”
Fang Heng opened the blueprint of the cave and explained it to Mo Jiawei.
“It’s like this.
The Night Owl organization has prepared explosives in the passage opening on the other side.”
“The Federation should also know about Night Owl’s actions, but they haven’t made any moves yet.
They’re just secretly observing from the side.”
“I also don’t know what kind of trick they’re playing, so let’s be straightforward and dig a passage through here directly.
We’ll think of a way to be faster than Night Owl’s people.”
“We will secretly dig out all the ores inside, pack them up and take them away.”
Fang Heng once again reiterated the strategy to Mo Jiawei.
“In short, try to get as many benefits as possible.
Don’t get into a conflict with the Federation and Night Owl’s people.
They can fight each other, and we can mine the ores.”
Hearing that, Mo Jiawei nodded in agreement.
He then lowered his head to look at the zombie team that was busy digging.
“But, Fang Heng, with so many zombies gathered together, isn’t the commotion a little big?
We won’t be discovered by night owl or the federation, Right?”
“We only started digging after crossing the other side of the Gobi Desert.
If anyone wants to discover us, they have to cross the Gobi Desert as well.
Night Owl’s people are still busy digging, so theoretically, they won’t be able to discover us.”
“What about the Federation?”
Mo Jiawei was more worried about the Federation.
“The people of the Federation have been keeping an eye on this mine and the Night Owl organization.
It’s a little troublesome to investigate at night.
It’s daytime now.
If we send more people to strengthen the inspection, I’m afraid we might be exposed.”
“You’re right.
So to prevent accidents, I asked Lucia to bring the Lickers to play with the people from the Federation.
Let them get busy.”
“Play...”
Listening to Fang Heng’s casual narration, Mo Jiawei felt a chill down his spine.
He wasn’t sure what Fang Heng meant by playing with toys.
However, when Mo Jiawei was called by Fang Heng to participate in the special mission last night, he had seen the red Lickers with his own eyes.
It was too terrifying.
If he were in the Federation, he wouldn’t have the mood to go to the other side of the Gobi Desert to investigate when he saw a group of Lickers surrounding the shelter early in the morning.
Fang Heng yawned as he spoke.
He hadn’t slept all night, so he was a little tired.
He forced himself to perk up.
“I’ll have to rely on you from now on, Jiawei!”
“Huh?”
Mo Jiawei was confused.
He pointed at his nose.
“Up to me?
What do I have to do with it?”
Mo Jiawei felt strange.
He was woken up by Fang Heng in the middle of the night, and then came to watch the zombies mine.
He felt that he didn’t have much use.
At most, he would help Fang Heng look after the simple bed when he went offline.
“Of course, there’s something to do.”
Fang Heng’s expression was exceptionally serious.
“Brother, stop pretending.
I already know everything.
During this period, I often go to the gym.
I’ve heard of your amazing deeds.
You’re very lucky, right?”
When Mo Jiawei heard this, his expression froze.
“Fang Heng, don’t listen to their nonsense.
It’s all fake!
It’s a lie!”
“It can’t be fake.
In the beginning, I was also skeptical.
Later on, I thought about it and realized that it was true.”
“Generally speaking, you were born as the chosen one, the direct heir of North River Heavy Industry.
You’re the only one and there is no competitor.
Once you enter the game, you immediately have an S-level talent, and the mission that you randomly accepted turns out to be the main storyline of the Dark Knights...”
“Going into details, when the sewer exploded, the shrapnel that fell from your head was always the smallest.”
“I also heard from the other brothers in the gym that when you were young, your great-grandfather tested your uncles’ business skills and gave them a sum of money to invest in their businesses.
He wanted to see which of them could get 100 million as fast as possible.”
“In the end, your Sixth Uncle brought you to the casino.
Is that true?”
Listening to Fang Heng’s serious narration, Mo Jiawei felt like crying.
“Indeed, but... but that time at the casino, my Sixth Uncle even lost his underwear...”
Fang Heng’s words were conclusive.
“Then there must be something wrong with this casino.”
“There’s no choice.
The time is too short, and I can’t find a high-level geological exploration player to find the specific mineral point of the crystal ores, so I’m relying on you.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he handed the hand-drawn map to Mo Jiawei.
“Come, point at a random location.”
“Fang Heng, don’t do these metaphysical things.”
“Hurry up and pick a random location.
I won’t let you take the blame.”
Mo Jiawei had never thought that Fang Heng had dragged him here for this.
Seeing that he couldn’t escape from it, he could only silently point at a random location.
“Then, let’s do it here.
What do you think?”
“I think it’s not bad either.”
Fang Heng glanced at the spot that Mo Jiawei pointed at, then controlled a part of the zombie team to change the angle and start digging in another direction.
Eight hours later.
Mo Jiawei and Fang Heng each drank two tons of coffee.
“Fang Heng, we’ve been digging for so long, but there’s still no movement.
Did we pick the right place?”
“Don’t worry.
We’ll see.
You have to believe in your ability.”
Mo Jiawei thought to himself, “What ability do I have?”
Fang Heng was calm.
At this stage of the game, the player’s level was too low.
There was no way to find the exact location of the crystal mine.
Anyway, it was just a random bet.
He was half serious and half joking when he asked Mo Jiawei to guess.
Fang Heng had a backup plan.
A large number of zombies crowded together to dig, which would affect the efficiency.
Therefore, he divided the zombie team into three teams.
Two teams were digging in different directions, and one team was responsible for transporting the excavated stones.
One team was digging along the passage pointed out by Mo Jiawei, while the other team was digging toward the location of the laboratory marked on Deng Xin’s hand-drawn map.
Fang Heng felt that if Mo Jiawei failed, he could still try to get information about the crystal ore from the laboratory.
Anyway, there was still plenty of time.
While he was thinking, the game suddenly gave a hint of a new message.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has excavated, you have obtained inferior blue crystal ore*2.]
[Hint: You have learned the method to identify blue crystal ore from the NPC Qiu Yaokang.]
It’s here!
Huh?
It’s from Mo Jiawei’s passage!

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - Iron Mine
paragraphs: Fang Heng patted Mo Jiawei on the shoulder.
“We found something. Let’s go and take a look!”
The excavation efficiency of the zombie team was extremely fast and they had dug out two caves hundreds of meters deep along the passage.
The two of them went to the deepest part of the cave together.
In front of them, the zombie team was still waving their iron axes and digging the cave.
One by one, the zombies were transporting the ores out of the cave.
Fang Heng checked the crystal ores that were excavated.
Item: Inferior blue crystal raw ore.
Level: D.
Description: Inferior grade. After special chemical purification, it can be used to extract C-D level blue crystal ores.
Success! That’s it!
Fang Heng turned around and gave Mo Jiawei a thumbs up.
Not bad!
Mo Jiawei’s luck was not bad!
They were already able to dig up the ore, which meant that they were heading in the right direction.
“No way? We found them?”
Mo Jiawei felt that this was a bit ridiculous.
Fang Heng praised, “I told you, ‘A fly does not bite an egg with no cracks’. Your luck is not bad.”
“What metaphor are you using... Fang Heng, you have to believe in science.”
Mo Jiawei was quite speechless.
“If I have the ability, wouldn’t I be able to dig up the blue crystal ore with just a casual dig?”
To prove himself, Mo Jiawei randomly picked up an iron pick on the ground and smashed it against the rock wall at the side.
“Bang!”
The rock wall made a loud sound.
“Look, it’s just a coincidence this time. My luck is just so-so, it’s not believable.”
To prove that his character was not that good, Mo Jiawei raised his pickaxe again and aimed at the spot where he had just hit, trying to smash out a stone to test his character.
“Bang!”
The pickaxe smashed into the rock wall again.
“Ka... Ka Ka Ka...”
The entire rock wall showed fine cracks under this heavy strike.
The cracks spread out rapidly in all directions like a spider web.
“Boom!!!”
There was a loud sound!
The rock wall in front of him formed pieces of shrapnel and collapsed backwards.
After the dust settled, a black hole appeared in front of Mo Jiawei.
“This...”
Mo Jiawei was stunned.
Fang Heng opened his mouth in disbelief.
He shone his flashlight into the hole.
Behind the hole was an artificially mined iron mine.
Blue fluorescent stones could be seen on the walls of the iron mine.
“Blue crystal raw ores?”
Fang Heng was also stunned,
He turned his head and looked at Mo Jiawei, who was also stunned.
When he first heard the story of Mo Jiawei’s uncles doing business, Fang Heng thought that Mo Jiawei’s sixth uncle was a joke.
It turned out that...
His sixth uncle was the one with great wisdom.
They found the ores!
The next step was naturally to take all the ores away!
Fang Heng patted Mo Jiawei’s shoulder vigorously.
“Mo Jiawei, I’ve said it long ago. You’re a talent!”
Fang Heng took out a shotgun and used the handle of the gun to clean and expand the hole until it could accommodate an adult.
After entering the iron mine, Fang Heng looked around.
This iron mine had been mined before. The walls were full of holes, and there were still messy mining tools on the ground.
Strangely, the entrance of the iron mine on the right side had been sealed by a large amount of shrapnel.
Fang Heng squatted down and picked up a miner’s hat from the ground.
He noticed the logo of the Meteorite Company on the miner’s hat.
[Item: Damaged miner’s hat.]
Description: This item has been damaged. It can provide weak protection to the head when worn.
“It looks like the Meteorite Company had been here before and have even collected the blue crystal ores here.”
Mo Jiawei followed him into the iron mine and looked around.
He soon noticed that the exit was blocked by rocks.
“The entrance to the iron mine has been sealed? Is it a landslide? Did the mining team meet with an accident?”
Fang Heng sniffed.
There was a familiar smell in the air.
“It doesn’t seem like an accident. There’s no corpse here, and there’s still the smell of gunpowder. It feels like the entrance was sealed by an explosion.”
“Ah? The entrance was sealed on purpose?”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng nodded.
He felt that it was strange.
The Meteorite Company must have understood the value of the high-level energy crystal.
There was still more than half of the ores left in the iron mine.
Why did they suddenly stop mining?
What had happened that forced them to make such a choice?
“Fang Heng, come and take a look. There’s a box here.”
Mo Jiawei found a wooden box in the corner and called Fang Heng over to check.
The box was not locked. There was also a symbol of Meteorite Company on it.
Fang Heng walked to the side of the box and carefully opened a gap in the box.
“Buzz...”
A faint blue light shone through the gap on Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei’s faces.
D*mn it, there was half a box of blue crystal ores in the box!
Fang Heng casually picked up a piece of ore and examined it.
Item: Premium blue crystal raw ore.
Level: S.
Description: The premium blue crystal raw ore contains powerful energy waves. After special chemical purification, A-S level blue crystal ores can be extracted from it.
Jackpot!
Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei looked at each other and saw the surprise in each other’s eyes.
Who cares why!
Since they had found the iron mine, they should start mining immediately and move all the ores back home!
“Let’s go, start digging!”
Without saying anything else, Fang Heng controlled the zombie team to drill through the hole and enter the abandoned iron mine.
The zombies waved their shovels and started digging at the blue spots on the other wall.
Five o’clock in the afternoon.
The Federation’s shelter in the desert area was still under Level 1 State of Siege.
They had been in a stalemate with the Lickers outside for the whole day!
The Lickers’ actions were too strange.
They did not seem to have any intention of attacking the shelter.
But they did not leave easily. Instead, they stayed at the periphery of the shelter and kept wandering around.
Five hours ago, when the Lickers first retreated, the Federation players let out a sigh of relief.
But before they could deactivate the alarm, the Lickers suddenly turned around and headed straight for the shelter.
They went back and forth a dozen times.
Sometimes they were close, sometimes they were far away.
The Federation players in the shelter were all under a lot of mental pressure from the group of Lickers. They were afraid that they would suddenly attack the shelter.
Half an hour ago, the group of Lickers had entered the shelter’s range.
Tang Chu gradually lost his patience.
He felt that the group of Lickers seemed to be playing with him, constantly challenging his bottom line.
“Captain Yu, the Lickers has entered the attack range. Should we try to attack?”
“No! Absolutely not.”
Yu Jie, the main person in charge of the shelter, firmly refused.
“This group of Lickers is behaving strangely. They are not attacking the shelter either because they are apprehensive, or maybe they are not targeting us.”

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - Asking for Help
paragraphs: “If we act rashly, we might arouse their hostility and force them to attack the shelter. At that time, we will be even more passive.”
Tang Chu could not refute.
He knew that Yu Jie was right.
“But are we just going to wait? Maybe we can try to attack and force them to retreat?”

“We can’t afford to gamble. The shelter’s current defense is not strong enough to withstand such a large number of Lickers. Even if we force the Lickers back, we can’t afford to suffer casualties and losses.”
“This will make us lose most of the combat ability against the zombies in the upcoming Blood Moon.”
Tang Chu clenched his fists.
He could not bear to sit and wait for death!
He turned his head to look at Zhang Zhe.
“Sir, is this group of Lickers related to the Night Owl organization?”
“I’m not sure.”
Zhang Zhe maintained his calm on the surface, but he was actually very uneasy inside.
In his opinion, this group of Lickers that had suddenly appeared was too strange. It was indeed very likely to be related to Night Owl.
But...
Did Night Owl have the ability to control the Lickers?
“Sir, could it be someone from the prison? I’ve come into contact with some intelligence before. The player in the prison can control Lickers in battle.”
Yu Jie had also heard of Fang Heng’s prison shelter. He raised his head and asked, “Are you talking about Fang Heng?”
“No, it can’t be him.”
Zhang Zhe firmly rejected it.
“I just met Fang Heng not long ago. I even worked with him for a short period of time during the mission.”
“He can indeed control a small number of Lickers, but there are definitely not that many.”
“Moreover, the prison is very far away from us, and the energy consumption of the space tearing passage is very high. It is impossible for the prison to transfer such a large number of Lickers.”
“Most importantly, the prison has no motive to attack our shelter.”
In the command room, everyone fell silent again.
Zhang Zhe asked, “Are our people still monitoring Night Owl? Do they have any new special reports?”
“We keep in contact with the monitoring team every 15 minutes offline. We just confirmed it three minutes ago.”
“So far, we have not found anyone leaving or entering the iron mine. We believe that the Night Owl organization is still excavating inside the cave.”
“We’ve conducted an analysis of the iron mine in advance. Based on the number of players entering the iron mine, it will take at least two days to dig through and enter the laboratory.”
Zhang Zhe looked at the time.
It had already been almost a day.
There was only one day left.
Theoretically speaking, it was almost impossible for Night Owl to be related to the group of Lickers outside.
However, the timing of their appearance was too coincidental.
Zhang Zhe felt apprehensive and insecure inside.
“Let’s organize a small team. I want to go over there and see for myself.”
“Now? This is too dangerous. What if those Lickers attack us?”
Zhang Zhe’s eyes narrowed.
“Colonel Tang Chu, this is an order. Night Owl is more dangerous than the group of Lickers outside.”
Tang Chu’s expression turned solemn.
“Yes, Sir!”
Yu Jie nodded and said, “I will stay here and provide backup. I wish you good luck.”
Ten minutes later, Zhang Zhe and Tang Chu finished their preparations and left the right side of the shelter with a team of twelve Federation elites.
The team maintained a high level of vigilance and gradually moved away from the Lickers from the side of the shelter.
Every member slowed down their footsteps and held their breath, trying not to attract the attention of the Lickers.
Tang Chu’s heart was in his throat.
He prayed in his heart that he would not be discovered by the Lickers.
In the distance, behind a broken bunker, Lucia revealed herself.
A layer of blood-red light appeared in her pupils.
After the modification from the biological weapon project, Lucia’s super strong vision allowed her to immediately capture the movements of the party of players.
Following Fang Heng’s instructions, Lucia stretched out her hand and pointed at Zhang Zhe’s team.
“Go!”
“Chi Chi Chi...”
The Lickers waiting outside the shelter received the order and immediately rushed toward Zhang Zhe’s team.
“D*mn it! They’re coming!”
“Retreat! Retreat quickly! !”
The soft sounds of “chi” were like a life-threatening charm!
Tang Chu quivered, shouted and took the lead to turn around and run.
It was too terrifying!
Hundreds of Lickers gathered together and madly rushed toward them.
The extreme pressure made Tang Chu unable to breathe and he couldn’t even think of resisting.
The entire team only had one thought in their minds.
Run!
The entire team practically rolled and crawled back to the shelter.
“Da Da... Da Da Da...”
Outside the shelter, the 10 automatic cannons that the Federation spent a large sum of money to buy opened fire at the same time!
Unfortunately, the output of the automatic cannons was still too weak!
Chi Chi Chi..
When the Lickers saw that the players had already retreated back into the shelter, they quickly retreated the same way.
They retreated again, maintaining a safe distance from the shelter.
Inside the shelter’s command room.
The operators let out a long sigh of relief when they saw the group of Lickers outside retreating through the surveillance screen.
Their foreheads were covered in a layer of cold sweat.
It was too scary.
Tang Chu’s back was drenched in sweat when he escaped back to the shelter’s command room.
He felt like he had just escaped from the gates of hell!
“F*ck!”
Tang Chu cursed in his heart.
Fortunately, they had only walked a dozen meters. If they had gone any further, they would have died outside.
Yu Jie had the operator replay the Licker’s attack on the main screen.
“The Lickers are afraid of the shelter. They are retreating very quickly.”
A researcher wearing glasses raised his glasses and said, “Sir, we have compared the images. The defensive ability of these Lickers is stronger than that of normal Lickers.”
“The hit rate of the automatic cannons previously was over 56% , but our attacks had almost no effect. We did not kill any Lickers.”
The entire hall fell into silence.
After a short exchange, the player discovered a cruel truth.
The damage of the automatic cannons on the Licker was negligible.
If they tried to fight it head-on, they would most likely lose.
Tang Chu gritted his teeth. “If the Lickers don’t leave, are we trapped here and can’t get out?”
No one responded to Tang Chu.
Being trapped here was good, but if the Lickers went crazy and attacked the shelter..
The shelter that they had spent a lot of effort on could be destroyed!
In the silence, the chief researcher adjusted his glasses and said, “Leader, I have a suggestion.”
“Go ahead.”
“Fang Heng from the prison shelter is working with the Dark Knights. They have found a way to control the Licker and control it to fight.”
“I think they know more about the Licker than we do. Maybe they have a way to solve our predicament.”
“I suggest we ask Fang Heng for help.”
Hearing this, hope was rekindled in everyone’s hearts.
Yu Jie turned to look at Zhang Zhe.
“I heard that you seem to be very familiar with Fang Heng?”
Hearing Fang Heng’s name again, Zhang Zhe frowned.
“Not really. We participated in a mission together.”
“Able to talk?”
Zhang Zhe was very unwilling to look for Fang Heng, but if he did not handle Night Owl’s problem well, he would also be in trouble.
Taking a deep breath, Zhang Zhe said, “I’ll go and try.”
