“He can indeed control a small number of Lickers, but there are definitely not that many.”
“Moreover, the prison is very far away from us, and the energy consumption of the space tearing passage is very high.
It is impossible for the prison to transfer such a large number of Lickers.”
“Most importantly, the prison has no motive to attack our shelter.”
In the command room, everyone fell silent again.
Zhang Zhe asked, “Are our people still monitoring Night Owl?
Do they have any new special reports?”
“We keep in contact with the monitoring team every 15 minutes offline.
We just confirmed it three minutes ago.”
“So far, we have not found anyone leaving or entering the iron mine.
We believe that the Night Owl organization is still excavating inside the cave.”
“We’ve conducted an analysis of the iron mine in advance.
Based on the number of players entering the iron mine, it will take at least two days to dig through and enter the laboratory.”
Zhang Zhe looked at the time.
It had already been almost a day.
There was only one day left.
Theoretically speaking, it was almost impossible for Night Owl to be related to the group of Lickers outside.
However, the timing of their appearance was too coincidental.
Zhang Zhe felt apprehensive and insecure inside.
“Let’s organize a small team.
I want to go over there and see for myself.”
“Now?
This is too dangerous.
What if those Lickers attack us?”
Zhang Zhe’s eyes narrowed.
“Colonel Tang Chu, this is an order.
Night Owl is more dangerous than the group of Lickers outside.”
Tang Chu’s expression turned solemn.
“Yes, Sir!”
Yu Jie nodded and said, “I will stay here and provide backup.
I wish you good luck.”
Ten minutes later, Zhang Zhe and Tang Chu finished their preparations and left the right side of the shelter with a team of twelve Federation elites.
The team maintained a high level of vigilance and gradually moved away from the Lickers from the side of the shelter.
Every member slowed down their footsteps and held their breath, trying not to attract the attention of the Lickers.
Tang Chu’s heart was in his throat.
He prayed in his heart that he would not be discovered by the Lickers.
In the distance, behind a broken bunker, Lucia revealed herself.
A layer of blood-red light appeared in her pupils.
After the modification from the biological weapon project, Lucia’s super strong vision allowed her to immediately capture the movements of the party of players.
Following Fang Heng’s instructions, Lucia stretched out her hand and pointed at Zhang Zhe’s team.
“Go!”
“Chi Chi Chi...”
The Lickers waiting outside the shelter received the order and immediately rushed toward Zhang Zhe’s team.
“D*mn it!
They’re coming!”
“Retreat!
Retreat quickly! !”
The soft sounds of “chi” were like a life-threatening charm!
Tang Chu quivered, shouted and took the lead to turn around and run.
It was too terrifying!
Hundreds of Lickers gathered together and madly rushed toward them.
The extreme pressure made Tang Chu unable to breathe and he couldn’t even think of resisting.
The entire team only had one thought in their minds.
Run!
The entire team practically rolled and crawled back to the shelter.
“Da Da...
Da Da Da...”
Outside the shelter, the 10 automatic cannons that the Federation spent a large sum of money to buy opened fire at the same time!
Unfortunately, the output of the automatic cannons was still too weak!
Chi Chi Chi..
When the Lickers saw that the players had already retreated back into the shelter, they quickly retreated the same way.
They retreated again, maintaining a safe distance from the shelter.
Inside the shelter’s command room.
The operators let out a long sigh of relief when they saw the group of Lickers outside retreating through the surveillance screen.
Their foreheads were covered in a layer of cold sweat.
It was too scary.
Tang Chu’s back was drenched in sweat when he escaped back to the shelter’s command room.
He felt like he had just escaped from the gates of hell!
“F*ck!”
Tang Chu cursed in his heart.
Fortunately, they had only walked a dozen meters.
If they had gone any further, they would have died outside.
Yu Jie had the operator replay the Licker’s attack on the main screen.
“The Lickers are afraid of the shelter.
They are retreating very quickly.”
A researcher wearing glasses raised his glasses and said, “Sir, we have compared the images.
The defensive ability of these Lickers is stronger than that of normal Lickers.”
“The hit rate of the automatic cannons previously was over 56% , but our attacks had almost no effect.
We did not kill any Lickers.”
The entire hall fell into silence.
After a short exchange, the player discovered a cruel truth.
The damage of the automatic cannons on the Licker was negligible.
If they tried to fight it head-on, they would most likely lose.
Tang Chu gritted his teeth.
“If the Lickers don’t leave, are we trapped here and can’t get out?”
No one responded to Tang Chu.
Being trapped here was good, but if the Lickers went crazy and attacked the shelter..
The shelter that they had spent a lot of effort on could be destroyed!
In the silence, the chief researcher adjusted his glasses and said, “Leader, I have a suggestion.”
“Go ahead.”
“Fang Heng from the prison shelter is working with the Dark Knights.
They have found a way to control the Licker and control it to fight.”
“I think they know more about the Licker than we do.
Maybe they have a way to solve our predicament.”
“I suggest we ask Fang Heng for help.”
Hearing this, hope was rekindled in everyone’s hearts.
Yu Jie turned to look at Zhang Zhe.
“I heard that you seem to be very familiar with Fang Heng?”
Hearing Fang Heng’s name again, Zhang Zhe frowned.
“Not really.
We participated in a mission together.”
“Able to talk?”
Zhang Zhe was very unwilling to look for Fang Heng, but if he did not handle Night Owl’s problem well, he would also be in trouble.
Taking a deep breath, Zhang Zhe said, “I’ll go and try.”

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - Cheating for Trucks
paragraphs: [Hint: Your zombie clone is collecting blue crystal ores. Obtained inferior blue crystal raw ore*2.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone is collecting blue crystal ores. Obtained normal blue crystal raw ore*1...]
The difficulty of collecting blue crystal ores was very high, and the mining efficiency was extremely slow.
Fortunately, before the zombie team arrived, they had all changed into premium shovels and they also had unlimited stamina.
Fang Heng glanced at the game hints and continued to sort the ores with Mo Jiawei.
After all, the zombies only knew how to mine and transport ores. They couldn’t distinguish the grades and types of ores.
They had to sort the ores themselves.
“Fang Heng, I didn’t expect the mine to be so small. It’s almost finished.”
“Yeah, it’s indeed a little small...”
Fang Heng hummed in agreement. He felt that he hadn’t finished yet.
There were very few premium blue crystals in the abandoned iron mine. Before entering the iron mine, the Meteorite Company had already mined more than half of the iron mine.
In just a few hours, half of the iron mine had been dug out by hundreds of zombie clones.
They had only dug out two boxes of premium iron ores!
Fang Heng estimated that in three to four hours, the premium ores in the core area would be finished.
If they continued, they would be able to dig out many low-level ores in the nearby area.
However, the ore yield was low and the ores they dug out were all low-level ores. It took a lot of time and effort, and it was far less satisfying than digging out the high-quality core area.
Mo Jiawei looked at the “small hills” made of twenty boxes full of ores and a dozen low-level ores.
“Wait, we have to think of a way to send the ores back to the shelter.”
This was also a problem!
Fang Heng wondered if he should go back to the shelter first and think of a way to get a few trucks to transport the ores.
This would waste a lot of time and it would probably be delayed until tomorrow morning.
“That’s right. I’ll go back and get some trucks. If there’s anything urgent, contact me offline.”
Just as Fang Heng was about to leave, a game hint flashed across his vision.

[Hint: Receive a call from a special function outside the game cabin. Call message: Fang Heng, Mr Chen Yu from the Federation has contacted you. He said that there’s something very important that has something to do with the matter at hand.]
Chen Yu?
Fang Heng was puzzled for a moment. He turned his head and said, “There’s an emergency contact outside. I’ll go offline first, you help to take care of the rest.”
“No problem.”
Fang Heng threw down a simple bed on the spot and quickly went offline.
“Oh? So, Chen Yu, are you asking me for help?”
After listening to Chen Yu’s entire story, Fang Heng’s expression was a little strange.
He forced himself to hold back his laughter.
D*mn it, the huge Federation came to him for help?
Why were they getting worse and worse?
On the other end of the phone, Chen Yu also felt like his balls were hurting.
He had just received a call from Zhang Zhe, and Chen Yu directly put the phone aside, thinking of pretending that the signal was bad and ignoring him.
But when he heard that it was related to Night Owl, Chen Yu couldn’t sit still anymore.
This was a serious matter, and the appearance of Night Owl was very likely to affect the safety of the people.
After listening carefully to Zhang Zhe’s story, Chen Yu immediately realized that this matter was most likely related to Fang Heng.
Not long ago, Fang Heng had just asked him about the desert region and Night Owl’s matter, and then something happened to the desert region...
How could there be such a coincidence!!
Of course, he had also heard of the familiar Licker.
Chen Yu had already guessed a thing or two in his heart.
If it’s said that this matter had nothing to do with Fang Heng, then he definitely wouldn’t believe it.
“Ahem, Fang Heng, I didn’t mention anything to Zhang Zhe about you contacting me before.”
“Thanks, but I’m quite curious. Isn’t your Federation’s database a little too incomplete? Isn’t there any other way to control the Licker in other servers?”
“I’ve investigated. No one in the entire server can control the Licker. I’ve only heard that there are very few ways to control Lickers within the Dark Knights.”
Chen Yu sighed in his heart and thought about how to convince Fang Heng to help.
“Fang Heng, I also hate that Zhang Zhe guy, but this matter is related to Night Owl. Look...”
“I understand. We’re so familiar with each other. I’ll give you face.”
Fang Heng thought and agreed with a smile.
Originally, he did not plan to make a move against the Federation shelter.
The group of Lickers outside was just to scare them.
“But, you can’t make me work for free, right? No matter what, I have to spend money to travel all the way there.”
Chen Yu immediately understood and agreed, “You’re right, I understand. This money is on Zhang Zhe’s head, let’s rip him off!”
“Deal. Help me negotiate. The bottom line is five military trucks. We need them in stock! The desert shelter should have some money, right?”
“No problem! Charge it to Zhang Zhe’s special team. If they don’t agree, I won’t interfere in this.”
“Okay. In three hours, I’ll send Lucia from the Dark Knights to the Federation shelter to pick up the goods. Once the goods are in hand, I’ll help you solve the problem.”
After the two of them finished discussing a series of details, Fang Heng once again returned to the game world.
Alright, now that the blue crystal raw ore was available, the Federation also helped to provide the delivery trucks.
The transportation problem was also solved!
He would just sit and wait to make a fortune!
After waiting bitterly for three and a half hours.
The nervous people of the Federation’s shelter finally looked forward to the Dark Knights team led by Lucia.
In the command room, the player observed the outside world through the video screen.
Yu Jie felt that he had made the right bet!
The Dark Knights’ vehicles passed by the Lickers.
The Lickers seemed to be very afraid of the Dark Knights. They stepped back and gradually left the shelter.
After a simple negotiation, Lucia left with a few elite Dark Knights in seven military trucks.
They slowly disappeared into the night.
Then, the group of Lickers disappeared into the darkness.
“It’s that simple?”
Looking at the Lickers that were gradually disappearing into the distance, Tang Chu was a little confused.
What the hell!
Those Lickers that had been circling the shelter for the whole day just disappeared with a blink of an eye?
When did the Dark Knights have such strong control over the Lickers? They had never heard of the Dark Knights being so strong in the other servers!
Yu Jie turned on his communicator. “All teams, report the situation.”
The radio in the command room transmitted the replies of the various reconnaissance teams.
“Command room, confirm that the Lickers have dispersed. Area 1 is safe.”
“Area 2 is safe.”
“Area 3 is safe.”
“Area 4 is safe. Confirm that the Lickers have evacuated...”
Listening to the report, the tense nerves of the player in the command room finally relaxed.
“The crisis has been temporarily lifted. Everyone, please work hard. Double the number of people on duty tonight and double the number of patrol personnel.”
“Yes!”
Federation players left one after another and began to make arrangements for tonight’s duty.
Yu Jie rubbed his swollen temples.
No matter what, the Lickers were gone and they could finally sleep peacefully tonight.
However, Zhang Zhe still stood motionlessly in front of the monitor, staring at the screen without saying a word.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - Crystallized Life Form
paragraphs: Tang Chu found it strange and asked in a low voice.
“Sir, aren’t you going to rest? Or did you find something?”
Zhang Zhe pointed at the replay on the screen and asked, “Did the Dark Knights leave in a different direction from when they came?”
Hearing that, Tang Chu also looked up at the replay.
“I think so.”
Zhang Zhe said, “They left in a direction that leads to the iron mine.”
D*mn that good night’s sleep!
Tang Chu felt that Zhang Zhe was too nervous. Everything could be connected to the Night Owl organization in the iron mine.
“Sir, I think this is just a coincidence. After all, trucks cannot pass through the space tear. It is normal for the Dark Knights to choose another way to return to the prison shelter.”
Zhang Zhe didn’t say anything.
After a moment of silence, he continued, “I need to immediately form an emergency investigation team to conduct an emergency investigation in the iron mine area.”
Tang Chu shivered and saluted, “Yes, sir!”
Outside the desert.
Fang Heng commanded the zombie team to move the ores back and forth, loading them into the truck in batches.
The core area of the iron mine had been mined half an hour ago.
Fang Heng didn’t want to waste the remaining low-level ores, so he continued to let the zombie team excavate them.
Seeing so many ores, Lucia’s eyes lit up and she praised, “Fang Heng, you’re amazing. They’re all the highest-level blue crystal ores. Did you excavate them all by yourself? You’re amazing.”
“Not really. Mo Jiawei contributed to the exploration. It was he who found the exact location of the mine.”
Lucia’s mood instantly became a little worse. She looked at Mo Jiawei with a sharp gaze.
“Cough, cough, cough... No, it’s not that. It has nothing to do with me.”
Mo Jiawei, who was drinking water at the side, suddenly felt a chill on his back. He choked on the water and started coughing violently.
“Lucia, I’ll need you to make a few trips later to send the ores back to the Dark Knights’ contact point. These ores are very precious, and I’m worried.”
Lucia felt sweet in her heart.
She felt that this was Fang Heng’s trust in her.
“Okay, I’ll protect these materials.”
“Take a few teams of Lickers to go with you. Be careful along the way. It’s best to take a detour around the shelter. Don’t let the Federation discover you.”
“I promise to complete the mission!”
Lucia’s expression immediately became serious and her eyes were filled with killing intent.
If the Federation discovered them on the way, then kill them all!
[Hint: Your zombie team has completed the excavation of the planned passage area.]
Eh! The passage to the laboratory has been dug!
Seeing the game hint, Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
“The secret research room’s passage has been dug through. Let’s go and take a look first.”
Raising his head and downing a bottle of coffee, Fang Heng brought Lucia along with Mo Jiawei into the other excavated passage to explore.
After walking along the newly excavated passage for nearly 20 minutes, an open area finally appeared in front of them.
Fang Heng was the first to step into it.
This was an abandoned laboratory that had been remodelled!
Most of the laboratory had been remodelled. The building and the cave had merged into one, and all kinds of experimental equipment could be seen scattered inside.
After confirming that it was safe, the three of them walked into the laboratory and searched for clues on their own.
The original entrance to the laboratory had been sealed.
Fang Heng smelled the residual smell of gunpowder in the air.
It seemed like the entrance to the passage had been blown up just like the mine.
Fang Heng pondered and walked to the side of the main control machine, casually pressing it.
[Hint: Player has been detected to have relevant mechanical repair skills.]
[Hint: The current machine is too old to complete repair.]
[Hint: The current machine lacks power and cannot be operated.]
The machine could not be operated because of age and lack of power.
“Eh?”
Fang Heng noticed a white human skeleton on the seat beside him.
The skeleton’s coat had the symbol of the Meteorite Company on it.
Fang Heng walked forward and took out a tattered notebook from the pocket of the skeleton’s coat.
[Hint: You have obtained an item-researcher’s notebook.]
Fang Heng tried to open the notebook.
As it had been too long, the notebook had rotted, and many of its contents could not be seen.
“Crystallized forms.”
“They were an extremely special kind of life form.”
“We had done a big data comparison, but we could not find any known life form on Earth that had a similar structure to crystallized forms.”
“Most of the time, crystallized forms were in a dormant state, maintaining extremely low vital signs.”
“They seem to be able to live for eternal life.”
“Dr Diehl was the first scientist to discover the existence of crystallized bodies and he was the most authoritative researcher on them.”
“He believed that humans could find a way to live for eternal life from crystallized forms.”
“Similarly, he believed that crystallized forms were closely related to a substance called blue crystal ore.”
“I was very happy to join Dr Diehl’s research team.”
“Under his leadership, we spent three years in the desert to find the blue crystal mine.”
“Meteorite Company decided to build a laboratory here for research.”
“I finally got what I wanted!”
“Dr Diehl was right!”
“We found that this kind of life form lived and purified by absorbing the strength of the blue crystal.”
“In the beginning, when the blue crystal was lacking, they would be very docile, not aggressive, and most of the time dormant.”
“They could feel the presence of blue crystals nearby.”
“Dr Diehl decided to conduct an experiment and try to use blue crystals to feed the crystallized form.”
“As the number of blue crystals swallowed increased, the crystallized form gradually became out of control.”
“Dr Diehl’s physical condition had been bad for the past two days.”
“Everyone was talking about him. Rumour had it that he had fallen ill because he was too tired from the hard work of the experiment.”
“But I knew that wasn’t the case.”
“Dr Diehl was experimenting on crystallized forms himself.”
“The experiment was in trouble.”
“Dr Diehl began to fall into a coma.”
“We continued with the experimental protocol he left behind.”
“Hopefully, we can find a way to bring Dr Diehl back.”
“Something’s wrong.”
“The crystallized form that was sent to Meteorite Company went berserk.”
“I heard the crystallized form destroyed the entire main company building.”
“We received an internal order from the Meteorite Company to stop all research on the crystallized forms, destroy all crystallized forms and all traces of research on the crystallized forms.”
“They even had to destroy Mr Diehl’s corpse on the spot!”
“I sensed that the Meteorite Company was afraid.”
“They were anxious to clean up everything!”
“I understand the dangers of crystallized forms.”
“But... we’ve reached this point in our research!”
“Destroy them all?”
“I’m not resigned to fate!”
“I’ll never agree to them doing this!”
“Mr Diehl isn’t dead! He’s just dormant!”
“I’ll never allow them to stop Mr Diehl’s experiment.”
“I believe that one day, the experimental subject will restart.”
“Tsk, another madman...”
Fang Heng closed the notebook and muttered to himself in a low voice.
He called Lucia and Mo Jiawei, “Hey, have you heard of this crystallized thing?”
The two of them turned around and gave Fang Heng a blank look.

Lucia’s expression immediately became serious and her eyes were filled with killing intent.
If the Federation discovered them on the way, then kill them all!
[Hint: Your zombie team has completed the excavation of the planned passage area.]
Eh!
The passage to the laboratory has been dug!
Seeing the game hint, Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
“The secret research room’s passage has been dug through.
Let’s go and take a look first.”
Raising his head and downing a bottle of coffee, Fang Heng brought Lucia along with Mo Jiawei into the other excavated passage to explore.
After walking along the newly excavated passage for nearly 20 minutes, an open area finally appeared in front of them.
Fang Heng was the first to step into it.
This was an abandoned laboratory that had been remodelled!
Most of the laboratory had been remodelled.
The building and the cave had merged into one, and all kinds of experimental equipment could be seen scattered inside.
After confirming that it was safe, the three of them walked into the laboratory and searched for clues on their own.
The original entrance to the laboratory had been sealed.
Fang Heng smelled the residual smell of gunpowder in the air.
It seemed like the entrance to the passage had been blown up just like the mine.
Fang Heng pondered and walked to the side of the main control machine, casually pressing it.
[Hint: Player has been detected to have relevant mechanical repair skills.]
[Hint: The current machine is too old to complete repair.]
[Hint: The current machine lacks power and cannot be operated.]
The machine could not be operated because of age and lack of power.
“Eh?”
Fang Heng noticed a white human skeleton on the seat beside him.
The skeleton’s coat had the symbol of the Meteorite Company on it.
Fang Heng walked forward and took out a tattered notebook from the pocket of the skeleton’s coat.
[Hint: You have obtained an item-researcher’s notebook.]
Fang Heng tried to open the notebook.
As it had been too long, the notebook had rotted, and many of its contents could not be seen.
“Crystallized forms.”
“They were an extremely special kind of life form.”
“We had done a big data comparison, but we could not find any known life form on Earth that had a similar structure to crystallized forms.”
“Most of the time, crystallized forms were in a dormant state, maintaining extremely low vital signs.”
“They seem to be able to live for eternal life.”
“Dr Diehl was the first scientist to discover the existence of crystallized bodies and he was the most authoritative researcher on them.”
“He believed that humans could find a way to live for eternal life from crystallized forms.”
“Similarly, he believed that crystallized forms were closely related to a substance called blue crystal ore.”
“I was very happy to join Dr Diehl’s research team.”
“Under his leadership, we spent three years in the desert to find the blue crystal mine.”
“Meteorite Company decided to build a laboratory here for research.”
“I finally got what I wanted!”
“Dr Diehl was right!”
“We found that this kind of life form lived and purified by absorbing the strength of the blue crystal.”
“In the beginning, when the blue crystal was lacking, they would be very docile, not aggressive, and most of the time dormant.”
“They could feel the presence of blue crystals nearby.”
“Dr Diehl decided to conduct an experiment and try to use blue crystals to feed the crystallized form.”
“As the number of blue crystals swallowed increased, the crystallized form gradually became out of control.”
“Dr Diehl’s physical condition had been bad for the past two days.”
“Everyone was talking about him.
Rumour had it that he had fallen ill because he was too tired from the hard work of the experiment.”
“But I knew that wasn’t the case.”
“Dr Diehl was experimenting on crystallized forms himself.”
“The experiment was in trouble.”
“Dr Diehl began to fall into a coma.”
“We continued with the experimental protocol he left behind.”
“Hopefully, we can find a way to bring Dr Diehl back.”
“Something’s wrong.”
“The crystallized form that was sent to Meteorite Company went berserk.”
“I heard the crystallized form destroyed the entire main company building.”
“We received an internal order from the Meteorite Company to stop all research on the crystallized forms, destroy all crystallized forms and all traces of research on the crystallized forms.”
“They even had to destroy Mr Diehl’s corpse on the spot!”
“I sensed that the Meteorite Company was afraid.”
“They were anxious to clean up everything!”
“I understand the dangers of crystallized forms.”
“But... we’ve reached this point in our research!”
“Destroy them all?”
“I’m not resigned to fate!”
“I’ll never agree to them doing this!”
“Mr Diehl isn’t dead!
He’s just dormant!”
“I’ll never allow them to stop Mr Diehl’s experiment.”
“I believe that one day, the experimental subject will restart.”
“Tsk, another madman...”
Fang Heng closed the notebook and muttered to himself in a low voice.
He called Lucia and Mo Jiawei, “Hey, have you heard of this crystallized thing?”
The two of them turned around and gave Fang Heng a blank look.

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - The Locked Crystal Coffin
paragraphs: “Forget it.”
Fang Heng shrugged and put the researcher’s notebook back into his backpack.
“It seems that this is a research laboratory for crystallized forms, but this thing doesn’t seem to have anything to do with zombies?”
Mo Jiawei agreed, “Yes, and there doesn’t seem to be any strange mutated zombies here.”
While speaking, Mo Jiawei suddenly made a discovery.
“Fang Heng, Lucia, come and take a look at this!”
Fang Heng and Lucia walked over.
Crystal coffin?
In a corner of the laboratory, there were five crystal coffins neatly arranged.
The crystal coffins were covered with dust.
Fang Heng tried to wipe off the dust on the coffin lid.
“What is this?”
There were more than ten white worms inside the coffin.
They looked like the larvae of some creature, about the length of a finger.
They lay quietly inside the coffin as if they had been dead for a long time.
“Eh? Look, it’s moving!”
Under the watchful eyes of Fang Heng and the others, the worms slowly woke up.
At the same time, they slowly moved toward Fang Heng.
Fang Heng subconsciously dodged backwards.
Lucia and Mo Jiawei both turned back to look at Fang Heng curiously.
“Fang Heng, what is on your body that attracts them?”
Fang Heng thought for a moment and immediately thought of the blue crystal ore and crystallized form recorded in the notebook just now.
“Let me try.”
Fang Heng took out a blue crystal raw ore from his backpack and placed it on the white glass cover of the coffin.
“Chi Chi Chi!”
As soon as the ore was placed on the lid, the worms immediately had a bigger reaction.
They frantically swarmed towards the blue crystal raw ore that Fang Heng placed on the lid, trying to break free from the crystal coffin’s restraints.
Fang Heng was even more confused.
“They are crystallized forms?”
“Let me take a look.”
Mo Jiawei felt that it was time to prove his worth.
He covered his left eye with his hand and looked at the young worms in the coffin.
Rows of information appeared on his retina.
“Crystallized body, currently at larva stage.”
“Special mutated creature (Tier 0 mutated body, can evolve)”
“Unknown creature, a living creature with a DNA structure similar to the primogenitor virus.”
“Living creatures can evolve by devouring the blue crystal raw ore and other blue crystal ore products.”
“After entering the growth stage, they can devour all lifeforms to absorb nutrients for self-evolution.”
“In theory, crystallized forms have unlimited possibilities of evolution.”
“Unknown creature. Player needs to increase his level and obtain more information.”
Mo Jiawei put down the palm covering his left eye, his expression somewhat incredulous.
What a joke!
His talent skill was S-level!
In the past, he could easily obtain all kinds of data and information even for a Tier 5 creature.
But now, he had a pitiful amount of information about crystallized forms.
“That’s all?”
“Yes, that’s all.”
Fang Heng stroked his chin and sized up the worm in the coffin.
This worm didn’t look very strong no matter how he looked at it.
It could evolve infinitely?
Could it be that Night Owl’s target this time was this thing?
“Fang Heng, why don’t we bring it back? Qiu Yaokang should be able to analyze something, right?”
As Mo Jiawei spoke, he tried to knock on the coffin lid.
The lid was very hard, making a ‘bang bang bang’ sound.
“It’s quite strong.”
This knock seemed to have triggered some mechanism, and the entire coffin suddenly lit up, emitting blue light.
Mo Jiawei hurriedly raised his hands, indicating that he had nothing to do with it.
A line of small words appeared on the coffin’s surface.
[Hint: Please enter the password.]
Fang Heng took a look and explained, “It’s an electronic lock. The shaking caused the automatic trigger.”
Mo Jiawei heaved a sigh of relief. “I told you, it has nothing to do with me.”
“Let’s look at the other few coffins.”
The five coffins were arranged side by side, separated by three to four meters
Fang Heng walked forward again and checked the remaining four crystal coffins.
Three of them were intact, and the inside was also filled with white worms.
Only the last crystal coffin was damaged and the outer layer of the glass crystal lid was broken.
“Eh? The worms inside were taken away?” Mo Jiawei felt strange and looked at Fang Heng. “Is there someone who came here faster than us?”
“It doesn’t look like it.”
Lucia squatted down and examined the broken lid.
“Fang Heng, judging from the cracks, the lid seems to have been broken from the inside.”
Mo Jiawei was shocked.
“What the hell? The worm broke the lid and escaped from the inside?”
Fang Heng also felt confused and confused.
The worm in its infancy didn’t have any attack power, so theoretically, it couldn’t break the lid.
“Whatever, I’m already here. Take the entire coffin back to the shelter. I’ll let Qiu Yaokang analyze it then.”
As he spoke, Fang Heng casually walked to the side of the crystal coffin that was still intact. He reached out and touched the bottom of the coffin, trying to lift the entire coffin.
“Huh?”
Fang Heng was surprised.
Only then did he realize that the entire bottom of the coffin was embedded in the bottom.
“Beep Beep Beep...”
A faint alarm sounded from the coffin.
[Hint: Please enter the password. Forced movement, destruction and power customization will cause the self-destruct program to activate.]
[Hint: This item is a special item. It cannot be stored in a backpack.]
Password? There’s a self-destruct program?
Fang Heng frowned and silently withdrew his hand.
The dead crystallized form most likely had no research value.
Mo Jiawei glanced at the other side of the laboratory that was sealed off by the Meteorite Company and asked, “Fang Heng, do you think Night Owl’s people have a password?”
“They...”
Fang Heng nodded and said, “That makes sense. I’ll go and ask.”
He turned on the survival radio and sent an urgent message to Deng Xin.
Fang Heng: “How’s your situation now?” How long do you need to excavate before reaching the central laboratory?”

Deng Xin: “We’re still excavating round-the-clock. If everything goes smoothly, we’ll be able to excavate it by tomorrow afternoon. In addition, I received news from Liu Keyi that the Federation has encountered some trouble.”.
Fang Heng: “There’s no need to pay attention to the Federation for the time being. Have you heard Liu Keyi talk about crystallized forms, coffins or passwords?”

Deng Xin: “I think so. She must have some special password. I haven’t heard anything else. She’s very vigilant and she doesn’t seem to be worried that the Federation will find out about this operation.”
Fang Heng looked at Deng Xin’s response and turned off the survival radio.
“There’s still nearly a day left...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself. He looked down at the coffin under his feet and suddenly had a good idea.
Almost in the blink of an eye, he had another bad idea.
If he succeeded, he could probably trick the coffin back.
“Fang Heng, what do we say?”

“It’s okay. Let’s go back and clean up the ores outside. Don’t let the Federation and Night Owl’s people find out. I’ll leave this place to you for now. I have to go back and bring some people to help.”
Fang Heng turned to look at Lucia. “Lucia, the situation has changed. I’ll go back to the shelter with you.”
Lucia said happily, “Good!”

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - Unlocked
paragraphs: The next afternoon.
In the depths of the cave that had been excavated.
“Bang!”
With a loud bang, the large rocks blocking the entrance to the laboratory were finally cleared.
Liu Keyi was the first to enter the laboratory hall and looked around.
“We’re here. Be careful. The target is a crystallized form.”
The other player entered the laboratory to search.
“Found it! It’s here!”
Deng Xin found something. She shouted and called Liu Keyi over to investigate.
Seeing the crystal coffin in the corner of the laboratory, a smile appeared on Liu Keyi’s face.
“This is the one?”
“That’s right. This is the crystallized form we’re looking for.”
Liu Keyi looked at the crystal coffins nearby and frowned.
There were five crystal coffins placed side by side in the corner of the laboratory. The other four had been destroyed, leaving only the last one in front of Deng Xin intact.
There were much fewer crystallized forms than she had expected.
Liu Keyi reached out and pressed on the crystal coffin.
[Hint: You have found an item-experiment crystal coffin.]
“Beep Beep Beep...”
The crystal coffin emitted a response and lit up with a blue light. A few lines of small words appeared on the built-in screen.
[Hint: Please enter the password to unlock.]
[Hint: Forced movement, destruction and power customization will cause the self-destruct program to start.]
[Hint: Three consecutive password input errors will cause the password program to start. The remaining number of times: three.]
Liu Keyi quickly pressed the button and entered the password.
“Click...”
[Hint: Password verified.]
After a slight sound, the tightly locked coffin was unlocked.
“Enough.”
Liu Keyi said in a low voice. She opened the lid of the crystal coffin, took out a blue crystal from her backpack and quickly threw it into it.
“Chi Chi Chi...”
The crystallized worms inside the crystal coffin woke up almost instantly and pounced toward the crystal.
They surrounded the crystal and greedily absorbed the energy that escaped from the crystal.
The worm’s body slowly expanded at a speed visible to the naked eye, and a faint red glow appeared under its skin.
Liu Keyi took out two tubes of T-virus from her backpack and stuffed them into the coffin.
Deng Xin tried to get more information from Liu Keyi.
She asked in a low voice, “Liu, what is this? Are we here to find this?”
“Yes, it’s the crystallized form that we’re looking for. The T-virus can stimulate them, allowing them to enter a rapid growth period in a short period.”
“However, it is prone to instability and will explode easily if you are not careful.”
Liu Keyi closed the lid of the crystal coffin as she spoke, turning around and sweeping her gaze across the crowd.
“Stick to the original plan and load the explosives. We’re going to send a big gift to the Federation.”
Just as they had agreed beforehand, everyone put on a uniform white mask.
The hired players surrounded them and tried to lift the coffin together.
“Let’s go!”
After loading the crystal coffin with explosives, Liu Keyi led the player team out of the cave.
Taking advantage of the fact that no one was paying attention, Deng Xin and her two teammates deliberately lagged behind them for a short distance and hid in the darkness of the laboratory.
After confirming that Liu Keyi’s team had all left, Deng Xin looked around the laboratory hall again.
She frowned and asked in a low voice, “Fang Heng? Are you there?”
“Da.”
Lucia fell from the high ground and stood in front of Deng Xin.
“Pada.”.
There was another soft sound.
Fang Heng also jumped down from the high ground.
Deng Xin saw Fang Heng and Lucia who fell from the sky, and for a moment, she was still in a daze.
“Thank you for your hard work. You did a good job. The bonus will be tripled at the end of the month.”
“Of course. Thank you, Boss!”
When Deng Xin’s two teammates heard about the bonus, they immediately reacted and thanked him together.
Just now, Fang Heng and the Lickers were hiding in the shadows at the top of the cave.
Fang Heng and the others saw everything that happened in the room.
Fang Heng quickly walked to the crystal coffin in the corner.
One of the five crystal coffins was taken away by Deng Xin.
“Looks like it’s quite easy.”
Fang Heng said as he reached out his hand to touch the broken crystal coffin.
“Oh my god! Fang Heng, be careful! I spent a few hours making this! They are all works of art!”
Fang Heng raised his head and looked at Sandy who was climbing down the rope ladder.
“I know.”
As he spoke, Fang Heng tore open a layer of drawing paper that was stuck to the surface of the crystal coffin.
“Chi!!”
In the dimly lit cave, along with Deng Xin’s intentional guidance from the side, Liu Keyi mistakenly thought that the remaining four crystal coffins had all been destroyed.
Those were only replicas made by Sandy using drawing paper.
“Did you get the password?”
“Wait a moment, I recorded it just now.”
As Deng Xin spoke, she retrieved the video footage from before and reported the password.
“Ouroboros.”
“What did you say?”
Fang Heng’s heart pounded fiercely, and he turned around to look at Deng Xin in surprise.
“Hmm?”
Deng Xin did not expect Fang Heng’s reaction to be so big, so she checked the video again.
“That’s right, the password is Ouroboros.”
Fang Heng frowned.
Why did Ouroboros appear here as the password?
What did it mean?
Sandy and Mo Jiawei also climbed down the rope ladder.
“Fang Heng, this is my best work in recent months. The shattered crystal mirror and the lifelike worms. God, I admire myself!”
“Indeed, it’s very good.”
Fang Heng came back to his senses and gave a perfunctory reply.
“Of course, this is art!!” Sandy proudly extended his five fingers. “There are not more than five people in the world who can tell that this is an imitation!”
Fang Heng temporarily suppressed the doubts about Ouroboros in his heart and quickly entered the password on the built-in screen.
“Click...”
The mechanical claw holding the crystal coffin loosened.
[Password confirmed, unlocked successfully...]
Fang Heng looked up. “Lucia, you take the crystal coffin and leave first. Take them back to the shelter for now. Be careful and try not to be noticed by others.”
“Okay!”
Lucia nodded heavily and asked, “What about you?”
“There are still some things that I don’t understand. I’ll go and check on the Federation. Maybe I can get some information from them.”
“Yes, be careful.”
Outside, Zhang Zhe led seven elite teams of the Federation to hide around the rock cave in the Gobi District area.

“Sir, what exactly does the Night Owl organization want to do by entering the laboratory? They shouldn’t have the ability to collect blue crystal ores. Is it for the crystallized form? What exactly is that thing?”
Tang Chu had always been curious.
He had heard of crystallized forms, but he had never been clear about what it was.
Zhang Zhe glanced at him.
“Captain Tang, you only need to carry out the order. Once Night Owl’s men leave the iron mine and enter the encirclement, immediately carry out the hunting plan.”
“I don’t wish to let any player off.”
“Yes!”
Zhang Zhe’s gaze was fixated on the cave passage not too far away.
Crystallized form!
That was an extremely special lifeform.
They absorbed the energy from the blue crystal ore to achieve their goal of evolving themselves.
The last time Zhang Zhe fought with a crystallized form, he was still in awe.
At that time, it was already the end of the game.
The Federation had joined forces with the Dark Knights and paid a huge price to destroy the crystallized form that had already entered the late stage of growth-a Tier 6 mutated creature.
That type of life form that could continuously enhance itself was extremely strange.
Perhaps Tier 6 was far from its final form.

After confirming that Liu Keyi’s team had all left, Deng Xin looked around the laboratory hall again.
She frowned and asked in a low voice, “Fang Heng?
Are you there?”
“Da.”
Lucia fell from the high ground and stood in front of Deng Xin.
“Pada.”.
There was another soft sound.
Fang Heng also jumped down from the high ground.
Deng Xin saw Fang Heng and Lucia who fell from the sky, and for a moment, she was still in a daze.
“Thank you for your hard work.
You did a good job.
The bonus will be tripled at the end of the month.”
“Of course.
Thank you, Boss!”
When Deng Xin’s two teammates heard about the bonus, they immediately reacted and thanked him together.
Just now, Fang Heng and the Lickers were hiding in the shadows at the top of the cave.
Fang Heng and the others saw everything that happened in the room.
Fang Heng quickly walked to the crystal coffin in the corner.
One of the five crystal coffins was taken away by Deng Xin.
“Looks like it’s quite easy.”
Fang Heng said as he reached out his hand to touch the broken crystal coffin.
“Oh my god!
Fang Heng, be careful!
I spent a few hours making this!
They are all works of art!”
Fang Heng raised his head and looked at Sandy who was climbing down the rope ladder.
“I know.”
As he spoke, Fang Heng tore open a layer of drawing paper that was stuck to the surface of the crystal coffin.
“Chi!!”
In the dimly lit cave, along with Deng Xin’s intentional guidance from the side, Liu Keyi mistakenly thought that the remaining four crystal coffins had all been destroyed.
Those were only replicas made by Sandy using drawing paper.
“Did you get the password?”
“Wait a moment, I recorded it just now.”
As Deng Xin spoke, she retrieved the video footage from before and reported the password.
“Ouroboros.”
“What did you say?”
Fang Heng’s heart pounded fiercely, and he turned around to look at Deng Xin in surprise.
“Hmm?”
Deng Xin did not expect Fang Heng’s reaction to be so big, so she checked the video again.
“That’s right, the password is Ouroboros.”
Fang Heng frowned.
Why did Ouroboros appear here as the password?
What did it mean?
Sandy and Mo Jiawei also climbed down the rope ladder.
“Fang Heng, this is my best work in recent months.
The shattered crystal mirror and the lifelike worms.
God, I admire myself!”
“Indeed, it’s very good.”
Fang Heng came back to his senses and gave a perfunctory reply.
“Of course, this is art!!” Sandy proudly extended his five fingers.
“There are not more than five people in the world who can tell that this is an imitation!”
Fang Heng temporarily suppressed the doubts about Ouroboros in his heart and quickly entered the password on the built-in screen.
“Click...”
The mechanical claw holding the crystal coffin loosened.
[Password confirmed, unlocked successfully...]
Fang Heng looked up.
“Lucia, you take the crystal coffin and leave first.
Take them back to the shelter for now.
Be careful and try not to be noticed by others.”
“Okay!”
Lucia nodded heavily and asked, “What about you?”
“There are still some things that I don’t understand.
I’ll go and check on the Federation.
Maybe I can get some information from them.”
“Yes, be careful.”
Outside, Zhang Zhe led seven elite teams of the Federation to hide around the rock cave in the Gobi District area.
“Sir, what exactly does the Night Owl organization want to do by entering the laboratory?
They shouldn’t have the ability to collect blue crystal ores.
Is it for the crystallized form?
What exactly is that thing?”
Tang Chu had always been curious.
He had heard of crystallized forms, but he had never been clear about what it was.
Zhang Zhe glanced at him.
“Captain Tang, you only need to carry out the order.
Once Night Owl’s men leave the iron mine and enter the encirclement, immediately carry out the hunting plan.”
“I don’t wish to let any player off.”
“Yes!”
Zhang Zhe’s gaze was fixated on the cave passage not too far away.
Crystallized form!
That was an extremely special lifeform.
They absorbed the energy from the blue crystal ore to achieve their goal of evolving themselves.
The last time Zhang Zhe fought with a crystallized form, he was still in awe.
At that time, it was already the end of the game.
The Federation had joined forces with the Dark Knights and paid a huge price to destroy the crystallized form that had already entered the late stage of growth-a Tier 6 mutated creature.
That type of life form that could continuously enhance itself was extremely strange.
Perhaps Tier 6 was far from its final form.

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - Explosion
paragraphs: After the Federation discovered the blue crystal mine and the
Meteorite Company’s former secret base, they had a discussion.
As they had not triggered the pre-mission, they were unable to crack the laboratory’s internal password to obtain the crystallized form.

Therefore, the Federation decided to temporarily put the mission on hold and send people to guard it 24 hours a day. When the time was right, they would think of a way to obtain the crystallized form and mine the blue crystal ore.
Unexpectedly, Night Owl obtained the laboratory’s password in advance and took the lead in taking action against the blue crystal mine.
After discovering Night Owl’s movements, Zhang Zhe immediately received the authorization and rushed to the desert to take charge of the operation to deal with Night Owl.
His initial thought was to directly eliminate Night Owl and obtain the crystallized form from them through interrogation.
Unfortunately, he was one step too late.
Through the player’s special talent skill, the Federation had discovered that Night Owl had already planted a large number of explosives inside the iron mine.
Once they sent people into the iron mine, Night Owl only needed to detonate the explosives, and it would be mutual destruction.
Not only would the federal team suffer heavy casualties, but the crystallized form that was inside the iron mine would also be affected.
The crystallized form was very valuable for research. It would be a pity to destroy it.

The most serious consequence was that if the explosion did not kill the crystallized form, the crystallized form would be freed by accident and absorbed the energy of the blue crystal ore without limit...
After consulting his superiors, Zhang Zhe decided to let Night Owl’s men take away the crystallized form in the laboratory directly.
Then, he would wait for Night Owl to come out of the cave before capturing all of them in one fell swoop! Annihilate them in one shot!
“Captain, they’re out!”
Zhang Zhe gripped his guns tightly.
It had been a long time since he had been this nervous.
He looked up and saw a group of masked players walking out of the cave.
At the end of the team, a few players were carrying a heavy crystal coffin.
“Sir, should we do it?”
“No, wait a little longer. Wait for them to enter the encirclement.”
Zhang Zhe said in a low voice as he stared fixedly at this group of players.
Only when he saw his party retreat from the entrance of the cave and enter the encirclement did Zhang Zhe suddenly wave his hand and shout.
“Quick! Move out!”

The elite party of the Federation that was lying in ambush in the surroundings took out their guns and crossbow arrows at almost the same time and quickly surrounded the Night Owl players from all directions.
The sudden encirclement caused a momentary disturbance in the team.
“It’s the people from the Federation. Don’t panic!”
Liu Keyi raised her hand, indicating for the team to calm down and stay in place quietly.
Zhang Zhe’s heart skipped a beat.
They didn’t resist?
Why did they look so calm?
Zhang Zhe held a double-barreled shotgun in his hand and quickly walked forward, walking in front of the leader, Liu Keyi.
“I suspect that all of you are related to the anti-federal organization, Night Owl. Put down your weapons and follow me back for investigation.”
Liu Keyi surveyed her surroundings as she raised her hands high.
The other players hired by the Night Owl organization also raised their hands.
“Bang!”
The crystal coffin landed heavily on the ground.
Liu Keyi knew that there was a high probability that the Federation had already noticed their movements, so she was not surprised by this attack.
“Captain Zhang Zhe, I’ve heard a lot about you. There are many comrades in the organization who have fought with you. They all say that you’re a hypocritical and cowardly person.”
Zhang Zhe stared at the masked Liu Keyi. “Who are you? Take off your mask and tell me everything you know. I can give you a way out.”

“The crystallized form in its infancy evolves and grows by devouring and absorbing the blue crystal. The entire process is relatively slow, but if the crystallized form accidentally comes into contact with the T-virus while absorbing the blue crystal’s energy...”
Liu Keyi was unmoved and continued to speak in a provocative manner.
“Captain Zhang Zhe, why don’t you guess what kind of wondrous chemical reaction it will have?”
Zhang Zhe’s pupils constricted slightly.
The Federation’s research on crystallized forms was far less thorough than the Night Owl organization’s.
“What will happen?”
“A high-intensity mutation in a short period of time. The strength of a mutated creature can reach Tier 3 to Tier 4, and there’s even a small chance that it can reach Tier 5.”

“Their evolution will become unusually unstable. During the process of evolution, they are extremely easy to explode. They are also very easy to be affected by explosions, resulting in a chain of explosions.”
“The explosion will also stimulate the crystallized form to a certain extent, allowing them to evolve at an unimaginable speed.”
As Liu Keyi spoke, she opened her hand, revealing the explosive detonator in her hand.
“Be careful!!!”
Tang Chu shouted.
The Federation soldiers all took a few steps back at the same time, pointing their guns at Liu Keyi.
Zhang Zhe stared at Liu Keyi. “Are you threatening me? What do you want?”
“Threatening? No, we, Night Owl, never negotiate with terrorist organizations.”
Liu Keyi’s eyes were secretly filled with anger. As she spoke, she fiercely pressed on the remote control device in her hand.
“Go to hell! This is just a little bit of interest!”
Tang Chu shouted, “Get out of the way!!”
The well-trained elite team of the Federation instantly spread out in all directions.
“Boom!!!”
In the next second, a violent explosion resounded throughout the Gobi Desert.
A thick cloud of smoke and dust rose up from the central area.
The crystal coffin instantly exploded, along with the explosives buried within the cave!
Not far away, feeling the tremors under his feet, Fang Heng raised his head and drank a bottle of coffee to calm himself down.
What a guy!
Night Owl was really a group of ruthless characters.
Sacrificing a small life to give a ruthless blow to the Federation.
In fact, Fang Heng had just learned from Deng Xin about Liu Keyi’s follow-up plan.
They placed bombs on the crystal coffin and their bodies.
If the plan went smoothly, they would take the crystal coffin to the nearest Federation shelter.
Then they would self-destruct.
If there was an accident on the way, they would self-destruct.
After the mission was completed, Night Owl would give a generous compensation to this group of hired suicide players.
Mo Jiawei also gulped and exclaimed, “Night Owl... They are all a bunch of lunatics. It’s better not to deal with them in the future.”
The dust gradually dispersed.
Fang Heng took out his binoculars and looked into the distance.
There were seven or eight light red worm creatures crouching on the ground.
Their bodies were already nearly two meters long.
After taking a closer look, Fang Heng realized that the worms themselves were not light red.
A series of scales-like red crystals grew out of the originally white skin of the crystallized worms. White teeth were exposed from its mouth.
“Crystallized form, currently at larva stage.”
“Special mutated creature (Tier 4 mutated creature, can be advanced).”
Mo Jiawei covered his left eye, narrating the information about the crystallized form obtained from the skill.
“Unknown creature, living creature with a DNA structure similar to the primogenitor virus.”

“Slow movement. Currently, it can absorb the energy of the crystallized form, and it also has the preliminary devouring ability. Through devouring flesh and blood, it can also evolve and improve, but the devouring efficiency is relatively low.”
“The current crystallized form has enhanced crystallized scales that can absorb damage. The white fangs have a lethal tearing effect. It can devour 99% of matter.”
“The living body currently only possesses the lowest-level intelligence. It can devour flesh and blood through perception.”
“Unknown creature. Player needs to increase level to obtain more information.”
As he spoke, Mo Jiawei put down his hand and turned to look at Fang Heng.
“It evolved to a Tier 4 mutated body just like that? It rose by 4 levels?”

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - First Wave
paragraphs: Tier 4!
The same tier as the Nemesis!
The worms were the same as when they were at Tier 0, and their movement speed was unusually slow.
They wriggled slowly on the ground, gnawing at the corpses on the ground.
The close-range explosion directly caused more than half of the Federation’s elite team to die.
Zhang Zhe’s condition wasn’t too good either. Even though he had been pushed away by Tang Chu at the last moment of the explosion, he had also been affected by the explosion.
He quickly took out a first-aid needle from his backpack and injected it into his arm.
“Sir! Are you okay?”
“Quick! Gather the team!”
Looking at the worms scattered in the desert, Zhang Zhe’s face was gloomy and cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
“Twelve...”
Zhang Zhe counted the number of crystallized forms left after the explosion.
Among them, four were Tier 4 crystallized forms and eight were Tier 3 crystallized forms.
Such a creature’s strength was a disaster for any shelter!
Currently, the Federation could only deal with two Tier 4 creatures at most, which was their limit!
“Contact the shelter and report to superiors!”
“Stop them! Buy time! No matter what price you pay, do not let them enter the shelter!”
“Yes!”

“Contact the headquarters and ask them to send reinforcements. Low-tier thermal weapons do almost no damage to them. Apply for emergency exchange. We must use highly corrosive sulfuric acid howitzers to deal with them.”
“Yes, Sir!”
The elite team of the Federation was equipped with weapons, and dense bullets rained down on their skin.
The bullet’s damage was very limited against Tier 3 crystallized forms, but it successfully angered them
The Tier 4 crystallized worms, on the other hand, were immune to the bullet’s attack. They didn’t even bother with the bullets, slowly creeping toward the shelter behind the player group.
Far away, Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei were quietly watching the battle.
“Fang Heng, what do you say? The people from the Federation shouldn’t be able to hold on, right?”
Fang Heng looked at the worms and couldn’t help but ponder.
Four of them were all Tier 4 creatures. The reward for killing them should be pretty good.
“I also feel that they won’t be able to hold on.”
Saying that, Fang Heng slowly sat down, opened a packet of biscuits and entered long-range spectator mode.
“There’s no rush. Let’s watch a little longer. The Federation should have some counter-measures. Let them think of a way to weaken them first, then we’ll go up and take the reward.”
Mo Jiawei thought about it and felt that it made sense.
“Right... We can’t help for nothing. We still have to get more benefits from the Federation... we’ll have to contact Chen Yu later.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he threw a simple bed to the side.
“I remember that the shelter needs some rare and special materials to advance to Tier 3, right?”
“Uh, I think so.”

Mo Jiawei looked at Fang Heng, who was calmly watching the situation, and then lowered his head to look at the distant Federation players who were currently engaged in a fierce battle with the crystallized forms.
They were already suffering yet Fang Heng still want to pick up a handful of wool from them.
For some reason, his heart ached for the people of the Federation.
This battle lasted for a full four hours!
The sun was about to set.
The Federation had spent quite a bit of effort to clear out all the Tier 3 crystallized worms.
Only the last four Tier 4 crystallized worms were left!
The strength of the Tier 4 worms was mostly focused on defense. They did not have any long-range attacks.
As long as they did not approach, the worms would basically stand there and take a beating.
The discipline of the Federation elite team was extremely good. No one would charge forward alone.
After using the emergency funds to exchange for the corrosive howitzers, the Tier 4 worm’s body was blasted with a few corrosive holes. The Federation players continued to attack the wounds.
The worm’s strong defensive ability allowed the corroded wounds to slowly recover.
Therefore, the Federation had no choice but to use a few howitzers to break the defense of the crystallized worms at intervals.
Zhang Zhe, who was commanding the battle, was extremely tense.
Although the worms’ movement speed was very slow, they were still approaching the shelter!
At this speed, it was estimated that the worms would reach the shelter in another hour.
The family members of important Federation members who had stayed in the shelter had already left early, but the Federation soldiers would still choose to defend the shelter with their lives.
It was impossible to hold on!
Zhang Zhe reasoned that they would never be able to defend the shelter against four Tier 4 crystallized forms!
He couldn’t think of any way to stop this wave of worms.
The Federation had spent a lot of effort to build the shelter and they were going to give it up just like that?
He would not be able to handle such a big mistake by himself no matter what!
When this matter was over, he would definitely be punished by the Federation!
His only chance was to solve this problem!
“Sir! Look over there!”
Zhang Zhe’s heart skipped a beat as he turned his head to look at a military truck that was approaching them not far away.
The truck stopped not far from the team.
When he saw Fang Heng and Lucia walking out from the truck, Zhang Zhe could not help but frown.
His mood was extremely bad, and he would not give Fang Heng a good look.
“Fang Heng, why are you here? The Federation is dealing with the matter urgently. Unrelated personnel, please evacuate immediately!”
“Your boss invited me here.”
Fang Heng said as he looked at the worms that were approaching the shelter.
“I heard that you were tricked by Night Owl again? Someone has to help you clean up this mess. After all, I still want to continue in Server 8.”
Zhang Zhe’s face was ashen.
Chen Yu walked down from the back of the truck.
“Zhang Zhe, this is the latest order from the higher-ups. Fang Heng will act as a staff officer and help us solve the problem of the crystallized bodies.”
Zhang Zhe’s expression changed as he looked at the copy of the letter of appointment that Chen Yu showed him.
“Are you crazy too? You’re endorsing him? Four Tier 4 creatures, what right does he think he has to help us?”
“These are orders from the superiors.”
“Good! I’d like to see how you deal with these crystallized creatures!” Zhang Zhe shouted angrily, “Meddling in my operation rashly! I’ll definitely report it to the superiors!”
After saying that, Zhang Zhe flicked his sleeves and left.
He sneered in his heart.
When he first saw Fang Heng, he was indeed angry.
But now, Zhang Zhe felt an indescribable ease.
He found someone to blame.
If Chen Yu was willing to take over this mess, then the rest would have nothing to do with him.
Although he would still receive a series of punishments after the incident, it was still much better than now.
No one could resist this wave of crystallized forms.
The destruction of the shelter was a foregone conclusion!
When the time came, everything could be pushed on Chen Yu! What he needed to do now was to quickly evacuate with the important people in the shelter!
Looking at Zhang Zhe leaving alone, Chen Yu snorted. The word ‘disdain’ was written on his face.
He said in an extremely low voice, “Shame...”
Tang Chu and the other team captains were also very angry and dissatisfied with the act of running away and throwing the blame on others.
“I am Tang Chu, head captain of the elite team of the Federation’s desert shelter. Sir! Please give me your instructions!”
“I am Chen Yu. I am in charge of this operation now.”
As he spoke, Chen Yu turned around and looked at Fang Heng.
The latter patted Chen Yu on the shoulder.
“Think on the bright side. Now it’s your turn to be the steward. Let’s solve this problem together.”

Mo Jiawei looked at Fang Heng, who was calmly watching the situation, and then lowered his head to look at the distant Federation players who were currently engaged in a fierce battle with the crystallized forms.
They were already suffering yet Fang Heng still want to pick up a handful of wool from them.
For some reason, his heart ached for the people of the Federation.
This battle lasted for a full four hours!
The sun was about to set.
The Federation had spent quite a bit of effort to clear out all the Tier 3 crystallized worms.
Only the last four Tier 4 crystallized worms were left!
The strength of the Tier 4 worms was mostly focused on defense.
They did not have any long-range attacks.
As long as they did not approach, the worms would basically stand there and take a beating.
The discipline of the Federation elite team was extremely good.
No one would charge forward alone.
After using the emergency funds to exchange for the corrosive howitzers, the Tier 4 worm’s body was blasted with a few corrosive holes.
The Federation players continued to attack the wounds.
The worm’s strong defensive ability allowed the corroded wounds to slowly recover.
Therefore, the Federation had no choice but to use a few howitzers to break the defense of the crystallized worms at intervals.
Zhang Zhe, who was commanding the battle, was extremely tense.
Although the worms’ movement speed was very slow, they were still approaching the shelter!
At this speed, it was estimated that the worms would reach the shelter in another hour.
The family members of important Federation members who had stayed in the shelter had already left early, but the Federation soldiers would still choose to defend the shelter with their lives.
It was impossible to hold on!
Zhang Zhe reasoned that they would never be able to defend the shelter against four Tier 4 crystallized forms!
He couldn’t think of any way to stop this wave of worms.
The Federation had spent a lot of effort to build the shelter and they were going to give it up just like that?
He would not be able to handle such a big mistake by himself no matter what!
When this matter was over, he would definitely be punished by the Federation!
His only chance was to solve this problem!
“Sir!
Look over there!”
Zhang Zhe’s heart skipped a beat as he turned his head to look at a military truck that was approaching them not far away.
The truck stopped not far from the team.
When he saw Fang Heng and Lucia walking out from the truck, Zhang Zhe could not help but frown.
His mood was extremely bad, and he would not give Fang Heng a good look.
“Fang Heng, why are you here?
The Federation is dealing with the matter urgently.
Unrelated personnel, please evacuate immediately!”
“Your boss invited me here.”
Fang Heng said as he looked at the worms that were approaching the shelter.
“I heard that you were tricked by Night Owl again?
Someone has to help you clean up this mess.
After all, I still want to continue in Server 8.”
Zhang Zhe’s face was ashen.
Chen Yu walked down from the back of the truck.
“Zhang Zhe, this is the latest order from the higher-ups.
Fang Heng will act as a staff officer and help us solve the problem of the crystallized bodies.”
Zhang Zhe’s expression changed as he looked at the copy of the letter of appointment that Chen Yu showed him.
“Are you crazy too?
You’re endorsing him?
Four Tier 4 creatures, what right does he think he has to help us?”
“These are orders from the superiors.”
“Good!
I’d like to see how you deal with these crystallized creatures!” Zhang Zhe shouted angrily, “Meddling in my operation rashly!
I’ll definitely report it to the superiors!”
After saying that, Zhang Zhe flicked his sleeves and left.
He sneered in his heart.
When he first saw Fang Heng, he was indeed angry.
But now, Zhang Zhe felt an indescribable ease.
He found someone to blame.
If Chen Yu was willing to take over this mess, then the rest would have nothing to do with him.
Although he would still receive a series of punishments after the incident, it was still much better than now.
No one could resist this wave of crystallized forms.
The destruction of the shelter was a foregone conclusion!
When the time came, everything could be pushed on Chen Yu!
What he needed to do now was to quickly evacuate with the important people in the shelter!
Looking at Zhang Zhe leaving alone, Chen Yu snorted.
The word ‘disdain’ was written on his face.
He said in an extremely low voice, “Shame...”
Tang Chu and the other team captains were also very angry and dissatisfied with the act of running away and throwing the blame on others.
“I am Tang Chu, head captain of the elite team of the Federation’s desert shelter.
Sir!
Please give me your instructions!”
“I am Chen Yu.
I am in charge of this operation now.”
As he spoke, Chen Yu turned around and looked at Fang Heng.
The latter patted Chen Yu on the shoulder.
“Think on the bright side.
Now it’s your turn to be the steward.
Let’s solve this problem together.”

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - Raise the Price
paragraphs: Chen Yu took a deep breath and nodded solemnly.
“Fang Heng, what arrangements do you have?”
“Tell your men to disperse first. I’ll test the strength of the crystallized form first. Be careful not to be affected.”
“Alright!”
Chen Yu looked at the small team at the side, commanding Tang Chu and the others.
“Listen to my orders. All teams retreat temporarily!”
Tang Chu saluted, “Yes!”
In the distance, the constantly attacking federal team quickly retreated.
Fang Heng and Lucia looked at each other and nodded.
Tang Chu and the other Federation players quickly retreated.
He didn’t know what happened, nor did he know what Chen Yu and Fang Heng’s plan was. However, they soon felt a faint vibration coming from beneath their feet.
“They’re here, look.”
They looked into the distance.
A patch of red appeared on the horizon again.
A swarm of Lickers rushed towards the crystallized worms like a torrent.
Tang Chu’s pupils constricted as he looked at Fang Heng and Lucia in shock.
The Lickers!
They were back again?
Did the prison lure them here through a special method?
Tang Chu’s heart was pounding.
This was too crazy!
The Lickers were moving extremely fast!
Almost instantly, the Lickers jumped onto the crystallized worms.
They waved their sharp claws, leaving scratches and scars on the crystallized worms’ armour.
The Licker’s evolved tongue stabbed at the crystallized worm’s armour! It left deep dents.
The crystallized worm squirmed very slowly. It could not avoid the Lickers’ attacks, but its counterattack was also abnormally swift!
“Chi!”
The worm opened its bloody mouth and bit forward.
The Licker that was attacking the crystallized worm could not dodge in time and ended up being swallowed by the latter.
Almost instantly, Fang Heng’s game log was flooded.
[Hint: Your zombie clone (proliferator)-Licker is attacked and dies.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker causes damage to the crystallized form.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker causes bleeding damage to the crystallized form...]
Fang Heng observed the battlefield from a distance while looking at the game log.
The situation was not optimistic!
The crystallized worm displayed a powerful devouring ability and defensive ability.
The sharp claws of the Lickers had the dual effect of breaking through the armour and causing bleeding damage. This was their greatest weapon when dealing with high-level creatures.
However, the crystallized armour was more sturdy and difficult to break.
If the armour could not be broken, the bleeding effect could not be triggered.
The only place that could cause bleeding damage was that spot!
Fang Heng’s gaze shifted to the right side of the worm’s body, the spot that had been hit by the sulfuric acid howitzer.
That spot was corroded by sulfuric acid. Without the protection of the crystallized armour, every attack of the Licker could rip off a large chunk of flesh.
There was also the bleeding damage effect!
As long as he controlled a large number of Lickers to attack the injured spot simultaneously, the bleeding damage could be stacked continuously!
They could grind it to death!
Let’s give it a try!
Fang Heng and Lucia exchanged glances.
The group of Lickers swarmed towards the crystallized worm with the most serious injury on the far right.
At this moment, the Federation players, who were watching by the side, were breathing heavily.
Shocking!
The strength of the Lickers was beyond their expectations.
Especially when hundreds of Lickers gathered together!
The scene in front of them looked unusually bloody.
This was the first time they had gained the upper hand in their fight with the crystallized worm!
The worm’s HP slowly decreased and the number of Lickers was also decreasing.
After more than ten minutes of entanglement, the Tier 4 crystallized worm that was besieged by the Lickers suddenly stopped attacking.
Its body was faintly emitting a red light.
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched.
“Chi Chi Chi Chi!!”
The Lickers retreated at an even faster speed.
“Boom!!!”
Three seconds later, the crystallized worm exploded on the spot!
The blast wave directly blew apart the nearby three Tier 4 crystallized worms and the group of Lickers that could not escape in time!
Even the Federation players that were assisting at the side were affected, and they were blown to all sides.
“Bah!”
Tang Chu quickly stood up and spat out the sand that was blown into his mouth.
“Success!!”
He was full of excitement.
The morale of the Federation players was also high.
One down!
After fighting with these troublesome worms for an entire afternoon, they finally saw a ray of hope!
[Hint: You have killed a crystallized form (Tier 4 larva stage). You have obtained 228 survival points. You have obtained a Tier 2 evolution crystal*1.]
The game hint made Fang Heng happy.
Good! The finishing blow was successful!
Evolution crystal fragments in hand!
There were still three left!
Fang Heng’s gaze focused on the remaining three evolved crystallized worms. He thought fast about it and adjusted his tactics.
“Chen Yu, I need your help. The crystallized worm’s armour requires the use of a sulfuric acid howitzer to complete the corrosion effect. I need your help to make a hole in their armour.”
“No problem! Our Federation’s elite team will hold them back from the side!”
Chen Yu quickly gave the order, “All teams, pay attention. Think of a way to separate the three crystallized worms. The next target is the crystallized worm on the far right!”
“Use the sulfuric acid howitzers. Aim at one part and corrode its crystallized armour!”
“Yes, Sir!”
Tang Chu was excited. He immediately commanded the three elite teams to approach from three different directions.
“Boom! Boom Boom!”
The howitzer, with a strong corrosive effect, required several rounds to barely corrode part of the crystallized armour of the worm.
Due to the limited ammunition, the federal team used the howitzer to blast a blood-red hole on the right side of the crystallized form before quickly retreating.
Fang Heng immediately controlled the Lickers to surround it.
He turned to look at Chen Yu.
“Not enough. I need more corrosive howitzers.”
“Yes, the process is already underway. The King of Gods’ points that were prepared for emergency use have been exhausted. It will be very troublesome to temporarily mobilize them. It will take time.”
Chen Yu wiped the sweat from his forehead. He was equally anxious.

“Fang Heng, they are getting closer and closer to the shelter. We have to think of a way to stop them from approaching the shelter. We have paid too much to build this shelter. We cannot afford such a huge loss.”
Hearing this, the Federation player’s attention was focused on Fang Heng.
Unknowingly, Fang Heng had become the last hope for the players to stop the crystallized worm.
“Sigh.”
Fang Heng was quite distressed and let out a long sigh.
Even Fang Heng could not do anything?
Seeing Fang Heng’s grave expression, everyone’s heart sank.
“Chen Yu, you have to pay more for this job...”
Chen Yu was stunned for a moment, then he was overjoyed.
He really had a way!
Chen Yu immediately said, “As long as we can find a way to stop the zombie horde from attacking the shelter, the Federation will try their best to satisfy any request!”
“You promised. Don’t go back on your word. I have recorded everything.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he slowly raised his right hand.
There was no other way. Fang Heng didn’t want to reveal his trump card so soon.
